rows.reference: Ìwáàdí nípa èrò-ọkàn àwọn ènìyàn láti ọwọ Ìgbìmọ̀ Amúṣẹ́ṣe fún Ìgbaniṣíṣẹ́ àti Àwọn Ìmọ̀ lọ́dún 2014 ṣàwárí pé ninu àwọn ìdí tí àwọn agbaniṣ̵íṣẹ́ sọ fún lílàkàkà wọn láti di àwọn ààyè òṣìṣẹ́ tó ṣófo, ìdá mẹ́tàdínlógún ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún wọn ni wọ́n sọpé ó jẹ́ nitori àìni ìmọ̀ ède miraǹ.

rows.source: Therefore more and more, language skills are becoming imperative in order to prepare young people for their future careers.
rows.output: Nítorí náà, ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ni wọ́n ń wá láti kọ́ èdè tuntun láti lè mú àwọn iṣẹ́ wọn lọ́wọ́ ní ọjọ́ iwájú.
rows.reference: Nítorínáà púpọ̀̀ àwọn ìmọ̀ èdè níwọ́n ńdi ohun tó ńfẹ̀ àmójútó láti leè gba àwọn ọ̀dọ́ láradì fún àwọn iṣẹ́-ìṣe ọjọ́ iwájú wọn.

rows.source: With more prospective job opportunities requiring languages, these skills are essential in a globalised world.
rows.output: Pẹ̀lú àwọn àǹfààní iṣẹ́ tó ń bọ̀ wọ́n sì ń béèrè fún èdè, àwọn ìmọ̀ọ́ṣe wọ̀nyí ṣe pàtàkì nínú ayé àgbáyé.
rows.reference: Pẹ̀lú ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn àǹfààni iṣẹ̵́ tówà lọ́jọ́ iwájú eyiti wọ́n nílò àwọn èdè, àwọn ìmọ̀ wọ̀nyí jẹ́ kòṣeémáàní ninu ayé tí ìkáwọ́ rẹ̀ ti dọ̀kan yìí.

rows.source: Regardless of the career someone chooses, if they've learned a second language, they'll have a real advantage in the future having a life-long skill such as this.
rows.output: Láìka iṣẹ́ tí ẹnìkan bá yan, bí wọn bá ti kọ́ èdè kejì, wọn yóò ní àǹfààní ńlá ní ọjọ́ iwájú ní níní ìmọ̀ọ́ṣe ìgbésí ayé bíi èyí.
rows.reference: Láìnífiṣe irú iṣẹ́-ìṣe ti ẹnìkan yàn, bí wọ́n báti kọ́ èdè keji, wọn yóò ní àǹfààní gidi kan ní ọjọ́ iwájú náà pẹ̀lú níní ìmọ̀́ irú èyí.

rows.source: Being able to communicate directly with people from foreign countries will automatically put a multilingual person ahead of the competition.
rows.output: Lára àwọn ohun tí o ṣe pàtàkì jùlọ ni láti lè bá àwọn ènìyàn láti orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn sọ̀rọ̀ ní ọ̀nà tààrà.
rows.reference: Láti leè bá àwọn èèyàn láti àwọn ilẹ̀ òkèèrè sọrọ tààra yóò fi ẹnití ó gbọ́ ọ̀pọ̀ èdè kan síwájú láìsí tàbí-ṣùgbọ́n ninu ìfagagbága náà.

rows.source: According to a YouGov poll of more than 4,000 UK adults in 2013, 75 per cent were unable to speak a foreign language well enough to hold a conversation and with French being the only language spoken by a double-digit percentage, 15 per cent.
rows.output: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìdìbò YouGov kan ti ju 4,000 àwọn àgbàlagbà UK lọ ní ọdún 2013, 75 ogorun kò lè sọ èdè àjèjì kan dáadáa tó lè mú ìjíròrò kan wá, àti pé Faransé nìkan ni èdè tí a sọ ní ìdá méjìlá.
rows.reference: Gẹ́gẹ́bi ìdìbò YouGov eyiti ẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́rin àwọn àgbà ní orile-ede UK kópa lọ́dún 2013, ìdá márùndínlọ́gọ́rin ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún ni kò leè sọ èdè ilẹ̀ òkèèrè kan eyiti kódára tó láti fiṣe ibánisọ̀rọ̀ atí bii èdè Faranṣe sè jẹ́ èdè kan ṣoṣo tí ìdá oní-díjíìtì méjì, ìdá márùndínlógún ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún ńsọ.

rows.source: This is why putting the investment into language teaching now is important for today's children.
rows.output: Èyí ni ìdí tí ó fi ṣe pàtàkì láti fi owó sí ẹ̀kọ́ èdè báyìí fún àwọn ọmọ òde òní.
rows.reference: Èyí ní ìdí tí fífi ìdókòòwò sínú ìkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ èdè nísinsìnyí ṣeṣe pàtàkì fún àwọn ọmọdé òde-òní.

rows.source: Having multiple languages, particularly those of developing economies, will equip children with a better chance of finding meaningful employment.
rows.output: Níwọ̀n bí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ èdè wà, pàápàá àwọn tí wọ́n ń ṣe ìdàgbàsókè ọrọ̀ ajé, yóò fún àwọn ọmọdé ní àǹfààní láti rí iṣẹ́ tí ó ní ìtumọ̀.
rows.reference: Níní àwọn ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ èdè, paàpá ti àwọn ọ̀rọ̀-ajé tó ńdàgbàsóke, yóò fún àǹfààní tódára ju fún rírí iṣẹ́ eyiti ó nítumọ̀.

rows.source: Within Scotland, each school will differ in the languages they teach.
rows.output: Ní Scotland, ilé-ẹ̀kọ̀ọ́ kọ̀ọ̀kan yóò yàtọ̀ ní èdè tí wọ́n ń kọ́.
rows.reference: Láàrin ilẹ̀ Sikọtiland, ilé ìwé kọ̀ọ̀kan yóò yàtọ̀ ninu àwọn èdè náà tíwọn ńkọ́.

rows.source: A number of schools will focus on the more classic modern languages, whereas others will teach languages that are deemed to be most important for the UK when looking ahead to 2020, such as Mandarin or Japanese.
rows.output: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ yóò dojú kọ àwọn èdè ìgbàlódé tó gbajúmọ̀, nígbà tí àwọn mìíràn yóò kọ́ àwọn èdè tó jẹ́ pàtàkì jùlọ fún UK nígbà tí a bá wo ọjọ́ iwájú sí 2020, bíi Mandarin tàbí Japanese.
rows.reference: Iye òǹkà àwọn ilé ìwé kan yóò gbájúmọ́ lórí àwọn èdè ọ̀làjú tójẹ́ ti ìgbàlódé díẹ̀ síi, nigbati àwọn miran yóò máa kọ́ni ní àwọn êdè tí wọ́n kàsí pàtàkì jùlọ fún orilẹ-ede UK nigbati a bá ńfojú ṣọ́nà fún ọdún 2020, bíi èdè Mandarin tabi èdè Japaanu.

rows.source: Whatever your child's interest, there will always be a number of languages to choose from within independent schools, with teaching staff who are specialists in this area.
rows.output: Ohunkóhun tí ọmọ rẹ fẹ́ràn, àwọn ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ olómìníìrìndòǹgbà kan wà tí yóò máa ń ṣe àwọn èdè tó yàtọ̀ síra fún wọn, pẹ̀lú àwọn olùkọ́ tí wọ́n jẹ́ àwọn akọ́ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ nínú ẹ̀ka yìí.
rows.reference: Ohunkóhun tóbájẹ́ ìfẹ́ ọmọ rẹ, iye òǹkà àwọn èdè kan yóò máa wà nigba gbogbo láti yàn ninu wọn láàrim àwọn ilé-iwé olómìnira, pẹ̀lú àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìkọ́nilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tíwọ́n jẹ́ akọ́ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ ninu ipele ẹ̀kọ́ yìí.

rows.source: Scottish independent schools are dedicated to providing a learning environment that will prepare children and arm them with the skills required to succeed, whatever the future holds.
rows.output: Awọn ile-iwe ominira ti Scotland jẹ ti a ṣe lati pese agbègbè ẹkọ ti yoo gbaradì awọn ọmọde ati ki wọn fun wọn ni awọn ọgbọ́n ti o yẹ ki wọn ṣe aseyọri, ohun ti ọjọ iwaju le mu wa.
rows.reference: Àwọn ilé ìwé olómìnira ti ilẹ̀ Sikotilandi ní a fijìn fún pípèsè àyíká ìkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ kan eyiti yóò gba àwọn ọmọdé laradì tí yóò sì rówọn lágbara pẹ̀lú ìmọ̀ tíwọ́n nílò láti ṣàṣeyọrí, ohunkóhùn tí ọjọ́ ọ̀la bámú dáni.

rows.source: It can't be denied at this time, in a global business environment, that languages continue to be vitally important to the country's future, so this must be mirrored in education.
rows.output: Kò ṣeé sọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ ní àkókò yìí, nínú àyíká ìṣòwò àgbáyé, pé èdè ń ṣe pàtàkì sí ọjọ́ iwájú orílẹ̀-èdè náà, nítorí náà, èyí gbọ́dọ̀ jẹ́ àfihàn nínú ẹ̀kọ́.
rows.reference: Kò ṣ̵eé ṣẹ́ ní àkókò yìí, ninu àyíká oko-òwò àgbáyé kan, wipe àwọn èdè ńtẹ̀síwájú láti máa jẹ́ kòṣeémáàní pàtàkí fún ọjọ́ iwájú orilẹ-ede náà, nítorínáà èyí ní a gbọ̀dọ̀ jẹ́kí ó hàn ninu ètò ẹ̀kọ́.

rows.source: Indeed, modern languages should really be considered "international communication skills."
rows.output: Ní tòótọ́, àwọn èdè ìgbàlódé gbọ́dọ̀ jẹ́ “àwọn ìmọ̀ọ́ṣe ìbáraẹniṣepọ̀ àgbáyé.”
rows.reference: Lóòtítọ́, àwọn èdè ọ̀làjú ni a nílatí kàsí gidigidi bíi ''àwọn ìmọ̀ ìbáraẹnisọ̀rọ̀ ti àgbáyé''.

rows.source: Independent schools will continue to offer this choice, diversity and excellence for Scotland's young people.
rows.output: Awọn ile-iwe ominira yoo tẹsiwaju lati funni ni yiyan, oniruuru, ati didara fun awọn ọmọde Scotland.
rows.reference: Àwọn ilé ìwé olómìnira yóò tẹ̀síwájú láti máa fúnni ní àṣàyàn yìí, ọ̀pọ̀ lóríṣiríṣi àti ìtayọ fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ilẹ̀ Sikotilandi.

rows.source: Il faut bien le faire.
rows.output: Ó yẹ kí a ṣe é.
rows.reference: Ó ṣe pàtàkì.

rows.source: John Edward is Director of the Scottish Council of Independent Schools
rows.output: John Edward ni Oludari Igbimọ Ilu Scotland ti Awọn ile-iwe Aladani
rows.reference: John Edward ni Olùdarí ti Ìgbìmọ̀ ti Àwọn Ilé ìwé Olómìnira Ilẹ Sikotilandi

rows.source: LeBron to make Lakers debut Sunday in San Diego
rows.output: LeBron lati ṣe akọkọ rẹ fun Lakers ni ọjọ Sundee ni San Diego
rows.reference: LeBron yóò gba ayò àkọ́kọ́ ninu ìdíje ti Lakers lọ́jọ́ Àìkú ni ìlú San Diego.

rows.source: The wait is nearly over for fans looking to see LeBron James make his first start for the Los Angeles Lakers.
rows.output: Ìdúró fún àwọn olólùfẹ́ tí ń retí láti rí LeBron James ṣe eré àkọ́kọ́ rẹ̀ fún Los Angeles Lakers.
rows.reference: Ìdúró náà ti fẹ́rẹ̀ tán fún àwọn olólùfẹ́ tíwọ́n ti ńfojú ṣọ́nà láti ríi kí LeBron James gba ayò àkọ́kọ́ fún Los Angeles Lakers.

rows.source: Lakers coach Luke Walton has announced that James will play in Sunday's preseason opener against the Denver Nuggets in San Diego.
rows.output: Olùkọ Lakers Luke Walton ti kede pe James yoo ṣe ere ni ere akọkọ ti preseason lori Denver Nuggets ni San Diego.
rows.reference: Olùkọ́ni Lakers Luke Walton ti kéde wipe James yóò gba ayò ninu ìdíje ìsíde tósáájú ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ sáà níbití wọn yóò ti dojúkọ Denvers Nuggets ní San Diego.

rows.source: But just how many minutes he'll play has yet to be determined.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n, bí ó bá ti ṣe àwọn ìṣẹ́jú mélòó tó yóò ṣe eré náà ṣì jẹ́ ohun tí a kò mọ̀.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n fún bí àwọn ìṣẹ́jú tí yóò fi gbá ayò níwọn kò tíì pinnu rẹ̀.

rows.source: "It will be more than one and less than 48," said Walton on the Lakers" official website.
rows.output: "Yóò ju ọ̀kan lọ àti kéré ju 48," ni Walton sọ lórí ojú òpó ayélujára ti Lakers.
rows.reference: ''Yóò ju ọ̀kan lọ àtipé yóò dín ní méjìdínláàdọ́ta,'' ni Walton sọ lórí ojú-òpó ayelujara ti ilé iṣẹ́ Lakers.

rows.source: Lakers reporter Mike Trudell tweeted that James will likely play limited minutes.
rows.output: Olùsáré Lakers Mike Trudell tweeted wipe James yoo se ere ere kukuru.
rows.reference: Oníròyìn Lakers Mike Trudell kọ àkọránṣẹ́ túwìtì wipe ó ṣeé ṣe kí James gbá ayò fún àwọn ìṣẹ́jú tó lódiwọ̀n.

rows.source: Following practice earlier this week, James was asked about his plans for the Lakers" six-game preseason schedule.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn iṣẹ́ tí ó ti ṣe ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí, wọ́n béèrè lọ́wọ́ rẹ̀ nípa àwọn ètò rẹ̀ fún àwọn eré ìdíje preseason mẹ́fà ti àwọn Lakers.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn ìgbaradì níbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí, wọ́n bí James léèrè nípa àwọn ètò rẹ̀ fún àkọsílẹ̀ ìlànà ìdíje fún ìdíje mẹ́fà tósíwájú sáà ti Lakers.

rows.source: "I don't need preseason games at this stage of my career to get ready," he said.
rows.output: "Mi ò nílò àwọn eré-ìdárayá preseason ní ìpele yìí ti iṣẹ́ mi láti gbaradì," ó sọ.
rows.reference: ''̀̀Èmi kò nílò àwọn ìdíje tósíwáju sáà ní ipele iṣẹ́ mi láti leè ṣetán,'' gẹgẹ bi otí wí.

rows.source: Trump's West Virginia Rally Time, YouTube Channel
rows.output: Ìpàdé Trump ní West Virginia, Àkáǹtì YouTube rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Àkókò Ìpéjọpọ̀ Ìwọ̀-oòrùn Virginia ti Trump, Ìkànnì YouTube

rows.source: President Donald Trump begins a flurry of campaign rallies tonight in Wheeling, West Virginia.
rows.output: Ààrẹ Donald Trump bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìpàdé ìdìbò púpọ̀ láláìpẹ́ yìí ní Wheeling, West Virginia.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ̵ Donald Trump ńbẹ̀rẹ̀ àkọlùkọgbà àwọn ìpéjọpọ̀ fún ìpolongo kan lálẹ́ òní ní ilù Wheeling, Ìwọ̀-oòrùn Virginia.

rows.source: It's Trump's first of five scheduled rallies in the next week, including stops in friendly places including Tennessee and Mississippi.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ ìpàdé àkọ́kọ́ Trump nínú àwọn ìpàdé márùn-ún tí a ti ṣètò fún ọ̀sẹ̀ tó ń bọ̀, títí kan ìpàdé ní àwọn ibi tí ó fẹ́ràn, bíi Tennessee àti Mississippi.
rows.reference: Ó jẹ́ ti aláàkọ́kọ́ ti Trump ninu àwọn ìpéjọpọ̀ máàrún tíwọ́n ti ṣàkọsílẹ̀ rẹ̀ pé yóò wáyé ninu ọ̀sẹ̀ tó ńbọ̀ náà, pẹ̀lú àwọn ìdúró ni àwọn ibití wọn ti jẹ́ ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ́ pẹ̀lú Tennessee àti Mississippi.

rows.source: With the confirmation vote on hold for his pick to fill the Supreme Court vacancy, Trump is aiming to build support for upcoming mid-term elections since Republicans are at risk of losing control of Congress when votes are cast on Nov.
rows.output: Pẹlu ibura ti o wa ni idaduro fun yiyan rẹ lati kun ipo Ile-ẹjọ giga, Trump n wa lati kọ atilẹẹin fun awọn idibo aarin-ọun ti n bọ, nitori pe awọn Republikani wa ni ewu ti sisubu iṣakoso Ile-igbimọ nigbati awọn idibo ba waye ni Oṣu kọkanla.
rows.reference: Pẹ̀lú ìdìbò ìfìdíọ̀rọ̀múlẹ̀ tó sì ńdúró fún ẹnití ó mu láti wànípò tó ṣófo nílé Ejọ́ Tógajùlọ náà, Trump ńlépa láti gbé àtìlẹ́yìn dìde fún àwọn ìdìbò ààrin-sáà tó ńbọ níwọ̀n igbati àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ̵́ òṣèlú Republican wà ninu ewu àtipàdánù ìsàkóso ilé Ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣojú-ṣòfin kékeré nigbati wọ́n bá dìbò lóṣù Bélú.

rows.source: What time is Trump's West Virginia rally tonight and how do you watch online?
rows.output: Kí ni àkókò ìpàdé Trump ní West Virginia lénìí? Báwo ni mo ṣe lè wo lórí ayélujára?
rows.reference: Kínni àkókò ìpéjọpọ̀ Ìwọ-oòrùn Virginia lálẹ́ òní àtipé báwo ni o ṣe leè wò ó lójú-òpó ayelujara?

rows.source: Trump's Wheeling, West Virginia rally is scheduled for 7 p.m. ET tonight, Saturday, September 29, 2018.
rows.output: Ìpàdé Trump ní Wheeling, West Virginia jẹ́ àsètò fún 7 p.m. ET lálẹ́ yìí, Saturday, September 29, 2018.
rows.reference: Ìpéjọpọ̀ Trump ti Ìwọ̀-oòrùn Virginia, ní ìlú Wheeling níwọn ṣàkọsílẹ̀ wíwáyé rẹ̀ fún aago méjé alẹ́. Àkókò l̀là-oòrùn lálẹ́ òní, Àbámẹ́ta, ọjọ́ kọkàndínlọ́gbọ̀n oṣù Owewe, ọdún 2018.

rows.source: You can watch Trump's West Virginia rally online below via live stream on YouTube.
rows.output: O lè wo ìpàdé Trump ní West Virginia lórí ayélujára nísàlẹ̀ nípasẹ̀ ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò YouTube.
rows.reference: Ó leè wo ìpéjọpọ̀ Ìwọ-oòrùn Virginia lójú-òpó ayelujara nísàlẹ̀ nípaṣẹ̀ ìsànwọlé bótíńṣẹlẹ̀ lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ lórí YouTube.

rows.source: Trump is likely to address this week's hearings for Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh, which became tense over sexual misconduct allegations with an anticipated Senate confirmation vote on hold for up to a week while the FBI investigates.
rows.output: Trump yóò ṣe àdúrà sí àwọn ìpàdé ilé ẹjọ́ tó ń lọ lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ fún ìdìbò sí ilé ẹjọ́ gíga, tó di ìforígbárí lórí àwọn ẹ̀sùn ìbálòpọ̀ tó ń lọ lọ́wọ́ pẹ̀lú ìdìbò Sẹnẹ́tọ̀ tó lè dúró fún ọ̀sẹ̀ kan nígbà tí àwọn ọlọ́pàá ń ṣe ìwádìí.
rows.reference: Trump ni ó ṣeé ṣ̵e kí ó sọ̀rọ̀ lórí àwọn ìgbẹ́jọ́ ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí fún ẹni-a-fàkalẹ̀-fúnṣẹ́ Ilé Ẹjọ́ Tógajùlọ Brett Kavanaugh, eyiti o dariwo lórí àwọn ẹ̀sùn ìsìwàhu nípa ìbánilòpọ̀ pẹ̀lú ìdìbò ìfìdíọ̀rọ̀múlẹ̀ tíwọn ńretí tó sì ńdúró fún bí ọ̀sẹ̀ kan nigbati àjọ FBI náà sì ńṣe ìwáàdí.

rows.source: But the primary aim of this flurry of rallies is helping Republicans facing touch November elections gain some momentum.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n ète àkọ́kọ́ ti ìwọ̀ntúnwọ̀nsì yìí ni láti ran àwọnómọ̀gbọ́n Republikáàsì lọ́wọ́ tí wọ́n ń dojú kọ ìdìbò tó le ní oṣù kọkànlá.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n ìlépa àkọ́kọ́ ti àkọlùkọgbà àwọn ìpéjọpò yìí ní láti ràn àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Republicans tó ńdojúkọ àwọn ìdìbò oṣù Bélú tóle lọ́wọ́ láti jèrè àwọn agbara fún ìlọsíwájú kan.

rows.source: Thus, President Trump's campaign said these five rallies in the next week are aimed at "energizing volunteers and supporters as Republicans try to protect and expand the majorities they hold in the Senate and House of Representatives," according to Reuters.
rows.output: Nítorí náà, ẹgbẹ́ ìpolongo Ààrẹ Trump sọ pé àwọn ìpàdé márùn-ún wọ̀nyí ní ọ̀sẹ̀ tó ń bọ̀ ni wọ́n ń fọkànsìn láti “mú àwọn olùfọkànsìn àti àwọn olùfọkànsìn kí wọ́n lè mú kí àwọn ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Republican lè dáàbòbò àti láti fọwọ́ sí àwọn ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Republican tó wà nínú Sénétọ̀ àti Ilé Ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣòfin,” gẹ́gẹ́ bí Reuters ṣe sọ.
rows.reference: Nítorínáa, ìpolongo ti Ààrẹ Trump sọpé àwọn ìpéjọpọ̀ máàrún lọ́sẹ̀ tó ńbọ̀ ńlépa fún ''fífi agbára fún àwọn tóyọ̀ǹda ara wọn àti àwọn alátìlẹ́yìn bí àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ òṣelú Rebulicans ṣe ńgbìyànjú láti dáàbò àti láti ṣàmúgbòòrò àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ tópọ̀ju tíwọ́n nílé Ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣojú-ṣòfin Àgbà ati ti Aṣojú-ṣòfin Àgbà kékeré,'' gẹ́gẹ̵̵́bí Reuters ti sọ.

rows.source: "Control of Congress is so critical for his agenda that the president will travel to as many states as possible as we head into the busy campaign season," a Trump campaign spokesman who declined to be named told Reuters.
rows.output: "Ìdarí ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin jẹ́ ohun pàtàkì fún ètò rẹ̀ tí Ààrẹ yóò rin ìrìn-àjò lọ sí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ìpínlẹ̀ bí a bá ti wọ inú àkókò ìdìbò tí ó ńlàásìkò," ẹni tí ó jẹ́ ọ̀gá ẹgbẹ́ ìdìbò Trump tí ó kọ̀ láti sọ orúkọ rẹ̀ ní Reuters sọ.
rows.reference: ''Ìṣàkóso ilé Ìgbìmọ Aṣojú-ṣòfin kékeré ṣe pàtàkí gidigidi fún ètò rẹ̀ eyiti yóò jẹ́kí ààrẹ rin ìrìn-àjò lọsí bíi àwọn ìpínlẹ̀ púpọ̀ tóbá ṣeé ṣe bí a tí ńkorí wọ inú sáà ìpolongo ìbò tókún fọ́fọ́ fún iṣẹ́ kan,'' ni agbẹnusọ ìpolongo ìbô Trump kan ẹnití ó kọ̀ wipe kí a dárúkọ òun sọ fùn Reuters.

rows.source: Scheduled for Wesbanco Arena in Wheeling, tonight's rally could bring supporters from "Ohio and Pennsylvania and draw coverage from the Pittsburgh media," according to the West Virginia Metro News.
rows.output: Ti ṣeto fun Wesbanco Arena ni Wheeling, apejọ ti o wa l'ẹnu-ọna le mu awọn olufowosi wa lati "Ohio ati Pennsylvania ati fa coverage lati ọdọ media Pittsburgh," ni ibamu si West Virginia Metro News.
rows.reference: Bí wọń ti ṣ̀akọsílẹ̀ rẹ̀ láti wáyé fún Gbàgede Wesbanco ní ìlú Wheeling, ìpéjọpọ̀ alẹ́ òni leè mú àwọn alátìlẹ̵̵yìn wá láti ''Ohio àti Pennysylvania kí ó sì fa ìgbésíta fáyé rí láti ọwọ́ àwọn oníròyìn Pittsburgh,'' gẹ́gẹ̵́bí Ìròyìn Ìwọ̀-oòrùn Virginia Metro tisọ.

rows.source: Saturday will be the second time in the past month that Trump has visited West Virginia, the state he won by more than 40 percentage points in 2016.
rows.output: Saturday yóò jẹ́ ìgbà kejì ní oṣù tó kọjá tí Trump ti ṣàbẹ̀wò sí West Virginia, ìpínlẹ̀ tí ó gba ní 40% ju àwọn olùdìbò lọ ní 2016.
rows.reference: Ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta ni yóò jẹ́ ìgbà kejì ninu oṣù tókọjá eyiti Trump ti ṣàbẹ̀wò sí Ìwọ-oòrùn Virginia, ìpínlẹ̀ náà tó borì rẹ̀ nípaṣẹ̀ àwọn kókó tóju ìdá ogójì nínú ọgọ́ọ̀rún lọ ninu ọdún 2016.

rows.source: Trump is trying to help West Virginia Republican Senate candidate Patrick Morrisey, who is trailing in the polls.
rows.output: Trump n gbiyanju lati ran oludije egbe oselu Republikani ti West Virginia, Patrick Morrisey lọwọ, ti o n lọ silẹ ni awọn idibo.
rows.reference: Trump ńgbìyànjú láti ṣe ìrànwọ́ fún olùdíje fún ipò Aṣojú-ṣòfin Àgbà ninu ẹgbẹ́ Republican fún Ìwọ-oòrùn Virginia Patrick Morrisey ẹniti ó ńwà lẹ́yìn ninu àwọn ìdìbò láti mọ èrò-ọkàn àwọn ara ìlú.

rows.source: "It's not a good sign for Morrisey that the president has to come to try to give him a boost in the polls," said Simon Haeder, a political scientist at West Virginia University, according to Reuters.
rows.output: "Kìí ṣe ààmì rere fún Morrisey pé Ààrẹ gbọ́dọ̀ wá láti gbìyànjú láti fún un ní ìmúlò nínú ìdìbò," ni Símón Héder, onímọ̀ òṣèlú ní Yunifásítì West Virginia, sọ fún Reuters.
rows.reference: ''Kìí ṣe àmì rere kan fún Morrisey wipe àarẹ̵ níláti wá láti gbìyànjú láti fún un ní ìgbésókè ninu àwọn ìdìbò náà,'' ni Simon Haeder, onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì ti òṣèlú kan ní ilé ìwé Yunifasiti Ìwọ-oòrùn Virginia sọ gẹ́gẹ́bí Reuters ti wí.

rows.source: Ryder Cup 2018: Team USA show stomach for fight to keep hopes alive heading into Sunday singles
rows.output: Ryder Cup 2018: Ẹgbẹ́ USA ńfi agbára fún ìjà láti pa ìrètí wọn mọ́ ní àkókò ìdáwọ́sọ̀rọ̀ ní ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta.
rows.reference: Ife-ẹ̀yẹ Ryder tí ọdún 2018 Ikọ̀ orilẹ-ede USA fi ikùn tíwọ́n ní hàn fún ìjà láti jẹ́kí àwọn ìrètí wà láàyè bí wọ́n ti ńgbórí wọnú àwọn ayò ẹlẹ́yọ-kọ̀ọ̀kan ti ọjọ́ Àìkú

rows.source: After three one-sided sessions, Saturday afternoon's foursomes might just have been what this Ryder Cup needed.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn àwọn ìpàdé mẹ́ta tí ó jẹ́ ọ̀kan, ọ̀sán ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta lè jẹ́ ohun tí Ryder Cup nílò.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn àwọn sáà mẹ́ta eyiti ó fì sẹ́ẹ̀gbẹ́ kan, àwọn onímẹ́rin ti ọ̀sán ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta kàn leè jẹ́ ohun tí Ife-ẹ̀yẹ Ryder yìí nílò.

rows.source: The swinging pendulum of momentum is a completely invented sporting concept but one that players truly believe in, and never more so than at competitions like these.
rows.output: Ìyípadà ìyípadà ti ìyípadà ni imọran eré-ìdárayá tí a ṣẹ̀dá, ṣùgbọ́n ọ̀kan tí àwọn eléré kò lè gbàgbọ́, tí wọ́n sì ń gbàgbọ́ lọ́kàn wọn ju nígbà tí wọ́n bá ń ṣe eré ní àwọn ìdíje bíi èyí.
rows.reference: Dùgbẹ̀-dùgbẹ̀ ti ipá-atini tó ńfì náà jẹ ọ̀rọ̀ eré ìdíje tíwọ́n gbélẹ̀rọ pátápátá kan ṣùgbọ́n ọ̀kan tí àwọn olùdíje gbàgbọ́ ninu rẹ̀ nítòótọ̀, tí kòrí jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ rí ní irú àwọn ìdíje bíi ìwọ́nyí.

rows.source: So where would they say the momentum is now?
rows.output: Nítorínáà ibi wo ni wọn yóò sọ pé ìmúṣẹ́ náà wà báyìí?
rows.reference: Nítorínáâ níbo ni wọn yóò sọpé ipá-atini náà wà báyìí?

rows.source: "They had a six-point lead and now it's four, so we are carrying that as a little bit of momentum I guess," said Jordan Spieth as he strolled off for the day.
rows.output: "Wọn ní ìdá mẹ́fà ní ìdá mẹ́fà àti báyìí o ti di mẹ́rin, nítorí náà a ń gbé èyí gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìdààmú díẹ̀," ni Jordan Spieth sọ bí o ti ń lọ fún ọjọ́ náà.
rows.reference: ''Wọ́n ti ní ìléwájú oníkókó-mẹ́fà àtipé nísinsìnyí ó jẹ́ mẹ́rin, nítorínáà a ńgbé ìyẹn bíi kékeré díẹ̀ ninu ipá-atini kan ní Èmi rò,'' ni Jordan Spieth sọ bí ó tì rìn jáde lọ fún ọjọ́ náà.

rows.source: Europe have the advantage, of course, four points ahead with twelve more in play.
rows.output: Europe ni ànfàní, dajudaju, awọn aaye mẹrin ni iwaju pẹlu mejila diẹ sii ni ere.
rows.reference: Ilẹ̀ Yuroopu ní àǹfààní náà, àní bí a ti ńretí, àwọn kókó mẹ́rin níwájú pẹ̀lú méjìlà díẹ̀ síi ninu ayò náà.

rows.source: The Americans, as Spieth says, feel they have a little wind in their sails though and they have plenty to be encouraged by, not least the form of Spieth and Justin Thomas who played together all day and each boast three points from four.
rows.output: Àwọn Amẹ́ríkà, gẹ́gẹ́ bí Spieth ṣe sọ, ńrí pé wọ́n ní ìjì kan nínú àwọn ẹ̀rọ wọn, wọ́n sì ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ohun láti fún wọn ní ìdánilójú, lára rẹ̀ ni irú eré ti Spieth àti Justin Thomas tí wọ́n ṣeré papọ̀ ní gbogbo ọjọ́ àti pé ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan wọn ní àwọn àmì mẹ́ta láti mẹ́rin.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọmọ ilẹ̀ Amẹrika, gẹ́gẹ́bí Spieth ti ńsọ, ròpé wọ́n ní afẹ́fẹ̵́ kékeré kan ninu àwọn ìtukọ wọn botilẹjẹ tí wọ́n sì ní ọ̀pọ̀ láti mú kí orí wọn yá nípa rẹ̀, tíkìí ṣe kékeré jùlọ bí irúfẹ́ ti Spieth àti Justin Thomas tí wọ́n gbá ayò papọ̀ ní gbogbo ọjọ́ tí ìkọ̀ọ̀kan wọn sì leè fi àwọn kókó mẹ́ta láti inú mẹ́rin.

rows.source: Spieth has been lethal from tee to green and is leading by example.
rows.output: Spieth ti jẹ́ alágbára láti ibi ìpàdé sí ibi tí ó ńdúró, ó sì ń darí nípa àpẹẹrẹ.
rows.reference: Spieth ti ńjẹ́ olóró láti ìhà tójìnnà sí afẹ́fẹ́ síbi ewéko tútù tí o sì ńsíwájú nípa àpẹẹrẹ.

rows.source: Those guttural screams of celebration got louder as his round went on, sinking a crucial putt to take match four all-square when he and Thomas had been two down after two.
rows.output: Àwọn ìkésíni èémí tí ó ńdún bí ìdùnnú pọ̀ sí i bí ìrù rẹ̀ ṣe ńlọ, ó sọ ọ̀pá pàtàkì kan láti mú eré náà dúró ní ìdá mẹ́rin-mẹ́rin nígbà tí ó àti Thomas ti jẹ́ méjì lẹ́yìn méjì.
rows.reference: Àwọn igbe ìkọ̀ǹkọ̀ ti àjọyọ̀ di aláriwo púpọ̀ síi bí ìpín àkókò tirẹ̀ ti ńlọ, tí ó sì gbá ayò tóṣe pàtàkì kan sínú ihò láti gba ìdíje ìkẹrin ní gbogbo igun mẹ́rẹ̀ẹ̀rin nigbati òun àti Thomas ti fi méjì wà nílẹ̀ lẹ́yìn méjì.

rows.source: His putt that won them the match on 15 was met with a similar scream, the sort that tells you he believes that the American team is not out of this.
rows.output: Ìfọwọ́kansí rẹ̀ tí ó jẹ́ kí wọ́n ṣẹ́gun eré náà ní 15 jẹ́ ìkésíni kan, irú èyí tí ó sọ fún ọ pé ẹgbẹ́ Amẹ́ríkà kò jáde nínú èyí.
rows.reference: Ayó rẹ̀ tógbá láti orí koríko eyiti ó borí ìdíje náà fún wọn níwọn pàdé pẹ̀lú igbe tójọra kan náà, irú eyiti ó nsọ fún ọ pé ó gbàgbọ́ wipe ikọ̀ ilẹ̀ Amẹrika kò tíì jáde kúró ninu èyí.

rows.source: "You've really just got to dig deep and worry about your own match," Spieth said.
rows.output: "O ti gbọdọ lọ jinlẹ̀ kí o sì máa banújẹ́ nípa eré rẹ̀," ni Spieth wí.
rows.reference: Spieth sọpe ''O níláti gbẹ́ ilẹ̀ jìn gidigidi nítòótọ́ kí ò maá ṣàníyàn nípa ìdíje tìrẹ̀''.

rows.source: It is all each of these players has left now.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ gbogbo ohun tí àwọn eléré yìí ní lọ́wọ́ báyìí.
rows.reference: Ohun ni gbogbo ìkọ̀ọ̀kan nínú àwọn agbábọ́ọ̀lù  gọ́ọ̀fù wọ̀nyẹn ti fi sílẹ̀ báyìí.

rows.source: 18 holes to make a mark.
rows.output: Àwọn ihò 18 láti fi àmì kan sílẹ̀.
rows.reference: Àwọn ihò méjìdínlógun láti ṣẹ̀dá máàkì kan.

rows.source: The only players with more points than Spieth and Thomas over the past two days are Francesco Molinari and Tommy Fleetwood, the indisputable story of the Ryder Cup.
rows.output: Àwọn eléré kan ṣoṣo tí wọ́n ní àwọn àmì-èrí ju Spieth àti Thomas lọ ní àwọn ọjọ méjì tó kọjá ni Francesco Molinari àti Tommy Fleetwood, ìtàn tí kò l'éwu ti Ryder Cup.
rows.reference: ̀Àwọn agbá̀ gọ́ọ̀fù kan ṣoṣo tóní àwọn kókó púpọ̀ ju Spieth àti Thomas lọ láàrin àwọn ọjọ́ méjì tókọjá ni Francesco Molinari à̵ti Tommy Fleetwood, ìtàn aláìṣeéjàníyàn ti Ìfe-ẹ̀yẹ́ Ryder náà.

rows.source: Europe's odd but adorable couple are four from four and can do no wrong.
rows.output: Ẹ̀dá tó ńpè ní Europe jẹ́ ọ̀kan lára àwọn tó ńpè ní Europe, wọ́n sì jẹ́ ọ̀kan lára àwọn tó ńpè ní Europe.
rows.reference: Àwọn ìbejì aláìṣeéṣàlàyé ṣùgbọ́n táyé ńfẹ́ ti ilẹ̀ Yuroopu jẹ́ mẹ́rin láti inú mẹ́rin tí wọn kòsí leè ṣe ohun tí kòtọ́ kankan.

rows.source: "Moliwood" were the only pair not to shoot a bogey on Saturday afternoon, but they also avoided bogeys on Saturday morning, Friday afternoon and the back nine on Friday morning.
rows.output: "Moliwood" ni awọn tọkọtaya nikan ti ko ṣe birdie ni ọsan ọjọ Satidee, ṣugbọn wọn tun yago fun birdies ni ọsan ọjọ Satidee, ọsan ọjọ Jimọ, ati awọnmeji lẹhin ọjọ Jimọ.
rows.reference: "Moliwood'' nìkan ni àwọn méjì tíwọn kògbá ayò ọlọ́wọ́kan lórí àkójọpọ̀ àwọn ayò fún ihò lọ́ọ̀sán ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n yàgò fún àwọn ayò ọlọ́wọ́kan bẹ́ẹ̀ ní òwúrọ̀ ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta, ọ̀sán ọjọ́ Ẹtì àti lẹ́yìn aago mẹ́ẹ̀sán òwúrọ̀ ọjọ́ Ẹtì.

rows.source: That run, and the way their energy seems to flow both to and from this boisterous crowd cements that they are the players to beat on Sunday, and there would be no more popular player to seal a potential European victory as the sun sets over Le Golf National than Fleetwood or Molinari.
rows.output: Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ yẹn, àti bí agbára wọn ṣe ń ṣàn sí àti láti inú àwọn ènìyàn tó ń ṣe eré yìí, jẹ́ kí wọ́n jẹ́ àwọn eléré tó yẹ kí wọ́n jẹ́ olùborí ní ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta, àti pé kò sí eléré tó gbajúmọ̀ jù lọ láti parí ìborí Yúróòpù kan bí oorun ti ń wọ́ Le Golf National ju Fleetwood tàbí Molinari lọ.
rows.reference: Aré sísá yẹn, àti ọ̀nà náà tódàbí pé agbára wọn  ńsàn lọ́sì àti láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn èrò aláriwo tíwọn kòsì kórawọn níìjánu yìí ńmú àyà àwọn agbábọ́ọ̀lù gọ́ọ̀fù náà le wipe àwọn ni aláyò láti lù lọ́jọ́ Àìkú, àtipé kòní sí agbábọ́ọ̀lù gọ́ọ̀fù tó gbajúmọ kankan mọ́ láti fi èdìdì kan di ìsẹ́gun ti ilẹ Yuroopu kan tóṣeé ṣe náà bí òòrùn ti ńwọ̀ lórí Le Golf National ju Fleetwood tàbí Molinari lọ.

rows.source: Preferably both simultaneously on different holes.
rows.output: Lára rẹ̀ ni kí wọ́n ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé ṣeé �
rows.reference: Àní pẹ̀lú ìfẹ́ àtọkànwá àwọn méjèèjì lórí àwọn ihò tóyàtọ̀.

rows.source: Talk of European glory remains premature, though.
rows.output: Ìjíròrò nípa ìṣọwọ́pọ̀ ilẹ̀ Yúróòpù ṣì wà ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ọ̀rọ̀ nípa ti ògo ilẹ̀ Yuroopù sì jẹ́ eyiti kòtìí dàgbà tó síbẹ̀síbẹ̀.

rows.source: Bubba Watson and Webb Simpson made short work of Sergio Garcia, the morning's fourballs hero, when he was paired with Alex Noren.
rows.output: Bubba Watson àti Webb Simpson ṣe iṣẹ́ kékéré pẹ̀lú Sergio Garcia, olùborí ìpàdé mẹ́rin ti òwúrọ̀, nígbà tí wọ́n pín pẹ̀lú Alex Noren.
rows.reference: Bubba Watson àti Webb Simson ṣe iṣẹ́ kúkúrú nípa ti Sergio Garcia, akọni oníbọ́ọ̀lù-mẹ́rin náà, nigbati wọn fí i ṣe ẹnìkeji pẹ̀lú Alex Noren.

rows.source: A bogey and two doubles on the front nine dug the Spaniard and the Swede into a hole they never got close to climbing out of.
rows.output: Ìdàpọ̀ kan àti ìdàpọ̀ méjì lórí àwọn ọ̀nà iwájú mẹ́sàn-án mú kí ọmọ ilẹ̀ Sípéènì àti ọmọ ilẹ̀ Sweden wà nínú ihò tí wọ́n kò sì lè jáde.
rows.reference: Ayò ọlọ́wọ́kan lórí àkójọpọ̀ àwọn ayò fún ihò kan ati awọn oníbejì méji lóju mẹ́ẹ̀sán iwáju gbẹ́ ọmọ ilẹ̀ Sipeeni náà àti ọmọ ilẹ̀ Siwidin náà sínú ihò kan tí wọn kò fígbà kankan súnmọ́ rí láti leè jadé kuro ninu rẹ̀.

rows.source: On Sunday, though, there is nobody to help you out of your hole.
rows.output: Ní ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta, kòsí ẹni tí yóò ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́ láti jáde kúrò nínú ihò rẹ.
rows.reference: Lọ́jọ́ Àìku, botiwukori, kòsí ẹnikan láti ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́ jáde kúrò ninu ihò rẹ.

rows.source: The fourballs and foursomes are so fascinating to watch up close because of the interactions between pairings, the advice they give, the advice they don't and the way that a strategy can change in an instant.
rows.output: Àwọn ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ mẹ́rin àti ìdá mẹ́rin jẹ́ ohun ìdánilójú láti wòó nítòsí nítorí àwọn ìbáṣepọ̀ láàárín àwọn ìdá, ìgbaninímọ̀ràn tí wọ́n fún, ìgbaninímọ̀ràn tí wọ́n kò fún, àti bí ìlànà kan ṣe lè yí padà ní ìṣẹ́jú kan.
rows.reference: Àwọn bọ́ọ̀lu-mẹ́rin àti àwọn onímẹ́rin kan niwọ́n ńwúni lórí gidi láti súnmọ́ fún wíwò nitori àwọn ìbáṣepọ̀ tówà láàrin àwọn oníbejì, ìmọ̀ràn tíwọn fúnni, ìmọ̀ràn tíwọn kò fúnni àti ọ̀nà náà tí ọgbọ́n-àtiṣeǹkan fi leè yípadà lójú-ẹ̀ṣẹ̀ kan.

rows.source: Europe have played better as a team thus far and take a significant lead into the final day but this foursomes session also showed that Team USA has the stomach for the fight that some, especially Stateside, had been doubting.
rows.output: Àwọn ará Yúróòpù ti ń ṣe eré ìdárayá dáadáa gẹ́gẹ́ bí ẹgbẹ́ kan títí di báyìí, wọ́n sì ní ìlàna pàtàkì sí ọjọ́ ìkẹyìn. Ṣùgbọ́n, ìpàdé yìí tún fi hàn pé ẹgbẹ́ USA ní ìgboyà láti bá a jà, èyí tí àwọn kan, pàápàá ní ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà, ti ń ṣiyèméjì.
rows.reference: Ilẹ Yuroopu ti gbá ayò tódàra ju gẹ́gẹ́bí ikọ̀ kan títí dé ìhín tí wọn sì tígba ìléwájú pàtàkí wọnú ọjọ́ tógbẹ̀yìn náà ṣùgbọn sáà onímẹ́rin yìí pẹ̀lú fihàn wipe Ìkọ Orilẹ-ede USA ní ikùn fún ìjà náà tí àwọn kan, papàá jùlọ Apá-ti-Orilẹ-ede náà, ti ńsiyèméjì.

rows.source: Europe take 10-6 lead into Ryder Cup final day
rows.output: Yúróòpù gba 10-6 ní ìdá kejì Ryder Cup.
rows.reference: Ilẹ̀ Yuroopu gba ìléwájú 10-6 wọnú ọjọ́ àṣèkágbá Ife-ẹ̀yẹ Ryder.

rows.source: Europe will take a healthy advantage into the final day of the Ryder Cup after emerging from Saturday's fourballs and foursomes matches with a 10-6 lead over the United States.
rows.output: Yúróòpù yóò lo àǹfààní ìlera sí ọjọ́ ìkẹyìn ìdíje Ryder Cup lẹ́yìn tí ó ti jáde ní ìdáje mẹ́rin àti ìdáje mẹ́rin ní ọjọ́ Saturday pẹ̀lú ìdáje 10-6 lórí Orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà.
rows.reference: Ilẹ̀ Yuroopu yóò mú ànfààni alálàáfíà kan wọnú ọjọ́ àṣèkágbá ti Ife-ẹ̀yẹ Ryder náà lẹ́yìn tí yọrí jàde kúrò ninu àwọn ìdíje oníbọ́ọ̀lù-mẹ́rin àti àwọn onímẹrin ti ọjọ Àbámẹ́ta pẹ̀lú ìléwájú 10-6 lórí orilẹ-ede United States náà.

rows.source: Inspired duo Tommy Fleetwood and Francesco Molinari led the charge with two victories over a struggling Tiger Woods to take their tally so far at Le Golf National to four points.
rows.output: Ìmísí méjì, Tommy Fleetwood àti Francesco Molinari, mú kí wọ́n lọ́wọ́ nínú ìpèníjà náà pẹ̀lú�i méjì tí wọ́n ṣẹ́gun tó sì mú kí wọ́n ní àmì mẹ́rin ní Le Golf National.
rows.reference: Àwọn oní-ìmísí méjì Tommy Fleetwood àti Francesco Molinari ni o darí ìdojúkọ náà pẹ̀lú àwọn ìṣẹ́gun méji lórí Tiger Woods tó ńlàkàkà kan láti mú iye ayò tíwọn jẹ́ jìnnà ní Le Golf National dé àwọn kókó mẹ̵́rin.

rows.source: Thomas Bjorn's European side, bidding to retain the trophy they lost at Hazeltine two years ago, dominated a misfiring American side in the morning fourballs, taking the series 3-1.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ Yúróòpù Thomas Bjorn, tí ń fẹ́ láti pa àmì ẹ̀yẹ tí wọ́n pàdánù ní Hazeltine ní ọdún méjì sẹ́yìn, ṣàkóso ẹgbẹ́ Amẹ́ríkà tí ó ń tiraka ní àwọn ìpàpà mẹ́rin òwúrọ̀, tí ó mú kí àwọn àmì ẹ̀yà 3-1.
rows.reference: Ikọ̀ ilẹ̀ Yuroopu ti Thomas Bjorn, tó ńlépa láti tún di ife-ẹyẹ̀ tí wọ́n pàdánù ní Hazeltine lọ́dún méjì tókọjá náà mu, jẹ́ gàba lé ikọ̀ ti ilẹ̀ Amẹrika kan eyiti ó ńsì ìbọn yìn ní oníbọ́ọ̀lù-mẹ́rin ti òwúrọ̀, tó sì gba ṣíṣẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé náà ni 3-1.

rows.source: The U.S. offered more resistance in the foursomes, winning two matches, but they could not eat into the deficit.
rows.output: Àwọn ará Amẹ́ríkà jẹ́ kí ìdàrúdàpọ̀ wọ́n pọ̀ sí i nínú àwọn ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ mẹ́rin, wọ́n sì ṣẹ́gun àwọn eré-ìje méjì, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n kò lè dín ìdààmú náà kù.
rows.reference: Orilẹ-ede U.S. náà fún wọn látakò díẹ̀ síi ninu àwọn onímẹ́rin náà, tíwọ́n sì borí ninu àwọn ìdíje méjì, ṣùgbọ́n wọn kò leè jẹun wọnú gbèsè náà.

rows.source: Jim Furyk's side need eight points from Sunday's 12 singles matches to retain the trophy.
rows.output: Ìàpá Jim Furyk nílò àwọn àmì mẹ́jọ láti inú àwọn eré ìdárayá ọgọ́rùn-ún méjìlá tí wọ́n ń ṣe ní ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta láti pa kí wọ́n tọ́jú àmì ẹ̀yẹ náà.
rows.reference: Ikọ̀ ti Jim Furyk nílò àwọn kókó mẹ́jọ láti inú àwọn ìdíje ẹlẹ́ẹyọkan méjìla ti ọjọ́ Àìkú láti leè tún gba ife-ẹ̀yẹ náà.

rows.source: Fleetwood is the first European rookie to win four points in a row while he and Molinari, dubbed "Molliwood" after a sensational weekend are only the second pair to win four points from their opening four matches in Ryder Cup history.
rows.output: Fleetwood ni akọkọ ti o wa lati Yuroopu ti o gba awọn aaye mẹrin ni ọna kan lakoko ti o ati Molinari, ti a pe ni "Molliwood" lẹhin ipade ipari ipari ipari, jẹ awọn meji nikan ti o gba awọn aaye mẹrin lati ibẹrẹ mẹrin ninu itan-akọọlẹ Ryder Cup.
rows.reference: Fleetwood ni ọmọ ilẹ̀ Yuroopu àkọ́kọ́ náà tójẹ́ ọ̀dọ́ tíkòní ìrírí láti gba àwọn kókó mẹ́rin léra-léra láìdúró nigbati òun ati Molinari tíwọ́n sọ lórúkọ ''Molliwood'' lẹ́yìn òpin-ọ̀sẹ̀ tópè fún àkíyèsí kan jẹ́ oníbejì ìkejì náà láti gba àwọn kókó mẹ́rin láti inú àwọn ìdíje àfisíde mẹ́rin ninu ìtan Ife-ẹ̀yẹ Ryder.

rows.source: Having crushed Woods and Patrick Reed in the fourballs they then gelled superbly to beat a deflated Woods and American rookie Bryson Dechambeau by an even more emphatic 5&4.
rows.output: Ti Woods ti fọ ati Patrick Reed ni awọn ere meji ti o duro, wọn si ṣe daradara lati bori Woods ti o ti fọ ati Bryson Dechambeau ti Amẹrika ti o jẹ tuntun nipasẹ 5&4.
rows.reference: Léyìn tíwọ́n ti tẹ Woods àti Patrick Reed lórí mọ́lẹ̀ ninu àwọn oníbọ́ọ̀lù-mẹ́rin wọn búgbàmu  pẹ̀lú agbára láti borí Woods tí táyà ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀ tijò àti ọ̀dọ́ ilẹ̀ Amẹrika tíkòni ìrírí Bryson Dechambeau nípaṣẹ̀ 5 àti 4 tórinlẹ̀ díẹ̀ síi.

rows.source: Woods, who dragged himself through two matches on Saturday, showed occasional bursts of brilliance but he has now lost 19 of his 29 matches in fourballs and foursomes and seven in a row.
rows.output: Woods, ẹni tí ó ń tiraka láti lọ́wọ́ nínú àwọn eré méjì ní ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta, fi hàn nígbàmíì pé ó ní ìmọ̀lára rere, ṣùgbọ́n ó ti pàdánù àwọn eré 19 nínú 29 rẹ̀ nínú ìdá mẹ́rin àti ìdá méjì, àti 7 ní ìlà-oorùn.
rows.reference: Woods, ẹnití ó wọ́ ara rẹ̀ kọjà ninu gbogbo àwọn ìdíje méji lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta, fi àwọn ìbújade iṣẹ́ ọpọlọ hàn lẹ́ẹ̀kọ̀kan ṣùgbọ́n nísinsìnyí ó ti pàdánù mọ́kàndínlógún ninu àwọn ìdíje mọ́kàndínlọ́gbọ̀n rẹ̀ ninu àwọn oníbọ́ọ̀lù-mẹ́rin àti àwọn onímẹ́rin àti méje láìdúró.

rows.source: Justin Rose, rested for the morning fourballs, returned to partner Henrik Stenson in the foursomes to a 2&1 defeat of Dustin Johnson and Brooks Koepka - ranked one and three in the world.
rows.output: Justin Rose, ti o sinmi fun awọn idaji-ọjọ mẹ́rin, pada pẹlu Henrik Stenson ninu awọn idaji-ọjọ meji si ijatil 2&1 ti Dustin Johnson ati Brooks Koepka - ti o wa ni ipo ọkan ati mẹta ni agbaye.
rows.reference: Justin Rose, sinmi fún àwọn oníbọ́ọ̀lù-mẹ́rin òwúrọ̀ náà, ó padà sọ́dọ̀ akẹgbẹ́ Henrik Stenson ninu àwọn onímẹ́rin náà sí ìjákulẹ̀ 2 àti 1 ti Dustin Johnson àti Brooks Koepka - àwọn tówànípò ìkínni àti ìkẹta ni àgbáyé.

rows.source: Europe did not have it al their own way though on a pleasant, breezy day south west of Paris.
rows.output: Kò sí ìdánilójú pé Yúróòpù ní gbogbo rẹ̀ fún ara rẹ̀, ní ọjọ́ kan tí o dára, tí o ní ìrì, ní gúúsù ìwọ̀ oòrùn Paris.
rows.reference: Ilẹ̀ Yuroopu kòrí gbogbo rẹ̀ gbà ní ọ̀nà wọn bottiwukori lọ̀jọ̀ dídún, alátẹ́gùn kan ní ìwọ-oòrùn gúúsù ti ìlú Paris.

rows.source: Three-times major winner Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas set the benchmark for the Americans with two points on Saturday.
rows.output: Ẹẹta-àkópọ̀ olùborí Jordan Spieth àti Justin Thomas ṣètò ìwọ̀n fún àwọn Amẹ́ríkà pẹ̀lú àwọn àmì méjì ní ọjọ́ Satide.
rows.reference: Akọni gbòógì ẹlẹ́ẹ̀mẹ́ta ọ̀tọ̀tọ̀ Jordan Spieth àti JustinnThomas ṣàgbékalẹ̀ gbèdéke máàki fún àwọn ọmọ ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà pẹ̀lú kókó méjì lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta.

rows.source: They earned a gritty 2&1 win over Spain's Jon Rahm and Ian Poulter in the fourballs and returned later to beat Poulter and Rory McIlroy 4&3 in the foursomes having lost the opening two holes.
rows.output: Wọ́n gba ìborí 2&1 kan lórí ilẹ̀ Sípéènì Jon Rahm àti Ian Poulter nínú àwọn ìpàdé mẹ́rin, wọ́n sì padà lẹ́yìn náà láti ṣẹ́gun Poulter àti Rory McIlroy 4&3 nínú àwọn ìpàdé mẹ́rin, lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n ti pàdánù àwọn ihò méjì àkọ́kọ́.
rows.reference: Wọ́n gba ìborí 2 àti 1 tíkòkúnná kan lóri Jon Rahm ọmọ ilẹ̀ Sipeeni àtinIan Poulter ninu àwọn oníbọ́ọ̀lù-mẹ́rin tíwọ́n sì padà lẹ́yìn nàà láti lu Poulter àti RoryMcllroy ní 4 àti 3 ninu àwọn onímẹ́rin lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n pàdánù àwọn ihò àfisíde méjì náà.

rows.source: Only twice in Ryder Cup history has a team come back from a four-point deficit going into the singles, although as holders Furyk's side need only draw to retain the trophy.
rows.output: Láìpẹ́ yìí, ẹgbẹ́ kan ti padà láti inú àdéhùn mẹ́rin (4) ní ìtàn Ryder Cup, bíótilẹ̀jẹ́pé gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn olùdíje, ẹ̀gbẹ́ Furyk nílò láti fa ìdánilójú kan láti tọ́jú àmì ẹ̀yẹ náà.
rows.reference: Lẹ́ẹ̀mejì nìkan ninu ìtàn Ife-ẹ̀yẹ Ryder ni ikọ̀ kan ti padà wá láti inu gbèsè oníkókó-mẹ́rin tó ńwọnú àwọn ẹlẹ́ẹyọ̀kan, botilẹjẹpe àwọn tómú ife-ẹ̀yẹ dáni nílò láti ta ọ̀mì láti tún di ife-ẹyẹ̀ náà mú.

rows.source: After being second-best for two days, however, a Sunday counter-attack looks as though it will be beyond them.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n ti jẹ́ ẹ̀kejì fún ọjọ méjì, ó sì dàbí pé ìdàrúdàpọ̀ ọjọ́ Àarọ̀ yóò kọjá lọ.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn jíjẹ́ ẹnití ó dára júlọ kejì fún àwọn ọjọ́ méjì, botiwukori, ìdáhùnsí-ikọlù kan tí ọjọ́ Àìkú dàbí wipe yóò fẹ́rẹ̀ tayọ wọn.

rows.source: North Korea says 'no way' will disarm unilaterally without trust
rows.output: Koria Aria sọ pé 'Kòsí Ọ̀nà' yóò yọ́ kúrò ní àdáni láì fi ìdánilójú hàn.
rows.reference: Àríwá Kòríà sọpé 'kòsí ọ̀nà' ti òun yóò fi kó ohun ìjà ogun dánù ní àdánìkànṣe láìsí ìgbẹkẹlé

rows.source: North Korea's foreign minister told the United Nations on Saturday continued sanctions were deepening its mistrust in the United States and there was no way the country would give up its nuclear weapons unilaterally under such circumstances.
rows.output: Minisita fun Oro Ajeji ti North Korea sọ fun United Nations ni ọjọ Satidee pe awọn ihamọ ti o tẹsiwaju n mu ki o ni ìdààmú si Amẹrika ati pe ko si ọna ti orilẹ-ede naa yoo fi awọn ohun ija iparun rẹ silẹ ni ọkan labẹ iru awọn ipo bẹ.
rows.reference: Aláàkóso ọ̀rọ̀ ilẹ̀ òkèèrè ti orilẹ-ede Àrìwá Kòríà Ri Yong sọ lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ̵́ta fún Àjọ Ìṣọ̀kan Àgbáyé pé àwọn ìjẹniníyà tó ńtẹ̵̀síwájú ńmú àìní-ìgbẹkẹ̀lé ninu orilẹ-ede United States jinlẹ̀ síi àtipé kòsí ọ̀nà tí orilẹ-ede náà yóò fi kó àwọn ohun ìjà àdó olóro rẹ̀ dánù ní àdánìkànṣe lábẹ́ irú àwọn ohun tóyí ọ̀rọ̀ náà ká bẹ́ẹ̀.

rows.source: Ri Yong Ho told the world body's annual General Assembly that North Korea had taken "significant goodwill measures" in the past year, such as stopping nuclear and missiles tests, dismantling the nuclear test site, and pledging not to proliferate nuclear weapons and nuclear technology.
rows.output: Ri Yong Ho sọ fun àjọ àgbáyé pé North Korea ti ṣe “ọnà ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ pàtàkì” ní ọdún tó kọjá, bíi dídúró fún àwọn ìdánwò ohun èlò àjèjì àti àwọn ìdánimọ̀, yíyọ́ ilé ìdánimọ̀ ohun èlò àjèjì, àti ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ pé kò ní tàáǹá àwọn ohun èlò àjèjì àti ìmọ̀ ẹ̀rọ àjèjì.
rows.reference: Ri Yong Ho sọ fún àjọ àgbáyé níbi Ìpéjọpọ̀ Gbogbogbòò ti Àjọ Ìṣọ̀kan Àgbáyé náà wipe Àríwá Kòríà ti gbé ''àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ ìfẹ́ inú rere tóṣe pàtàkì'' ní ọdún tókọjá, bíi dídá àwọn ìdánwò àdó olóró àti àwọn àdó abúgbàmu tóńfòlókè dúró, ṣíṣe àtúpalẹ̀ ibi ìdánwò àdó olóró, àti jíjẹ́ ẹjẹ́ láti máṣe ṣọ àwọn àdó olóró àti ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ àdó olóró di púpọ̀ yanturu.

rows.source: "However, we do not see any corresponding response from the U.S.," he said.
rows.output: "Àmọ́sá, a kò rí ìdáhùn kankan láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn ará Amẹ́ríkà," ni ó sọ.
rows.reference: O ni ''Botiwukori, a kòrí ìdáhùn tóbáramu èyíkeyìí láti ọ̀dọ̀ orilẹ-ede U.S.,'' .

rows.source: "Without any trust in the U.S. there will be no confidence in our national security and under such circumstances there is no way we will unilaterally disarm ourselves first."
rows.output: "Láìsí ìdánilójú kankan nínú U.S., kòsí ìdánilójú nínú ààbò orílẹ̀-èdè wa, àti lábẹ́ irú àwọn ipò bẹ́ẹ̀, kòsí ọ̀nà tí a lè fọwọ́ sí ìfipá sílẹ̀ fún ara wa ní àkọ́kọ́."
rows.reference: ''Láìsí ìgbẹkẹ̀lé èyíkéyìí ninu orilẹ-ede U.S. kòní sí ìgbọkànlé ninu ààbò orilẹ-ede wa àtipé lábẹ́ irú àwọn àyíká bẹ́ẹ̀ kòsí ọ̀nà  tí a ó fi kọ́kọ́ kó ohun ìjà ogun ara wa dánù ní àdánìkànṣe.''

rows.source: While Ri reprised familiar North Korean complaints about Washington's resistance to a "phased" approach to denuclearization under which North Korea would be rewarded as it took gradual steps, his statement appeared significant in that it did not reject unilateral denuclearization out of hand as Pyongyang has done in the past.
rows.output: Lakoko ti Ri tun ṣe awọn ẹdun North Korea ti o mọ nigbagbogbo nipa resistance Washington si ọna “ipin” si iparun ti o wa ni isalẹ ti North Korea yoo gba ẹbun bi o ti ṣe awọn igbesẹ ti o lọra, ọ̀rọ rẹ han pe o ṣe pataki nitori pe ko kọ iparun ti o wa ni ọkan rẹ ni kiakia bi Pyongyang ti ṣe tẹlẹ.
rows.reference: Nigbati Ri tún tẹnumọ́ àwọn ẹ̀dùn ọkàn ti Àríwa Kòríà eyiti gbogbo ayé mọ̀ nípa àtakò Washington sí ìgbéṣẹ̀ ''onípele'' sí kíkó àwọn àdò olóró dànù lábẹ́ eyiti wọn ti fún Àríwá Kòríà lérè bí ó báti ńgbé àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ onípẹ̀lẹ̀pẹlẹ̀, gbólóhùn rẹ̀ farahàn bí eyito ṣe pàtàkì nitoripe kò kọ kíkó àwọn ohun ìjà àdó olóro dànù ní àdánìkànṣe kuro ní ọwọ́ bí Pyongyang tiṣe se nígbà kan sẹyìn.

rows.source: Ri referred to a joint statement issued by Kim Jong Un and Donald Trump at a first ever summit between a serving U.S. president and a North Korean leader in Singapore on June 12, when Kim pledged to work toward "denuclearization of the Korean peninsula" while Trump promised guarantees of North Korea's security.
rows.output: Ri tọ́ka sí ọ̀rọ̀ tí a pín sílẹ̀ tí Kim Jong Un àti Donald Trump ṣe ní ìpàdé àkọ́kọ́ láàárín ààrẹ orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà tó ń ṣiṣẹ́ lọ́wọ́ àti olórí ilẹ̀ Koria Arewò ní Singapore ní ọjọ́ kẹrìnlá oṣù kẹfa, nígbà tí Kim ṣe ìlérí láti ṣiṣẹ́ sí “ìdàrúdàpọ̀ ti ilẹ̀ Koria” nígbà tí Trump ṣe ìlérí láti fún Koria Arewò ní ààbò.
rows.reference: Ri tọ́kasí gbólóhùn alájọṣe kan ti Kim Jong Un àti Donald Trump jọ gbéjáde níbi ìpàdé àkọ́kọ́ láàrin ààrẹ orilẹ-ede U.S. tówànípò kan àti olórí Àríwá Kòríà kan ní Singapore lọ́jọ́ kejìlá oṣù Òkúdu, nigbati Kim ṣe ìlérí láti ṣiṣẹ́ fún ''kíkó àwọn ohun ìjà olóró kuro ni erékùsù Kòríà'' nigbati ṣe ìlérí àwọn ìdánilójú fún ààbò Àríwá Kòríà.

rows.source: North Korea has been seeking a formal end to the 1950-53 Korea War, but the United States has said Pyongyang must give up its nuclear weapons first.
rows.output: Nípati ti orílẹ̀-èdè Gúúsù Koria ti ń wá ìparẹ́ ti ogun Koria (1950-1953), ṣùgbọ́n àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà ti sọ pé Pyongyang gbọ́dọ̀ fi àwọn ohun ìjà rẹ̀ sílẹ̀ kí ó tó ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀.
rows.reference: Àríwá Kòríà ti ńwá òpin alákọsílẹ̀ kan sí Ogun Kòríà tọdún 1950-53, ṣùgbọn orilẹ-ede United Ststes ti sọpé Pyongyang gbọ́dọ̀ kọ́kọ́ ju àwọn ohun ìjà àdó olóró rẹ̀ sílẹ̀.

rows.source: Washington has also resisted calls to relax tough international sanctions on North Korea.
rows.output: Ààrẹ Washington náà ti tako àwọn ìpè láti tú àwọn ìjìyà líle tí wọ́n fi lé lórí orílẹ̀-èdè Koria.
rows.reference: Washington tún ti tako àwọn ìpè láti dẹ̀ ẹ́ díẹ̀ nípa àwọn ìfìyàjẹni tàgbáyé líle lórí Àríwa Kòríà.

rows.source: "The U.S. insists on the "denuclearization-first" and increases the level of pressure by sanctions to achieve their purpose in a coercive manner, and even objecting to the "declaration of the end of war,"" Ri said.
rows.output: "U.S. n tẹnumọ si pe "denuclearization-first" ati pe wọn n pọ si ipele titẹ nipasẹ awọn ihamọ lati ṣaṣeyọri idi wọn ni ọna iparun, ati paapaa n tako "ikede opin ogun,"" Ri sọ.
rows.reference: ''Orilẹ-ede U.S. ńtakú lórí ''kíkọ́kọ́ kó àwọn ohun ìjà àdó olóró dànù'' náà tí ó sì ńmu ipele ìninilára nípa àwọn ìfìyàjẹni náà pọ̀síi láti leè gba èrèdí wọn ní ọ̀nà ìfipámúni kan, tósì ńtako ''ìkede ti òpin ogun náà,'''' bii Ri ṣe sọ.

rows.source: "The perception that sanctions can bring us on our knees is a pipe dream of the people who are ignorant about us.
rows.output: "Ìròyìn pé ìjìyà lè mú wa wá sí ẹṣẹ̀ ni àlá buburú ti àwọn ènìyàn tí kò mọ̀ nípa wa.
rows.reference: ''Ojú-ìwòye náà wipe àwọn ìjẹniníyà leè mú wa wá sórí àwọn orúnkún wa jẹ́ àlá kan tí kò leè ṣẹ ti àwọn eniyan tíwọ́n jẹ́ aláìmọ̀kan nípa wa.

rows.source: But the problem is that the continued sanctions are deepening our mistrust."
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n ìṣòro náà ni pé àwọn ìjìyà tí ó ńtẹ̀síwájú ńmú ìdààmú ìfọkàntán wá."
rows.reference: ''Ṣùgbọn ìṣòro náà nipé àwọn ìjẹniníyà tó ńtẹ̵̀síwájú ńmú àìní-ìgbẹkẹ̀lé wa jinlẹ̀.''

rows.source: Ri made no mention of plans for a second summit between Kim and Trump that the U.S. leader highlighted at the United Nations earlier in the week.
rows.output: Ri ko sọ nipa awọn ero fun ipade keji laarin Kim ati Trump ti olu�eto Amẹrika tẹnuba ni Ajo Agbaye ni kutukutu ọsẹ naa.
rows.reference: Ri kò sọ ohun kankan nípa àwọn ètò fún ìpàdé ẹlẹ́ẹ̀keji kan láàrin Kim àti Trump eyiti olórí orilẹ-ede U.S. tẹnumọ́ níbi Àjọ Ìṣọ̀kan Àwọn Orilẹ-ede Àgbáyé níbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọ̀sẹ̀ náà.

rows.source: The minister instead highlighted three meetings between Kim and South Korean leader Moon Jae-in in the past five months and added: "If the party to this issue of denuclearization were South Korea and not the U.S., the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula would not have come to such a deadlock."
rows.output: Minisita naa dipo ṣe afihan awọn ipade mẹta laarin Kim ati oludari South Korea Moon Jae-in ni o�u marun to kọja ati fi kun: “Ti ẹgbẹ ti ọran ti denuclearization ba jẹ South Korea ati kii ṣe Amẹrika, denuclearization ti Korean Peninsula yoo ko ti de opin bii eyi.”
rows.reference: Aláàkóso náà dípò tẹnumọ́ àwọn ìpàdé mẹ́ta láàrin Kim àti olóri Gúúsù Kòríà Moon Jae-in láàrin oṣù máàrún tókọjá tí ó sì fi kún uń pé: Bí ẹniti ọ̀rọ̀ kíkó àwọn ohun ìjà olóró dànù yìí kàn bájẹ̵́ Gúúsù Kòríà tí kìí ṣe orilẹ-ede U.S., ọ̀rọ̀ kíkó àwọn ohun ìjà olóró dànù náà kì bátí dúró sójú kan.

rows.source: Even so, the tone of Ri's speech was dramatically different from last year, when he told the U.N. General Assembly that targeting the U.S. mainland with North Korea's rockets was inevitable after "Mr Evil President" Trump called Kim a "rocket man" on a suicide mission.
rows.output: Àní bẹ́ẹ̀, tóńṣe ìpèse fún ìpàdé náà, ìró ọ̀rọ̀ Ri yàtọ̀ gidi ju ti ọdún tó kọjá lọ, nígbà tí ó sọ fún Ìgbìmọ̀ Gíga Jù Lọ ti U.N.
rows.reference: Àní bẹ́ẹ̀, ohun ti ọ̀rọ̀ Ri náà yàtọ̀ lọ́nà tóyanilẹ́nu sí ti ọdún tókọjá, nigbati o sọ fún U.N. Ìpéjọpọ̀ Gbogbogbòò wipe ṣíṣe àfojúsùn ori-ilẹ̀ ti orilẹ-ede U.S gan-an pẹ̀lú ẹ̀rọ̀-bí-ọfà abúgbàmù jẹ́ nǹkan tí kòṣeé yàgò fún lẹ́yìn tí ''Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Ààrẹ Búburú'' Trump pe Kim ni ''ọkùnrin ẹlẹ́ẹ̀rọ̀-bí-ọfà abúgbàmù'' tó ńlépa láti pa ara rẹ̀.

rows.source: This year at the United Nations, Trump, who last year threatened to "totally destroy" North Korea, heaped praise on Kim for his courage in taking steps to disarm, but said much work still had to be done and sanctions must remain in place until North Korea denuclearizes.
rows.output: Ní ọdún yìí ní Ìgbìmọ̀ Àwujọ Àwọn Orílẹ̀-èdè Àgbáyé, Trump, ẹni tí ó sọ ní ọdún tó kọjá pé òun yóò “parun pátápátá” Koria, ó sọ pé Kim ní ìgboyà láti gbé ìgbésẹ̀ láti yọ àwọn ohun ìjà kúrò, ṣùgbọ́n ó sọ pé iṣẹ́ púpọ̀ sì wà láti ṣe àti pé ìjìyà gbọ́dọ̀ wà títí Koria yóò fi yọ àwọn ohun ìjà kúrò.
rows.reference: Lọ́dún yìí ní Àjọ Ìṣọ̀kan Àwọn Orilẹ-ede Àgbáyé náà, Trump, ẹnití ó dúnkòokó lọ́dún tókọjá láti ''pa  Àríwá Kòríà run pátápátá'', rọ òjò oríyìn sórí Kim fún ìgboyà rẹ̀ ninu gbìgbé àwọn ìgbẹ́sẹ̀ láti kó ohun ìjà dànù, ṣùgbọ́n ó sọpé ọ̀pọ̀ iṣẹ́ sí wà láti ṣe àtipé àwọn ìfìyàjẹni gbọ̀dọ̀ wànípò wọn títí ti Àríwá Kòríà yóò fi kó àwọn ohun ìjà olóró dànù.

rows.source: On Wednesday, Trump said he did not have a time frame for this, saying "If it takes two years, three years or five months - doesn't matter."
rows.output: Ni ọjọ Wẹside, Trump sọ pe ko ni akoko kan fun eyi, o sọ pe "Ti o ba gba ọdun meji, ọdun mẹta tabi oṣu marun - ko ṣe pataki."
rows.reference: Lọ́jọ́ 'Ru, Trump sọpé òun kòní férémú àkókò fún èyí, tó sì ńsọpé ''bí ó bá gba àwọn ọdún méjì, ọdún mẹ́ta tabi oṣù máàrún - kòṣe nǹkan kan.''

rows.source: China and Russia argue that the U.N. Security Council should reward Pyongyang for steps taken.
rows.output: China àti Rọ́ṣíà ń jiyàn pé Ìgbìmọ̀ Ààbò ti U.N.
rows.reference: Orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà àti Rọsia wí àwíjàre wipe àjọ U.N. Ìgbìmọ lórí Ètò Ààbo níláti fún Pyongyang léré àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ tóti gbé.

rows.source: However, U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo told the U.N. Security Council on Thursday that: "Enforcement of Security Council sanctions must continue vigorously and without fail until we realize the fully, final, verified denuclearization."
rows.output: Báwo ló ṣe rí lára ​​àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo sọ fún U.N. Security Council ní ọjọ́ẹ̀dẹ́gbẹ́ta (Thursday) pé: “Ìmúṣẹ àwọn ìjìyà tí U.N. Ìgbìmọ̀ Ààbò gbọ́dọ̀ tẹ̀síwájú ní ìgboyà àti láìsí ìdàrú tàbí ìdàrú títí tí a ó fi rí ìdánilójú, ìdánilójú, ìdánilójú, ìdánilójú, ìdánilójú, ìdánilójú, ìdánilójú, ìdánilójú, ìdánilójú, ìdánilójú, ìdánil
rows.reference: Àmọ́sá, orilẹ-ede U.S Akọ̀wé ti Ọ̀rọ̀ Ilẹ̀ Òkèèrè Mike Pompeo sọ fún àjọ UN wipe Ìgbìmọ lórí Ètò Ààbo lọ́jọ́ 'Bọ̀ wipe: ''Fífi ipá mú àwọn ìfìyàjẹni ti Ìgbìmọ lórí Ètò Ààbo ṣẹ gbọdọ̀ tẹ̀síwájú pẹ̀lu agbára àti láìkùnà títí a ó fi dé lẹ́ẹ̀kúnrẹ́rẹ́, òpin, kíkó àwọn ohun ìjà àdó olóró dànù.

rows.source: The Security Council has unanimously boosted sanctions on North Korea since 2006 in a bid to choke off funding for Pyongyang's nuclear and ballistic missile programs.
rows.output: Ìgbìmọ̀ Ààbò ti fọwọ́ sí ìdènà tó pọ̀jù lọ lórí North Korea láti ọdún 2006 láti dènà owó fún ètò ìdàrúdàpọ̀ àti àwọn ètò ọkọ̀ ojú omi ballistic Pyongyang.
rows.reference: Ìgbìmọ lórí Ètò Ààbo náà ti fi kún àwọn ìfìyàjẹni lórí Àríwá Kòríà pẹ̀lú ìfohùnṣọ̀kan pátápátá láti ọdún 2016 ninu ìlépa láti di ọ̀fun rírí owó ná fún àwọn ètò àdó olóró àti àwọn àdó abúgbàmu tóńfòlókè ti Pyongyang.

rows.source: Pompeo met Ri on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly and said afterwards that he would visit Pyongyang again next month to prepare for a second summit.
rows.output: Pompeo pàdé Ri ni ẹ̀gbẹ́ ìpàdé Ìgbìmọ̀ Gíga Jù Lọ ti U.N. ó sì sọ lẹ́yìn náà pé òun yóò bẹ̀rù sí Pyongyang lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i ní oṣù tó ń bọ̀ láti gbaradì fún ìpàdé kejì.
rows.reference: Pompeo pàdé Ri ní àwọn ìgbá tọ́wọ́dilẹ̀ ni àjọ U.N. Ìpéjọpọ̀ Gbogbogbò tí ó sọ lẹ́yìn náà wipe òun yóò ṣàbẹ̀wò sí Pyongyang lẹ́ẹ̀kan sii lóṣù tó ńbọ láti gbaradì fún ìpàdé ẹlẹ́ẹ̀kejì kan.

rows.source: Pompeo has visited North Korea three times already this year, but his last trip did not go well.
rows.output: Pompeo ti ṣàbẹ̀wò sí North Korea ní ìgbà mẹ́ta l'ónìí, ṣùgbọ́n ìrìn-àjò rẹ̀ tó kẹ́yìn kò dára.
rows.reference: Pompeo ti ṣàbẹ̀wò sí Àríwá Kòríà lẹ́ẹ̀mẹta tẹ́lẹ̀tẹ́lẹ̀ lọ́dún yìí, ṣùgbọ́n ìrìn-àjò rẹ̵̵̀ tógbẹ̀yìn kò lọ dáradára.

rows.source: He left Pyongyang in July saying that progress had been made, only for North Korea within hours to denounce him for making "gangster-like demands."
rows.output: Ó kúrò ní Pyongyang ní July, ó sì sọ pé ìdàgbàsókè ti wà, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ará Gúúsù Koria ní wákàtí díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn ti kọ̀ láti ṣe “àwọn ìbéèrè oníwà ipá.”
rows.reference: Ó kúró ní Pyongyang lóṣ̵ù Agẹmọ wipe ìtẹ̀síwájú tíwáyé, ó kù níkan fún Àríwá Kòríà láàrin àwọn wákàtí láti kọ 'àwọn ìbéèrè bíiti-ọ̀daràn'' sílẹ̀.''

rows.source: North Korea pledged in a meeting with Moon this month to dismantle a missile site and also a nuclear complex if the United States took "corresponding measures."
rows.output: Ní ìpàdé kan pẹ̀lú Moon ní oṣù yìí, Àríwísí Koria sọ pé wọn yóò fọ́ ibi ìfiráńṣẹ́ kan àti ibi ìfiráńṣẹ́ àjèjì kan tí àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà bá gbé ìgbésẹ̀ “ìbọ̀wọ̀fọ̀.”
rows.reference: Àríwá Kòríà ṣe ìlérí ninu ìpàdé kan pẹ̀lú Moon lóṣù yìí láti ṣàtúpalẹ̀ ibi ìdánwòàwọn àdó abúgbàmu tóńfòlókè kan àti ilé ńlá fún iṣẹ́ àdó olóró kan bí orilẹ-èdè United States náà bá gbé ''àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ ìdáhùn tóbáramu.''

rows.source: He said Kim had told him the "corresponding measures" he was seeking were security guarantees Trump pledged in Singapore and moves toward normalization of relations with Washington.
rows.output: Ó sọ pé Kim ti sọ fún un pé “àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ tó báamu” tí ó ń wá ni àwọn ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ààbò tí Trump ṣe ní Singapore àti àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ sí ìmúdàgbà ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú Washington.
rows.reference: Ó sọpé Kim sọ fún òun wipe ''àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ ìdáhùn tóbáramu'' náà tí Kim ńwá jẹ́ àwọn ìdánilójú ààbò tí Trump ṣe ìlérì ní Singapore àti àwọn ìgbésẹ sójú àwọn ìbáṣepọ̀ bótiyẹ pẹ̀lú Washinhton.

rows.source: Harvard students take course in getting enough rest
rows.output: Àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ Harvard ń kọ́ nípa bí wọ́n ṣe ń sinmi dáadáa
rows.reference: Àwọn ọmọ ilé ìwé Havard kọ ẹ̀kọ́ ninu níní ìsinmi tópeye

rows.source: A new course at Harvard University this year has got all its undergraduates getting more sleep in a bid to combat the growing macho culture of studying through caffeine-fuelled 'all-nighters.'
rows.output: Ìpàdé tuntun kan ní Harvard University ní ọdún yìí ti jẹ́ kí gbogbo àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ rẹ̀ máa sùn dáadáa ní ìsapá láti dín ìṣesí àjèjì ti ẹ̀kọ́ nípa lílo kọfí tí ó ńfa 'àgọ́ òru.'
rows.reference: Ẹ̀kọ́ tuntun kan ní ilé ìwé Yunifasiti Havard lọ́dún yìí ti gba gbogbo àwọn àkẹ́kọ̀ọ́-gboyè àkọ́kọ́ rẹ̀ láti máa rí oorun sùn síi ninu ìlépa láti gbógun ti àṣà ìṣebí-ọkùnrin ti kíkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ nípaṣẹ̵̀ òògùn-bí-epo-ọkọ́ 'amunimásùn-nigbogbo-oru'.

rows.source: An academic found students at the world's number one university are often clueless when it comes to the very basics about how to look after themselves.
rows.output: Akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ kan rí àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ní ilé ẹ̀kọ́ gíga tó ga jùlọ ní ayé máa ń ṣòro nígbà tí wọ́n bá ń ṣe ìtọ́jú ara wọn.
rows.reference: Olùkọ́-àgbà kan ṣàwárí wipe àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ní yunifasiti onípò ìkínní láàgbáyé náà lọ́pọ̀ ìgbà níwọn kìí mọ ohun tóyẹ láti ṣe nigbati ó bá kan àwọn ohun ìpìlẹ̀ nípa bí wọn tiṣe leè mójútó ara wọn.

rows.source: Charles Czeisler, professor of sleep medicine at Harvard Medical School and a specialist at the Brigham and Women's Hospital, designed the course, which he believes is the first of its kind in the US.
rows.output: Charles Czeisler, olùkọ́ ẹ̀kọ́ oorun ní Ilé-ìwé Iṣé Oúnjẹ Harvard àti amoyé ní Ilé ìwòsàn Brigham àti Àwọn Obìnrin, ṣe àtúnṣe ẹ̀kọ́ náà, èyí tó gbà pé ó jẹ́ àkọ́kọ́ irú rẹ̀ ní Orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà.
rows.reference: Charles Czeisler, ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n ninu ìṣègùn oorun ní Ilé Ẹ̀kọ́ nípa Ìṣègùn ti Yunifasiti Havard àti akọ́ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ kan ní Ilé Ìwòsàn Brigham àti àwọn obìnrin, ló ṣàgbékalẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ náà, eyiti o gbàgbọ́ wipe ó jẹ́ àkọ́kọ́ irú rẹ̀ ní orilẹ-ede US.

rows.source: He was inspired to start the course after giving a talk on the impact sleep deprivation had on learning.
rows.output: Ó ní ìmísí láti bẹ̀rẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ náà lẹ́yìn tí ó ti sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ipa àìsí oorun lórí ẹ̀kọ́.
rows.reference: Ó ní ìmísí láti bẹ̀rẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ náà lẹ́yìn tí ó fún wọn ní ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ lórí ipa tí àìfójúlóoorun ńkó lórí ìkẹ́kọ̀ọ́.

rows.source: 'At the end of it one girl came up to me and said: 'Why am I only being told this now, in my senior year?'
rows.output: Ní òpin rẹ̀, ọmọbìnrin kan wá sọ fún mi pé: 'Kínni ìdí tí wọ́n fi ń sọ fún mi báyìí, ní ọdún tó kẹ́yìn?'
rows.reference: <seg id="6">'Lópin rẹ̀ ọmọbìnrin kan dìde tọ̀ mi wá tí ó sì sọpé: 'Kínni ìdí tójẹ́pé nísinsìnyí ni ẹ ńsọ èyí fún mi, nígbà tí mó ti wà ilé ẹ́kọ̀o àgbạ̀́?'

rows.source: She said no one had ever told her about the importance of sleep - which surprised me,' he told The Telegraph.
rows.output: Ó sọ pé kòsí ẹni tó sọ fún un nípa pàtàkì oorun - èyí sì yà mí lẹ́nu,' ó sọ fún The Telegraph.
rows.reference: Ó sọpé ẹnikéni kò fìgbà kankan sọ fún ohun rí nípa pàtàki oorun sísùn - eyiti ó yàmí lẹ́nu,' ó sọ fún ìwé ìròyìn The Telegraph.

rows.source: The course, rolled out for the first time this year, explains to students the essentials of how good sleep habits help academic and athletic performance, as well as improve their general wellbeing.
rows.output: Ìpàdé náà, tí a ṣe fún ìgbà àkọ́kọ́ ní ọdún yìí, ṣàlàyé fún àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ nípa àwọn ohun pàtàkì tí o wà nínú bí oorun tí ó dára ṣe ń ṣe ìrànwọ́ fún iṣẹ́ ẹ̀kọ́ àti eré-ìdárayá, àti bí o ṣe ń mú ìmúláradá wọn pọ̀ sí i.
rows.reference: Ẹ̀kọ́ náà, tíwọ́n gbé jáde fún ìgbà àkọ́kọ́ lọ́dún yìí, ńṣàlàyé fún àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ àwọn ohun kòṣeémáàní bí àwọn ìwà oorun sísùn tódára ṣe ńran ìṣeṣí ìkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ àti aré ìdárayá lọ́wọ́, àtipé ó ńjẹ́kí ìmúdárasíi bá ìgbáyé-gbádùn wọn lọ́nà gbogbo.

rows.source: Paul Barreira, professor of psychiatry at Harvard Medical School and executive director of the university's health services, said the university decided to introduce the course after finding students were seriously sleep deprived during the week.
rows.output: Paul Barreira, olùkọ́ ìmọ̀ ọpọlọ ní Ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ Ìṣègùn Harvard àti olùdarí ìṣíṣẹ́ ìlera ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ náà, sọ pé ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ náà pinnu láti ṣe ìfilọ́lẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ náà lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n rí pé àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ náà ń ṣe àṣìṣe oorun ní ọ̀sẹ̀ náà.
rows.reference: Paul Barreira, ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n nípa àisán ọpọlọ ní Ilé Ẹ̀kọ́ Ìṣègùn ti Havard àti olùdarí ti àwọn iṣẹ́ ètò ìlera ti yunifasiti náà sọpé yunifasiti náà pinnu lati ṣàfilọ́lẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ náà lẹ́yìn ìṣàwárí wipe àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ jẹ́ àwọn ti oorun ńjẹníyà láàrin ọ̀sẹ̀.

rows.source: The hour long course involves a series of interactive tasks.
rows.output: Ìdá wákàtí kan ní ìpàdé náà ní àwọn iṣẹ́ ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ kan.
rows.reference: ẹ̀kọ oni wákàtí gígùn ́náà ní oni àwọn ìmùṣẹ́ṣe oníṣíṣẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé kan ninu.

rows.source: In one section there is an image of a dorm room, where students click on coffee cups, curtains, trainers and books to be told about the effects of caffeine and light and how athletic performance is impacted by sleep deficiency, and the importance of a bedtime routine.
rows.output: Ní apá kan, àwòrán kan wà ti yàrá ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ kan, níbi tí àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ti ń tẹ àwọn ife kọfí, àwọn aṣọ ìbora, àwọn eré ìdárayá, àti àwọn ìwé láti mọ nípa ipa ti kọfí àti ìmọ́lẹ̀ àti bí iṣẹ́ eré ìdárayá ṣe ń ní ipa lórí àìsí oorun, àti pàtàkì ìmúrasílẹ̀ kí a tó sùn.
rows.reference: Ninu abala kan ni àwòrán tí yàrá kan ninu ibùgbé àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ kan wa, níbití àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ti ńfọwọ́ ta àwọn ife kọfí, àwọn asọ ìbòju fèrèsé, àwọn akọ́nilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ àwọn sọ fún wọn nípa àwọn ipa ti kafínìnnì àti ìmọ́lẹ̀ àti bí àìsí oorun tiṣe nla ipa lórí ìṣeṣí eré ìdárayá, àti pàtàkì níní àkókó ibùsùn tómọ́nilára.

rows.source: In another section, participants are told how long-term sleep deprivation can increase risks of heart attacks, stroke, depression and cancer.
rows.output: Ní apá mìíràn, àwọn olùkópa ni a sọ fún bí àìsí oorun tí ó péye ṣe lè mú kí ewu àìsàn ọkàn, ikọlu, ìbànújẹ́, àti àìsàn jẹjẹrẹ pọ̀ sí i.
rows.reference: Ninu abala miran, àwọn akópa níwọ́n sọ fún nípa bí àìsí oorun onígbàtógùn ti leè mú àwọn ewu ti àwọn ìkọlù ọkàn, arọmọlápá-rọlẹ́sẹ̀, ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sí àti àìsàn jẹjẹrẹ pọ̀síi.

rows.source: A map of the campus, with interactive icons, then encourages participants to think about their daily routine.
rows.output: Àtòkọ àwọn ibi tí ó wà ní ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ náà, pẹ̀lú àwọn àmì ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò, lẹ́yìn náà, ó ń pe àwọn olùkópa láti ronú nípa àwọn ìṣe ojoojúmọ́ wọn.
rows.reference: Àwòrán ọgbà ilé ìwé náà, pẹ̀lú àwọn àmi ìṣàmì ìbáraẹniṣepọ̀, lẹ́yìn náà ńṣekóríyá fún àwọn ìṣe ojoójúmọ tótidibárakú fún wọn.

rows.source: 'We know it won't change students' behaviour instantly.
rows.output: 'A mọ̀ pé kòní mú ìhùwàsí àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ yí padà lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.
rows.reference: 'A mọ̀pé kòní yí àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ padà' ninu ìwà wọn lójú-ẹṣẹ̀.

rows.source: But we believe they have a right to know - just as you have a right to know the health effects of choosing to smoke cigarettes,' Prof Czeisler added.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n a gbàgbọ́ pé wọn ní ẹ̀tọ́ láti mọ̀ - gẹ́gẹ́ bí ẹ̀tọ́ rẹ láti mọ̀ nípa àwọn ipa ìlera tí ó wà nínú yíyan láti mu sìgá.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n a gbàgbó wípé wọ́n ní ẹ̀tọ́ láti mọ̀ - gẹ́gẹ́bí ìwọ náà ti ní ẹ̀tọ́ láti mọ̀ àwọn ipa ti ìlera ti yíyàn láti máa mu àwọn sìgá,' ni Ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n Czeisler fi kún un.

rows.source: The culture of pride in 'pulling an all-nighter' still exists, he said, adding that modern technology and ever-increasing pressure on students meant sleep deprivation was a growing problem.
rows.output: Ìtàn ìgbérága nínú 'ìdáwọ́le gbogbo alẹ́' ṣì wà, ó sọ, ó sì tún sọ pé ìmọ̀ ẹ̀rọ ìgbàlódé àti ìdààmú tí ó ń pọ̀ sí i lórí àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ jẹ́ ìṣòro tí ó ń pọ̀ sí i.
rows.reference: Àṣà ti ìgbéraga ninu 'fífa gbogbo-olóru kan' sì wà síbẹ̀, ni ó sọ, tó sì ńfi kún un pé ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ tìgbàlódé àti ìnira tó ńpọ̀síi láìdúró lórí àwọn akẹ̵́kọ̀ọ́ túmọ̀ síipé ìfoorundunara-ẹni jẹ́ ìṣòro kan tó ńdàgbàsókè.

rows.source: Ensuring you have enough sleep, of a good quality, should be a student's 'secret weapon' to combat stress, exhaustion and anxiety, he said - even to avoid putting on weight, as sleep deprivation puts the brain into starvation mode, making them constantly hungry.
rows.output: Ìdánilójú pé o ní oorun tó tó, ti ìdára, jẹ́ ohun tí o yẹ kí akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ lo bí ohun elò láti dojú kọ wàhálà, rírẹni àti àníyàn, o sọ - pàápàá láti yẹra fún wíwọ̀pọ̀ ìsanra, nítorí àìní oorun ń mú ọpọlọ wà nínú ipò ìdẹ́rù, tí ń jẹ́ kí wọn máa ń jẹun ní gbogbo ìgbà.
rows.reference: Ríríi dájú wípé ó rí oorun tópéye sùn, tósì dára kan, yẹ kí ó jẹ́ 'ohun ìjà ogun àṣírí' ti akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ kan láti gbógun ti ìnira-ọkàn, àárẹ̀, àti ìpayà, ni ó sọ - àni láti yàgò fún fífi ìwọn kún ìwọn títóbi ara-ẹni, nitoripe àìfójúlóoorun ńfi ọpọlọ náà sí ipò ebi, tósì ńjẹ́kí ebi máa pa wọ́n nígbà gbogbo.

rows.source: Raymond So, a 19-year-old Californian studying chemical and physical biology, helped Professor Czeisler design the course, having taken one of his classes last year during his first year at Harvard.
rows.output: Raymond So, ọmọ ọdún 19 kan ti ń kẹ́kọ̀ọ́ nípa kemistri àti fisiksi, ṣe iranlọwọ funọ́kìsì Czeisler láti ṣe àgbékalẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ náà, lẹ́yìn tí ó ti gba ẹ̀kọ́ kan lára ​​àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ rẹ̀ ní ọdún tó kọjá nígbà àkọ́kọ́ rẹ̀ ní Harvard.
rows.reference: Raymond So, ẹni ọdún mọ́kàndínlógún ara California kan tó ńkẹ̀kọ̀ọ́ nípa ìmọ̀ bàọ́lọ́jì tí èròjà kẹ́míkà àti nǹkan àfojúri, ràn Ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n Czeisler lọ́wọ́ láti ṣàgbékalẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ náà lẹ́yìn tí o ti kẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ninu àwọn kíláàsì rẹ̀ ni ọdún àkọ́kọ́ rẹ̀ ní Havard.

rows.source: He said the course had opened his eyes and inspired him to push for a campus-wide course.
rows.output: Ó sọ pé kíláàsì náà ti ṣí àwọn ojú rẹ̀ tí ó sì fún un ní ìmísí láti lọ fún kíláàsì káàkiri gbogbo ilé ẹ̀kọ́ náà.
rows.reference: Ó sọpé ẹ̀kọ́ náà ti sí ojú òun tí ó sì ti fún òun ní ìmísí láti taari rẹ̀ fún ẹ̀kọ́ gbogbòò kan ninu ọgbà náà.

rows.source: The next step, he hopes, it to ask all postgraduate students to complete a similar study programme before joining the competitive institution.
rows.output: Ìgbésẹ̀ tó tẹ̀ lé e, ó ń retí, ni láti bèèrè lọ́wọ́ gbogbo àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ gíga láti parí ètò ẹ̀kọ́ kan tó jọra kí wọ́n tó darapọ̀ mọ́ ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ tó ńfigagbága.
rows.reference: Ìgbésẹ̀ tókàn náà, tó ńretí, ni láti bèèrè lọ́wọ́́ gbogbo àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tó ńkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ gboye ẹlẹ́ẹ̀kejì láti parí ètò ẹ̀kọ́ tófarajọ́ ọ saáju kí wọ́n to ́darapọ̀ mọ́ ilé ìwé onífiga-gbága náà.

rows.source: Prof Czeisler recommended that students should consider setting an alarm for when to go to bed, as well as for when to wake, and be aware of the harmful effects of 'blue light' emitted by electronic screens and LED lighting, which can throw your circadian rhythm out of kilter, leading to problems falling asleep.
rows.output: Dọkita Czeisler dábàá pé àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ náà yẹ kí wọ́n ronú láti ṣètò ìkìlọ̀ fún ìgbà tí wọ́n yóò lọ sùn, àti fún ìgbà tí wọ́n yóò jí, kí wọ́n sì mọ̀ nípa àwọn ipa búburú tí ìmọ́lẹ̀ aláwọ̀ búlù tí a ńtú jáde láti inú iboju ẹ̀rọ elekitiriki àti iná LED, tí ó lè fọ́ ìṣọ̀kan ìṣesí wọn, tí ó sì lè yọrí sí àwọn ìṣòro tí ó ní í ṣe pẹ̀lú oorun.
rows.reference: Ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n Czeisler gba àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ lámọ̀ràn wipe ki wọ́n ronú nipa ṣíṣètò aago ìtanijí kan láti sọ àkókò láti lọ sórí ibùsùn, àti ìgbà tóyẹ láti jí, àti kí wọn sì sọ́ra fun àwọn ipa tóléwuto 'ìtànsán ìmọlẹ̀ aláwọ̀ aró' tí àwọn ìbòjù ìwòran ńtú síta àti ìmọ́lẹ̀ LED, eyiti o leè da òbìrí iṣẹ́ àti oorun sísùn ojoójúmọ ẹni ru, tí yóò sì yọrídí àwọn ìṣòro àìrí-oorun sùn.

rows.source: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Menga goal downs Gerrard's men
rows.output: Ìpínlẹ̀ Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Ibi-afẹde Menga ṣẹ́gun àwọn ọmọ ogun Gerrard
rows.reference: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Bọ́ọ̀lù ti Menga gbá wọlé tẹ àwọn ọkùnrin Gerrard lọsílẹ̀

rows.source: Rangers suffered another bout of away-day blues as Dolly Menga's strike consigned Steven Gerrard's disjointed side to a 1-0 defeat at Livingston.
rows.output: Àwọn Rangers dojú kọ ìṣòro mìíràn ní ọjọ́ ìpàdé gẹ́gẹ́ bí Dolly Menga ṣe gbé bọ́ọ̀lù, èyí sì mú kí ẹgbẹ́ Steven Gerrard jẹ́ aláìlábùkù, tí wọ́n sì sọ wọ́n di 1-0 ní ìdáwọ́lù.
rows.reference: Rangers jẹ ìyà àwọn ìkorò ti ọjọ-ìwàlájò miran bí ìkọlù-àìtàṣé ti Dolly Menga ti kó ikọ̀ ti Steven Gerrard aláìsínísọ̀kan sínú ìyà 1-0 kan ní Livingston.

rows.source: The Ibrox side were looking to record their first win on the road since February's 4-1 triumph at St Johnstone, but Gary Holt's team inflicted just Gerrard's second defeat in 18 games as manager to leave his side eight points adrift of runaway Ladbrokes Premiership leaders Hearts.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ Ibrox ń wá láti ṣe àmì ìborí àkọ́kọ́ wọn ní ìta láti February's 4-1 triumph at St Johnstone, ṣùgbọ́n Gary Holt's team fọwọ́ sí ìborí kejì Gerrard nínú 18 games gẹ́gẹ́ bí alága rẹ̀ láti fi ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ sílẹ̀ mẹ́jọ nínú àwọn àmì àbámù àwọn olùborí Ladbrokes Premiership, Hearts.
rows.reference: Ikọ̀ ti Ibrox náà ńwá láti ṣàkọsílẹ̀ ìborí àkọ́kọ́ wọn lójú ọ̀nà láti ìgbà ìborí 4-1 tíwọ́n ní ni St Johnstone ninu oṣù Ẹrẹ́ná, ṣùgbọ́n ikọ̀ ti Gary Holt ṣe wọ́nní ìpalára ìjìyà ẹlẹ́ẹ̀kejì tí Gerrard yóò ní ninu àwọn ìdíje méjìdínlógún gẹ́gẹ́bí olùṣàkóso láti fi àwọn kókó mẹ́jọ ti ikọ̀ rẹ̀ sílẹ̀ láìní àfojúsùn Hearts ikọ̀ Ladbrokes tíwọ́n jẹ́ adarí Líìgí Àkọ́kọ́.

rows.source: Menga struck seven minutes before half-time and a Rangers line-up short on inspiration never looked like levelling.
rows.output: Mbenga lu iṣẹju meje ṣaaju idaji-ọsẹ, ati pe laini Rangers ti ko ni ẹmi ko dabi ẹni pe yoo dọgba.
rows.reference: Menga ṣe ọṣẹ́ àìtàṣe ní ìṣẹ́jú méje saájú ìdajì-àkókò tí ikọ̀ Rangers eyiti ó ṣe aláìní ìnísí kòfi ìgbà kankan wò rárá bí ẹnipé wọ́n fẹ́ báwọn dọ́gba.

rows.source: While Rangers now drop down to sixth spot, Livingston climb to third and only behind Hibernian on goal difference.
rows.output: Nígbà tí àwọn Rangers bá sọ̀kalẹ̀ sí ipò kẹfa, àwọn Livingston sì ń dìde sí ipò kẹta, tí wọ́n sì wà lẹ́yìn Hibernian nípa ìyàtọ̀ góòlù.
rows.reference: Nigbati Rangers jáwálẹ̀ báyìí sí ipò ìkẹfà, Livinston fò sí ipò ìkẹta tí wọn sìwà lẹ́yìn Hibernia nìkan lórí ìyàtọ̀ iye ayò gbígbá wọlé.

rows.source: And there could be further trouble in store for Rangers after linesman Calum Spence had to be treated for a head wound after an object was apparently thrown from the away end.
rows.output: Àtipé àwọn ìṣòro síwájú si lè wà fún àwọn Rangers lẹ́yìn tí olùṣàkóso ìlà Calum Spence ti ní láti tọju ọgbẹ́ orí rẹ̀ lẹ́yìn tí ohun kan ti dámọ̀ràn láti ọ̀nà jínjìn.
rows.reference: Àtipé ìṣòro púpọ̀ síi sì leè wà ní ìpamọ́ fún Rangers lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n níláti tójú ọkùnrin tó ńkíyèsí ìlà orí-pápá Calum Spence fún ìpalára orí kan lẹ́yìn tí ó hàn wipe wọn ju ohun kan láti ìhà ibiti àwọn àlejò náà wà.

rows.source: Gerrard made eight changes to the side which swept past Ayr into the Betfred Cup semi-finals.
rows.output: Gerrard ṣe àwọn àyípadà mẹ́jọ sí ẹgbẹ́ náà tí ó kọjá Ayr sínú ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ Betfred.
rows.reference: Gerrard ṣe àwọn ìyípadà mẹ́jọ sí ikọ̀ náà eyiti ó gbá rekọjá Ayr wọnú ìdíje tó kángun sí àṣèkágbá Ife-ẹ̀yẹ Betfred náà.

rows.source: Holt, on the other hand, went with the same Livi 11 which took a point off Hearts last week and he would have been delighted with the way his well-drilled outfit suffocated their opponents at every turn.
rows.output: Holt, ni apa keji, lo Livi 11 ti o mu aaye kan kuro ni Hearts ni ọsẹ to kọja, o si ni inu-didun pẹlu bi ẹgbẹ rẹ ti o ni ilana ti o fi agbara mu awọn alátakò wọn ni gbogbo ọna.
rows.reference: Holt, ní apá miran, lọ pẹ̀lú Livi mọ́kànlá kannáà tí ó mú kókó kan kúró lára Hearts lọ́sẹ̀ tókọjá tí inú rẹ̀ kì bá sì dùn pẹ̀lú ọ̀nà tí àwọn ikọ̀ tótikọ́ dáradára rẹ̀ fi fún àwọn alátakò wọn lọ́rùn ní gbogbo ibiti wọ́n bá kọjú sí.

rows.source: Rangers may have dominated possession but Livingston did more with the ball they had.
rows.output: Àwọn Rangers lè ti ní ìdánilójú ní ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ṣùgbọ́n Livingston ṣe púpọ̀ pẹ̀lú bọ́ọ̀lù tí wọ́n ní.
rows.reference: Rangers leè ti ní àwọn bọ́ọ̀lù pípẹ́lẹ́sẹ̀ tópọ̀jùlọ̀ ṣùgbọ́n Livingston ṣe púpọ̀ pẹ̀lú bọ́ọ̀lù náà tíwọ́n ní.

rows.source: They should have scored just two minutes in when Menga's first-time lay-off sent Scott Pittman through on Allan McGregor's goal but the midfielder tugged his big chance wide.
rows.output: Wọ́n gbọ́dọ̀ ti gba wọ́n ní ìṣẹ́jú méjì ṣáájú ìgbà tí Menga ṣe ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ àkọ́kọ́ rẹ̀ fi Scott Pittman ránṣẹ́ sí àgbègbè Allan McGregor, ṣùgbọ́n midfielder náà yọ ọ́ lọ́nà ìwọ̀n.
rows.reference: Ó yẹ kíwọ́n ti gbá ayò wọlé ní ìṣẹ́jú méji nigbati  bọ́ọ̀lù aláàtẹ́sílẹ̀ àkọ́kọ́ ti Menga rán Scott níṣẹ́ wọ ojú ile Allan McGregor ṣùgbọ́n tí onípò-ààrin náà gbá àǹfààní ńlá rẹ̀ dànù sígbó.

rows.source: A deep Keaghan Jacobs free-kick then found skipper Craig Halkett but his defensive partner Alan Lithgow could only stab wide at the back post.
rows.output: Ìúnlò Keaghan Jacobs tó jinlẹ̀ lẹ́yìn náà rí skipper Craig Halkett, ṣùgbọ́n aláàbò rẹ̀ Alan Lithgow lè ṣe é ṣeé fọwọ́ kan ní ẹ̀yìn pẹ̀lú.
rows.reference: Ìgbásójú-ilé aláìsí-àtakò tójinlẹ̀ ti Keaghan Jacobs lẹ́yìn náà rí asíwáju Craig Halkett ṣùgbọ́n akẹgbẹ́ aláàbò rẹ̀ Alan Lithgow kàn leè  gúnbẹ dànù ní ẹ̀yìn ojú-ilé náà.

rows.source: Rangers did grab control but there looked to be more hope than belief about their play in the final third.
rows.output: Àwọn Rangers gba ìṣàkóso ṣùgbọ́n ó dàbí pé ìrètí ju ìgbàgbọ́ lọ nípa eré wọn ní apá kẹta.
rows.reference: Rangers kúkú já ìṣàkóso gbà ṣùgbọ́n ó dàbí ẹnipé ìrètí púpọ̀ wà ju ìgbàgbọ́ nípa ayò gbígbá wọn ninu ìparí ẹlẹ́ẹ̀kẹta náà.

rows.source: Alfredo Morelos certainly felt he should have had a penalty on the quarter-hour mark as he and Steven Lawless collided but referee Steven Thomson waved away the Colombian's appeals.
rows.output: Alfredo Morelos ní ìrònú pé ó yẹ kí wọ́n fún un ní ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ní ìdá mẹ́rìnláàádọ́ta (quarter-hour) gẹ́gẹ́ bí ó ti kọlu Steven Lawless, ṣùgbọ́n olùkópa Steven Thomson kọ̀ láti gbà á.
rows.reference: Alfredo Morelos rò pẹ̀lú ìdánilójú wipe ó yẹ́ki òun gba pẹnariti gbígbá kan lójú àmì ìdá kan nínú ìdá mẹ́rin wákàtí bí òun àti Steven Lawless tíkọlu ara wọn ṣùgbọ́n rẹfirí Steven Thomson juwọ́ dànù sí àwọn ẹ̀bẹ̀ ọmọ ilẹ Colombia náà.

rows.source: Rangers managed just two first-half shots on target but former Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly was barely troubled by Lassana Coulibaly's header and a tame Ovie Ejaria strike.
rows.output: Àwọn Rangers ṣe àṣeyọrí méjì péré nínú àwọn ìfọwọ́kùsọ̀ àkọ́kọ́ ṣùgbọ́n Liam Kelly tó ti ṣeé ṣe fún Ibrox náà kò ní ìṣòro púpọ̀ láti ọwọ́ Lassana Coulibaly àti ìfọwọ́kùsọ̀ Ovie Ejaria tó rọrùn.
rows.reference: Rangers rí ọgbọ́n dá láti gba àwọn bọ́ọ̀lù gbígbóná méjì tólọ sójú ilé ni ìdajì ìdíje àkọ́kọ́ ṣùgbọ́n aṣọ́lé Ibrox Liam Kelly kòfi bẹ́ẹ̀ rí ìsọro rárá nípaṣẹ̀ bọ́ọ̀lù aforígbá ti Lassana Coulibaly àti ìkọlù Ovie Ejaria tíwọn mú ṣo.

rows.source: While Livi's 34th-minute opener may have been against the run of play, no one can deny they deserved it for their graft alone.
rows.output: Nígbà tí Livi ti ṣe àmì ìdá 34th rẹ̀ ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀, kò lè jẹ́ kí a sọ pé wọ́n yẹ fún un nítorí bí wọ́n ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́ takuntakun.
rows.reference: Nigbati bọ́ọ̀lù àfisíde tówọlé ti Livi leè jẹ́ eyiti tólòdì sí bí ìdíje tí ńlọ, kòsí ẹnití o leè ṣẹ́ wipe wọn yẹ fún un nitori ohun tíwọ́n gbà nìkan.

rows.source: Again Rangers failed to deal with a deep Jacobs set-piece.
rows.output: Lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i, àwọn Rangers kò lè yanjú ìpèníjà tí Jacobs ṣe pẹ̀lú ìpèníjà.
rows.reference: Lẹ́ẹ̀kan sii Rangers kùná láti yanjú ọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú àtòpapọ̀-ẹlẹ́yọ tójinlẹ̀ kan.

rows.source: Scott Arfield did not react as Declan Gallagher slotted the ball to Scott Robinson, who kept his cool to pick out Menga for a simple finish.
rows.output: Scott Arfield kò fèsì bí Declan Gallagher ṣe fi bọ́ọ̀lù náà sí Scott Robinson, ẹni tó pa ìṣòro rẹ̀ mọ́ láti yan Menga fún ìparẹ́ tó rọrùn.
rows.reference: Scott Arfield kò dáhùn bí Declan Gallagher ti taari bọ́ọ̀lù sí Scott Robinson ẹnití ó farabalẹ̀  láti yọ Menga jáde fún ìparí tó rọrùn kan.
