rows.source: Gerrard acted at the break as he swapped Coulibaly for Ryan Kent and the switch almost provided an immediate impact as the winger slotted in Morelos but the impressive Kelly raced from his line to block.
rows.output: Gerrard ṣe ní ìparẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ó ti rọ́pò Coulibaly pẹ̀lú Ryan Kent, àti pé ìyípadà náà fà á láti ní ipa lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ bí ó ti fi Kent sínú Morelos, ṣùgbọ́n Kelly tó ṣeé ṣe kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́
rows.reference: Gerrard ṣe nǹkan ninu ìsinmi náà bí ó ti pààrọ̀ Coulibaly fún Ryan Kent ti ìyípadà náà sì fẹ́rẹ̀ pèsè ipa kan lójú-ẹṣẹ̀ bí onípò-igun náà ti gbá bọ́ọ̀lù sínú fún Morelos ṣùgbọn Kelly tó móríẹni wú sáré kuro lójú ìlà rẹ̀ láti dènà.

rows.source: But Livingston continued to suck the visitors into playing exactly the type of game they enjoy, with Lithgow and Halkett sweeping up long ball after long ball.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n Livingston tẹ̀síwájú láti fa àwọn àlejò sínú eré náà tí wọ́n fẹ́ràn, pẹ̀lú Lithgow àti Halkett tí ń gbé bọ́ọ̀lù gúngùn lẹ́yìn bọ́ọ̀lù gúngùn.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọn Livinston tẹ̀síwájú láti fa àwọn àlejò náà sí gbígbá ayò lọ́nà ìdíje náà tíwọ́n gbádùn, pẹ̀lú Lithgow àti Halkett tíwọ́n ńgbá bọ́ọ̀lù gígùn lẹ́yìn bọ́ọ̀lù gígùn.

rows.source: Holt's side could have stretched their lead in the final stages but McGregor stood up well to deny Jacobs before Lithgow headed wide from the corner.
rows.output: Ìàpá Holt lè ti fa ìdàgbàbọ̀ wọn ní àwọn ìṣẹ́jú tó kù, ṣùgbọ́n McGregor dúró dáadáa láti dènà Jacobs, nígbà tí Lithgow ti kọlu ìlà náà láti igun.
rows.reference: Ikọ̀ Holt kòbá ti fa ìléwájú wọn wọnú àwọn ipele ìparí ṣùgbọn McGregor duro dìde bótiyẹ láti fí ayò dun Jacobs kí Lithgow tó fi orí gbá a dànù láti igun náà.

rows.source: Rangers substitute Glenn Middleton had another late claim for a penalty as he tangled with Jacobs but again Thomson looked away.
rows.output: Olùṣàkóso Rangers Glenn Middleton ní ẹ̀tọ́ mìíràn fún ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ kan lẹ́yìn ìgbà tí ó bá Jacobs pàdé, ṣùgbọ́n lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i, Thomson wo ọ̀nà mìíràn.
rows.reference: Àfirọ́pò Rangers Glenn Middleton ni àwíjàre ìgbẹ̀yìn miran fún pẹnariti gbígbá bí o ti lọ́ mọ́ Jacobs ṣùgbọ́n lẹ́èkan síi Thomsom wo ibòmíràn.

rows.source: Almanac: The inventor of the Geiger Counter
rows.output: Almanac: Olùṣàgbéjáde Ìwọ̀n Ìwọ̀n Geiger
rows.reference: Álimánáàkì Aṣàgbélẹ̀rọ́ ti Olóǹka Geiger náà

rows.source: And now a page from our "Sunday Morning" Almanac: September 30, 1882, 136 years ago today, and COUNTING ... the day the future physicist Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger was born in Germany.
rows.output: Àti báyìí, ojú-ìwé kan láti inú “Àkókò Ìṣé” Almanac: September 30, 1882, 136 ọdún sẹ́yìn lénìí, àti ÌKÁ ... ọjọ́ tí physicist Johannes Wilhelm “Hans” Geiger ni a bí ní Jámánì.
rows.reference: Àtipé nísinsìnyí ojú-ewé kan kúrò sí Álimánáàkì ''Sunday Morning'' wa: Ní Ọgbọ̀nọjọ́ oṣù Owewe, lọ́dún 1882, lọ́dún mẹ̵́rìndínlógóje lóòní, tósì tún ŃKA... ọjọ́ náà ni wọ́n bí onímọ̀ ìjìnlẹ ohun àfojúrí ọjọ́ iwájú Johannes Wilhelm ''Hans'' Geiger ní orilẹ-ede Jamani.

rows.source: Geiger developed a method for detecting and measuring radioactivity, an invention that eventually led to the device known as the Geiger Counter.
rows.output: Ìmọ̀ ẹ̀rọ Geiger ṣe àgbékalẹ̀ ọ̀nà kan fún ìdámọ̀ àti ìwọn ìmúra, ìmúlò tí ó yọrí sí ẹ̀rọ tí a mọ̀ sí Geiger Counter.
rows.reference: Geiger ṣàgbékalẹ̀ ọgbọ́n-àtiṣenǹkan fún dídámọ̀ àti ṣíṣe òdiwọ̀n àwọn ìtújáde tíwọn pè ni oníṣẹ́rédíò, àgbélẹ̀rọ eyiti o pàpà yọrísì ẹ̀rọ náà tíwọ́n mọ̀ sí Geiger Counter.

rows.source: A mainstay of science ever since, the Geiger Counter became a pop culture mainstay as well, as in the 1950 movie "Bells of Coronado," starring those seemingly unlikely cowpoke scientists Roy Rogers and Dale Evans:
rows.output: Ìpìlẹ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì tó ń bá a lọ láti ìgbà náà, ẹ̀rọ ìwọ̀n Geiger di ohun tó gbajúmọ̀ nínú àṣà pop, gẹ́gẹ́ bí nínú fíìmù 1950 “Bells of Coronado,” tí àwọn ọmọ ilẹ̀ cowboy tó dà bíi pé kò ṣeé ṣe, Roy Rogers àti Dale Evans:
rows.reference: Òpómúléró kan ti ìmọ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì láti ìgbà náà, Olóǹkà Geiger di òpó fún àṣà pop bákannáà, bótirí ninu àwòrán sinnimá ọdún 1950 ''Àwọn Agogo ti Colorado,'' eyiti àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì tíwọn fúnníṣe àgbàṣe wọ̀nyẹn tí a kò lérò ROY Rogers àti Dale Evans ti kópa:

rows.source: Man: "What in the world is that?"
rows.output: Ọkùnrin: "Kínni ọ̀rọ̀ náà?"
rows.reference: Ọkùnrin: ''Kínni ǹkan náà?''

rows.source: Rogers: "It's a Geiger Counter, used to locate radioactive minerals, such as uranium.
rows.output: Rogers: "Ó jẹ́ ẹ̀rọ ìwọn ìdọ̀tí, tí a ń lò láti rí àwọn ohun èlò àdó abúgbàmù, bíi uranium.
rows.reference: Rogers: ''Olóǹkà Geiger kan ni, tíwọn ńlò latí mọ ibi ti àwọn èròja àlùmọ́ọ̀nì oníṣẹ́rédíò, bíi yureniọmu wà.

rows.source: When you put these earphones on, you can actually hear the effects of the atoms given off by the radioactivity in the minerals."
rows.output: Nígbà tí o bá fi àwọn etí náà sí, o lè gbọ́ àwọn ipa tí àwọn àtòmù tí a ń tú jáde láti inú ìmúra ti àwọn ohun èlò tí ó ń ṣe ìmúra."
rows.reference: Nigbati o báfi àwọn fóònù ètí wọ̀nyí sétí, o leè gbọ́ àwọn ipa ti àwọn átọ́ọ́mù tíwọ́n tú jáde nípaṣẹ̀ iṣẹ́ rédíò nínú àwọn àlùmọ́ọ̀nì náà.''

rows.source: Evans: "Say, it sure is popping now!"
rows.output: Evans: "Dúró, ó ńpọ̀ sí i báyìí!"
rows.reference: Evans: ''Sọpé, ó ńtú jáde nítòótọ́ nísinsìnyí!''

rows.source: "Hans" Geiger died in 1945, just a few days short of his 63rd birthday.
rows.output: "Ìhàns" Geiger kú ní 1945, ní ọjọ́ díẹ̀ ṣáájú ọjọ́ ìbí 63th rẹ̀.
rows.reference: ''Hans'' Gieger kú lọ́dún 1945, ni ó kù àwọn ọjọ́ díẹ̀ sí àjọ̀dún ojọ́-ìbí ìkẹtàlélọ́gọ́ta rẹ̀.

rows.source: But the invention that bears his name lives on.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n ìmúlò tí orúkọ rẹ̀ ń jẹ́ ń bẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n iṣẹ́ àgbélẹ̀rọ náà eyiti ó ńjẹ́ orúkọ rẹ̀ sí wà láàyé títí lái.

rows.source: New cancer vaccine can teach the immune system to 'see' rogue cells
rows.output: Ẹ̀rọ àjẹsára jẹjẹrẹ tuntun lè kọ́ ẹ̀yà àjẹsára láti ‘rí’ àwọn ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì tó ńtan ara wọn jẹ́.
rows.reference: Abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára fún àìsàn jẹjẹrẹ tuntun leè kọ́ àwọn ètò ìlànà àgọ́-ara tówà fún ìdáààbòbò láti 'ri' àwọn ṣẹ̵́ẹ̀lì olè.

rows.source: New cancer vaccine can teach the immune system to 'see' rogue cells and kill them
rows.output: Ẹ̀rọ àjẹsára jẹjẹrẹ tuntun lè kọ́ ẹ̀yà àjẹsára ara láti ‘rí’ àwọn ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì tó ńtanra àti láti pa wọn.
rows.reference: Abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára fún àìsàn jẹjẹrẹ tuntun leè kọ́ àwọn ètò ìlànà àgọ́-ara tówà fún ìdáààbòbò láti 'ri' àwọn ṣẹ̵́ẹ̀lì olè kí ó sì pa wọn

rows.source: Vaccine teaches immune system to recognise rogue cells as part of treatment
rows.output: Ẹran àjẹsára kọ́ ẹ̀yà àjẹsára láti mọ àwọn ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì tó ńtan ara wọn jẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí apá kan nínú itọju náà
rows.reference: Abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára ńkọ́ àwọn ètò ìlànà àgọ́-ara tówà fún ìdáààbòbò láti dá àwọn ṣẹ̵́ẹ̀lì olè mọ̀ gẹ́gẹ́bí ara ìtọ̀jú

rows.source: Method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in lab
rows.output: Ìlànà náà ní í ṣe pẹ̀lú yíyọ àwọn ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì àjẹsára kúrò nínú aláìsàn kan, yíyí wọn padà ní ilé-iṣẹ́ ìwádìí
rows.reference: Ọ̀nà àtiṣiṣẹ́ ní wíwa àwọn ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì ètò ìlànà àgọ́-ara ìdáààbòbò jáde kúrò lára aláìsàn kan nínú, kí á sì yíwọn padà nínú yàrá iṣẹ́ ìmọ̀ ìjìnlẹ̀

rows.source: They can then 'see' a protein common to many cancers and then reinjected
rows.output: Wọ́n lè ríi amuaradagba kan tí ó wọ́pọ̀ ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àìsàn jẹjẹrẹ, wọ́n sì tún lè fi padà sínú ara ẹni náà
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn náà wọ́n leè 'ri' èròja puroteeni tówọ́pọ̀ sí ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn jẹjẹrẹ tíwọn yóò sì túnwọn gbé mì

rows.source: A trial vaccine is showing promising results in patients with a range of cancers.
rows.output: Ìdánwò àjẹsára kan ńfi àwọn àbájáde tí ó dára hàn nínú àwọn aláìsàn tí ó ní oríṣiríṣi àìsàn.
rows.reference: Abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára kan tí a ńdánwò lọ́wọ́ ńfi àwọn èsì oníìlérí hàn ninu àwọn aláìsàn tíwọ́n ní onírú-irú àwọn àìsàn jẹjẹrẹ.

rows.source: One woman treated with the vaccine, which teaches the immune system to recognise rogue cells, saw her ovarian cancer disappear for more than 18 months.
rows.output: Obìnrin kan ṣe itọju àjẹsára náà, èyí tó kọ́ eto àjẹsára láti mọ àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì tí kò tọ́ ní, ó sì rí pé jẹjẹrẹ ọ̀fun rẹ̀ parẹ́ fún ó lé ní oṣù méjìlá.
rows.reference: Obìnrin kan tíwọ́n tọ́jú pẹ̀lú abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára náà, eyiti ó ńkọ́ àwọn ètò ìlànà àgọ́-ara tówà fún ìdáààbòbò láti ri àwọn ṣẹ̵́ẹ̀lì olè, ríi ti jẹjẹrẹ ti ẹ̀yà-ara fún ẹyin ìbímọ rẹ̀ pòórá fún àwọn oṣù tóju méjìdínlógún lọ.

rows.source: The method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in the laboratory so they can "see" a protein common to many cancers called HER2, and then reinjecting the cells.
rows.output: Ìlànà náà ní í ṣe pẹ̀lú yíyọ àwọn ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì àjẹsára kúrò nínú aláìsàn kan, yíyí wọn padà ní ilé-iṣẹ́ láti lè “rí” èrònjà kan tí ó wọ́pọ̀ nínú ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn àrùn jẹjẹrẹ tí a ń pè ní HER2, àti lẹ́yìn náà tún fi àwọn ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì náà sínú ara.
rows.reference: Ọ̀nà àtiṣiṣẹ́ náà ní wíwa àwọn ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì ètò ìlànà àgọ́-ara ìdáààbòbò jáde kúrò lára aláìsàn kan nínú, kí á sì yíwọn padà nínú yàrá iṣẹ́ ìmọ̀ ìjìnlẹ̀ kan kí wọ́n leè 'ri' èròja puroteeni tówọ́pọ̀ sí ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn jẹjẹrẹ tíwọ́n ńpe ni HER2, àtipé lẹ́yìn náà kí wọ́n sì tún àwọn ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì náà gbé mi.

rows.source: Professor Jay Berzofsky, of the US National Cancer Institute in Bethesda, Maryland, said: "Our results suggest that we have a very promising vaccine."
rows.output: ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n Jay Berzofsky, ní Ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ gíga ti Orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà fún Àrùn Jẹjẹrẹ ní Bethesda, Maryland, sọ pé: “Àwọn àbájáde wa dámọ̀ràn pé a ní àbójútó àbójútó.”
rows.reference: Ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n Jay Berzofsky, ti Ilé Ẹ̀kọ́ Àìsàn Jẹjẹrẹ ti Orilẹ-ede Amẹrika ní Bethesda, Maryland, sọpé: ''Àwọn èsì wa ńsọ fún wa wipe a ní abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára oníìlérí gidigidi kan.

rows.source: HER2 "drives the growth of several types of cancer," including breast, ovarian, lung and colorectal cancers, Prof Berzofsky explained.
rows.output: HER2 "ń mú kí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ irú jẹjẹrẹ dàgbà," pẹ̀lú jẹjẹrẹ ọyàn, jẹjẹrẹ ọ̀fun, jẹjẹrẹ ẹ̀dọ̀fóró àti jẹjẹrẹ ikùn, ṣíṣe àlàyé Prof Berzofsky.
rows.reference: HER2 ''ńwakọ̀ ìdàgbàsókè ti ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ onírúurú jẹjẹrẹ,'' ninu eyiti ti àwọn ọyàn, tí àgọ́-ara ẹyin ìbímọ, fùùkû ati tí ìfun ìsàlẹ̀ wà, ni Ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n Berzofsky ṣe àlàyé rẹ̀.

rows.source: A similar approach of taking immune cells out of patients and "teaching" them how to target cancer cells has worked in treating a type of leukaemia.
rows.output: Ìmúlò tí ó jọra ní gbígba àwọn ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì àgọ́ ara láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn aláìsàn kí wọ́n sì “kọ́ wọn bí wọ́n ṣe lè fojusi àwọn ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì àrùn” ti ṣiṣẹ́ ní títọ́jú irú àrùn kan tí ó ní í ṣe pẹ̀lú ẹ̀jẹ̀ funfun.
rows.reference: Ọ́ná tó farajọ ọ́ kan ni mímú àwọn ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì ètò àgọ́-ara tówà fún ìdáààbòbò kùrò lára aláìsàn náà àti ''kíkọ́'' wọn bí wọn yóò ti máa ṣàfojúsùn àwọn ṣẹ́ẹ̀lì jẹjẹrẹ ti ṣiṣẹ́ ninu títọ́jú irú áìsàn jẹjẹrẹ ti ẹlẹ́ẹ̀jẹ̀.

rows.source: Kanye West Embarked on a Pro-Trump Diatribe, Wearing a MAGA Hat, After his SNL Appearance.
rows.output: Kanye West bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ pẹ̀lú Trump, wọ aṣọ MAGA lẹ́yìn àfihàn rẹ̀ lórí SNL.
rows.reference: Kanye West Bẹ̀rẹ̀ Ìkọluni Ọlọ́rọ̀ Èébú fún Àtilẹ́yìn-Trump kan, tó ńdé Ate-ori MAGA, Lẹ́yìn Ìfarahàn SNL rẹ̀.

rows.source: It Didn't Go Well
rows.output: Kò ṣe dáadáa
rows.reference: Kò Lọ Dáradara

rows.source: Kanye West was booed in the studio during a Saturday Night Live after a rambling performance in which he praised U.S. President Donald Trump and said he would run for office in 2020.
rows.output: Kanye West ni wọn kọlu ninu ile-iṣẹ igbasilẹ lakoko ere Saturday Night Live lẹhin iṣẹ kan ti o n sọrọ ni gbangba ti o sọ pe Donald Trump jẹ Aare Amẹrika ati pe yoo dije fun ipo naa ni ọdun 2020.
rows.reference: Kanye West ni àwọn èrò hó lé lórí ninu situdio náà níbi ètò Saturday Night Live kan lẹ́yin eré ṣíṣe eyiti ó yapa kuro lọ́nà ninu eyiti ó ti gbóríyìn fún orilẹ-ede U.S. Ààrẹ Donald Trump tí ó sì sọpé yóò díje fún ọ́fíìsì lọ́dún 2020.

rows.source: After performing his third song of the night, called Ghost Town in which he was wearing a Make America Great cap, he went on a rant against the Democrats and reiterated his support for Trump.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn tí ó ti ṣe orin kẹta rẹ̀ ní alẹ́ yẹn, tí a ń pè ní Ghost Town, níbi tí ó ti wọ Make America Great cap, ó lọ sí ìpàdé kan lòdì sí àwọn Democrats ó sì tún fi ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ rẹ̀ hàn sí Trump.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn tí ó kọ orin ìkẹta rẹ̀ ti alẹ́ náà, tí ó pè ni Ghost Town níbi ti o ti ńdé fila Sọ Amẹrika Di Ńlà, ó tẹ̀síwájú pẹ̀lú ọ̀rọ̀ èébu lòdí sí àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Democrats tí o sì tún tẹnumọ́ àtìlẹ́yìn fún Trump.

rows.source: "So many times I talk to a white person and they say: "How could you like Trump, he's racist?"
rows.output: "Mo ti ń sọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn ènìyàn funfun ní ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà tí wọ́n sì sọ fún mi pé: "Báwo ni o ṣe lè fẹ́ràn Trump, ó jẹ́ ẹlẹ́yàmẹyà?"
rows.reference: ''Ní ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà ní Mo ńsọ fún eniyan funfun tíwọn wipe: ''Báwo ni ó ṣe níláti fẹ́ràn Trump, ẹlẹ́yàmẹ̀yà ni?''

rows.source: Well, if I was concerned about racism I would've moved out of America a long time ago," he said.
rows.output: Ó dára, bí mo bá ti ń ṣàníyàn nípa ẹ̀yà, mo ti lọ kúrò ní Amẹ́ríkà pẹ́pẹ́," ni ó wí.
rows.reference: Ó dára, bí ìwà ẹlẹ́yàmẹ̀yà bá kàn mi N kòbá ti jáde kuro ní Amẹrika nígba tótipẹ́ sẹ́yìn,'' ni o wí.

rows.source: SNL started the show with a skit starring Matt Damon in which the Hollywood star made fun of Brett Kavanaugh's testimony before the Senate Judicial Committee on sexual assault claims made by Christine Blasey Ford.
rows.output: SNL bẹ̀rẹ̀ eré náà pẹ̀lú eré kan tí ó ní Matt Damon tí ó sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ Brett Kavanaugh níwọ̀n ìgbà tí Senate Judicial Committee ń ṣe ìwádìí lórí ẹ̀sùn ìfipá-bánilopọ̀ tí Christine Blasey Ford fi kan.
rows.reference: SNL bẹ̀rẹ̀ ètò náà pẹ̀lú eré ìtàgé eyiti Matt Damon kópa ninu rẹ̀ níbití ìràwọ̀ Hollywood náà ti fi ẹ̀rí Brett Kavanaugh nìwáju Ìgbìmọ Ètò Ìdájọ́ ti Ilé Ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣojú-ṣòfin Àgbà lori àwọn ẹ̀sùn ìkọluni nitori ìbálòpọ̀ tí Christine Blassey Ford fi kàn án ṣe yẹ̀yẹ̵́.

rows.source: Although it was not broadcast, the footage of West's rant was uploaded to social media by comedian Chris Rock.
rows.output: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kò sí ìtànsán, fídíò ìbínú West ni Chris Rock, apanilẹ́rìn-ín kan, ṣe gbé s'íta lórí mídíà ìbáraẹniṣepọ̀.
rows.reference: Botilẹjẹpe kìí ṣe ètò àgbéjáde, àwòrán fídíò ti ọ̀rọ̀ èébú ti West náà ni kó gòké sínú ojú-òpò ìbáṣepọ̀ ayelujara láti ọwọ́ Chris Rock.

rows.source: It is unclear if Rock was trying to mock West with the posting.
rows.output: Kò yéni bóyá Rock ńgbìyànjú láti fi ẹ̀hónú hàn sí ìwọ̀ oòrùn pẹ̀lú ìfiránṣẹ́ náà.
rows.reference: Kò tíì hàn kedere bóyá Rock ńgbìyânjú láti fi West ṣe ẹlẹ́yà ni pẹ̀lú àgbéjáde náà.

rows.source: Also, West had complained to the audience that he had got a hard time backstage about his head wear.
rows.output: Pẹlupẹlu, West ti kerora fun awọn olugbo pe o ni akoko lile niẹhin nipa aṣọ ori rẹ.
rows.reference: Bákannáà, West ti fẹ̀sùn kan sọ́dọ̀ àwọn olùtẹ́tígbọ́ náà wipe òun ti ní àkókò tóle gidi kan lẹ́yìn ìtàgé nípa ate-ori rẹ̀.

rows.source: "They bullied me backstage.
rows.output: "Wọn ń fi ipá mú mi lẹ́yìn ìpele.
rows.reference: ''Wọ́n halẹ̀ mọ́ mi lẹ́yìn ìtàge.

rows.source: They said, 'don't go out there with that hat on.'
rows.output: Wọn sọ pé, "máṣe lọsíta pẹ̀lú fìlà yìí."
rows.reference: Wọ́n sọpé, 'máṣe jáde lọ síta níbẹ̀yẹn pẹ̀lú ate yẹn lórí.'

rows.source: They bullied me!
rows.output: Wọ́n ń fi agbára mú mi!
rows.reference: 'Wọ́n halẹ̀ mọ́ mi!

rows.source: And then they say I'm in a sunken place," he said, according to the Washington Examiner.
rows.output: Àti lẹ́yìn náà wọ́n sọpé mo wà ní ibi tí o ti sọnù," ó wí, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìwé ìròyìn Washington Examiner ṣe sọ.
rows.reference: Àtipé lẹ́yìn náà wọn sọpé Mo wà níbi tójìnwọnú kan, ní ó sọ, gẹ́gẹ́bí Washington Examiner ti wí.

rows.source: West went on: "You wanna see the sunken place?" saying that he would "put my superman cape on, because this means you can't tell me what to do. You want the world to move forward?
rows.output: Ó tẹ̀síwájú: "O fẹ́ rí ibi tí o ti sọ̀kalẹ̀?" ó sọ pé òun yóò "fi aṣọ aláwọ̀ dúdú mi wọ̀, nítorí pé èyí túmọ̀ sí pé o kò lè sọ ohun tí mo gbọ́dọ̀ ṣe fún ọ. O fẹ́ kí ayé tẹ̀síwájú?
rows.reference: West tẹ̀síwájú: ''Ṣe o fẹ́ láti rí ibi tójìnwọnú náà?'' tó sì ńsọpé òun yóò ''wọ ẹ̀wù aláìlápá ti ọkùnrin alágbára sọ́rùn, nitoripe èyí túmọ̀ sípé ò kò leè sọ ohun tóyẹ kí ńṣe fúnmi. Ó fẹ́ kí ayé tẹ̀síwájú bí?

rows.source: Try love."
rows.output: Gbìyánjú ìfẹ́."
rows.reference: Gbìyànjú lílo ìfẹ́.''

rows.source: His comments drew boos at least twice from the audience and SNL cast members appeared to be embarrassed, Variety reported, with one person there telling the publication: "The entire studio fell dead silent."
rows.output: Àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ mú kí àwọn olùgbọ́ náà kọ̀ wọ́n, ó kéré jù lọ ní ìgbà méjì. Àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ SNL dà bí ẹni pé wọ́n ń bínú, Variety sọ, pẹ̀lú ènìyàn kan tó wà níbẹ̀ sọ fún ìwé náà pé: “Gbogbo ilé iṣẹ́ náà dúró ní ìdákẹ́jẹ́jẹ́.”
rows.reference: Àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ fa ariwo ìhónú ní ó kéré tán lẹ́ẹ̀mẹjì láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn olùtẹ́tígbọ́ àti àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ akópá ninu eré SNL tíwọn dàbí ẹnipé ojú tìwọn, ni Variety ròyìn, pẹ̀lú ẹnìkan níbẹ̵̵̀ tó ńsọ àgbéjáde náà. ''Gbogbo situdio náà dákẹ́ minimini.''

rows.source: West had been brought in as a late replacement for singer Ariana Grande, whose former boyfriend, the rapper Mac Miller had died a few days ago.
rows.output: Ìwọ̀ oòrùn ti wọ inú gẹ́gẹ́ bí rọ́pá fún akọrin Ariana Grande, ẹni tí ó ti fẹ́ rẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀, rapper Mac Miller, tí ó kú ní ọjọ́ díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn.
rows.reference: West ni wọ́n ti mú wọlé bí ìpààrọ̀ ìgbẹ̀yìn fún akọrin Arian Grande, ẹnití ọ̀rẹ́kùnrin rẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀rí, akọrinbíẹ̵nití-ńsọ̀rọ̀ náà Mac Miller ti kú ní àwọn ọjọ́ díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn.

rows.source: West puzzled many with a performance of the song I Love it, dressed as a Perrier Bottle.
rows.output: Ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n
rows.reference: West jọ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ lójú pẹ̀lú ìkọ orin rẹ̀ I Love it, tó wọ ẹ̀wù bíi Ìgò Perrier kan.

rows.source: West got backing from head of conservative group TPUSA, Candace Turner who tweeted: "To one of the most courageous spirits: THANK YOU FOR STANDING UP TO THE MOB."
rows.output: Ìwọ̀ oòrùn gba àtìlẹ́yìn láti ọ̀dọ̀ olórí ẹgbẹ́ ìdàgbàdà, Candace Turner, ẹni tó tweeted: "Fún ọ̀kan lára àwọn ẹ̀mí tó ní ìgboyà jùlọ: O ṣeun fún dídúró ṣinṣin sí ọ̀wọ̀ àwọn ènìyàn."
rows.reference: West gba àtìlẹ́yìn láti ọwọ́ olórí ẹgbẹ́ oṣèlú conservative TPUSA kan, Candace Turner tí ó kọ àtẹ̀ránṣẹ́ si tweeter: ''Sí ọ̀kan ninu àwọn ẹ̀mí tóní ìgboyà jùlọ: ''A DÚPẸ́ LỌ́WỌ́ RẸ FÚN DÍDÌDE DÚRÓ SÍ Ọ̀PỌ̀ ÈRÒ NÁÀ.''

rows.source: But talk show host Karen Hunter tweeted that West was simply "being who he is and that's absolutely wonderful."
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n Karen Hunter, agbalejo ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò, tweeted pé West kàn jẹ́ "ẹniti ó jẹ́ àti pé ìyẹn jẹ́ ìyanu."
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n olùgbàlejò ètò ọ̀rọ̀ sísọ nàà Karen Hunter kọ àtẹ̀ránṣẹ́ tweeter wipe West pẹ̀lú ìrọ̀rùn ''njẹ́ ẹnití i ṣe àtipé ìyẹn jẹ́ eyiti ó dára gídígáà́n.''

rows.source: "But I chose NOT to reward someone (by purchasing his music or clothing or supporting his "art") who I believe is embracing and spewing ideology that is harmful to my community.
rows.output: "Ṣùgbọ́n mo yan láti má san owó fún ẹnìkan (nípa rà orin rẹ tàbí aṣọ rẹ tàbí ṣíṣe àtìlẹ́yìn fún “ìwé” rẹ) tí mo gbàgbọ́ pé ó ńgbáradì àti ṣíṣe àfihàn ìrònú tí ó l'éwu sí àwùjọ mi.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n Mo yàn LÁTI MÁṢE san èrè fún ẹnìkan (nípa ríra orin rẹ̀ tàbí asọ tàbí ṣíṣe àtìlẹ́yìn fún ''iṣẹ́ ọwọ́'' rẹ̀) eyití mo gbàgbọ́ wipe o dìròmọ́ tí ó sì ńtu àwọn èrò eyiti ó léwu sí àwùjọ mi jáde lẹ́nu.

rows.source: He is free.
rows.output: Ó ní òmìnira.
rows.reference: Ó ní òmìnira.

rows.source: So are we," she added.
rows.output: Nítorí náà, a tún wà," ó ṣàfikún.
rows.reference: Bẹ́ẹ̀ni àwa náà,'' ni ó fi kún un.

rows.source: Before the show, the rapper announced on Twitter that he had changed his name, saying that he was now "the being formally known as Kanye West."
rows.output: Kí ṣáájú eré náà, olórin náà kéde lórí Twitter pé òun ti yí orúkọ rẹ̀ padà, ní sọ pé òun ni “ẹni tí a mọ̀ sí Kanye West tẹ́lẹ̀.”
rows.reference: Saájú ètò náà, akọrinbíẹnití-ń-sọ̀rọ̀ náà kéde lori Twitter wipe òun ti yí orúkọ òun pada, tósì ńsọpé òun ní báyìí ni ''ẹni náà tíwọ́n mọ̀ tẹ́lệ bíi Kanye West.''

rows.source: He is not the first artist to change their name and follows in the footsteps of Diddy, also known as Puff Daddy, Puffy and P Diddy.
rows.output: Kò jẹ́ ẹni àkọ́kọ́ tí ó yí orúkọ rẹ̀ padà, ó sì tẹ̀lé àwọn ẹ̀ṣọ́ Diddy, tí a tún mọ̀ sí Puff Daddy, Puffy àti P Diddy.
rows.reference: Òun kọ́ni òṣèré àkọ́kọ́ náà ti yóò yí orúkọ wọn padà tí ó ńtẹ̀lé àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ ti Diddy, tíwọ́n tún mọ̀ sí Puff Daddy, Puffy àti P Diddy.

rows.source: Fellow rapper, Snoop Dogg has had the name Snoop Lion and of course the late music legend Prince, changed his name to a symbol and then the artist previously known as Prince.
rows.output: Akọrin ẹlẹgbẹ, Snoop Dogg ti ni orukọ Snoop Lion ati dajudaju akọrin olokiki ti o ku, Prince, yi orukọ rẹ pada si aami kan ati lẹhinna o�ere ti a mọ tẹ́lẹ bi Prince.
rows.reference: Akọrinbíẹnití-ń-sọ̀rọ̀ bí tirẹ̀, Snoop Dogg ti ní orúkọ Snoop Lion àtipe bí a ti ńretí àgbà akọrin tódi olóògbé Prince, yí orúkọ rẹ̵̀ padà sí àmì kan àtipé lẹ́yìn náà òṣèré tíwọn mọ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀ bíi Prince.

rows.source: Attempted murder charge over Belfast restaurant stabbing
rows.output: Ìgbèkùn ìpànìyàn kan lórí ìpànìyàn kan ní ilé oúnjẹ ní Belfast
rows.reference: Ẹ̀sùn ìgbìyànjú láti pànìyàn nitori ìgúnnilọ́bẹ nílé oúnjẹ

rows.source: A 45-year-old man has been charged with attempted murder after a man was stabbed in a restaurant in east Belfast on Friday.
rows.output: Ọkùnrin kan tó jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún 45 ni wọ́n fi ẹ̀sùn ìpànìyàn lé e lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n fà á lọ́wọ́ ìkọlù kan tó wáyé ní ilé oúnjẹ kan ní ìlà oòrùn Belfast ní ọjọ́ Ẹtì.
rows.reference: Ọkùnrin ẹni ọdún márùndínláàdọ́ta kan ní wọ́n ti fẹ̀sùn ìgbìyànjú láti pànìyàn kàn lẹ́yìn tíwọ́n gún ọkùnrin kan lọ́bẹ nílé oúnjẹ kan ní ìlà-oòrùn Belfast lọ́jọ́ Ẹtì.

rows.source: The incident happened in Ballyhackamore, police said.
rows.output: Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà ṣẹlẹ̀ ní Ballyhackamore, àwọn ọlọ́pàá sọ.
rows.reference: Olọ́ọ̀pá sowipe ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà wáyé ni Ballyhackamore.

rows.source: The defendant is expected to appear before Belfast Magistrates' Court on Monday.
rows.output: Oníṣègùn náà ni a retí láti farahàn ní Ilé ẹjọ́ Magistrate Belfast ní ọjọ́ Móndé.
rows.reference: Ẹnití wọn fẹ̀sùn kàn náà níwọn ńretí láti farahàn níwájú Ilé Ẹjọ́ Majisireti ti Belfast lọ́jọ́ Ajé.

rows.source: The charges will be reviewed by the Public Prosecution Service.
rows.output: Àwọn ẹ̀sùn náà yóò jẹ́ àyẹ̀wò nípa Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdọ̀tí Ìdọ̀tí Ìdọ̀tí Ìdọ̀tí Ìdọ̀tí Ìdọ̀tí Ìdọ̀tí Ìdọ̀tí Ìdọ̀tí Ìdọ̀tí Ìdọ̀tí Ìdọ̀tí Ìdọ̀tí Ìdọ̀
rows.reference: Àwọn ẹ̀sùn náà ni wọ́n yóò tún ṣàgbéyẹ̀wò wọn láti ọwọ́ Ilé Iṣẹ́ Ìgbẹ́jọ́ ti Ara Ìlú.

rows.source: Game of Thrones star Kit Harington hits out at toxic masculinity
rows.output: Ìdíje ti àwọn ìtànsán náà ń ṣe, Kit Harington ń kọlu ìbínú akọ.
rows.reference: Ìràwọ Games of Thrones Kit Harrington sọ̀rọ̀ burúku jáde sí ìṣebí-ọkùnrin tólóró

rows.source: Kit Harington is known for his sword-swinging role as Jon Snow in HBO's violent medieval fantasy series Game of Thrones.
rows.output: Ìtàn àrídájú Kit Harington ni a mọ̀ fún ipa rẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí Jon Snow nínú jara eré àrídájú HBO, Game of Thrones.
rows.reference: Kit Harrington níwọ́n mọ̀ fún ipa tókó bíi Jon Snow tó ńfi idà sọ́ọ̀tún àti sósì ninu eré ṣíṣẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé aláàlá ti ààrin ìgbà tósaáju ayé ọ̀lájú Games of Thrones.

rows.source: But the actor, 31, has hit out at the stereotype of the macho hero, saying such roles on screen mean young boys often feel like they have to be tough to be respected.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n òṣèré náà, 31, ti kọ́ àwọn àwòrí ti akọni oníwàásù, ní sọ̀rọ̀ pé irú àwọn ipa lórí iboju náà túmọ̀ sí pé àwọn ọmọkùnrin kékeré máa ń lérò pé wọ́n níláti jẹ́ alágbára láti jẹ́ kí wọ́n bọ̀wọ̀ fún wọn.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n òṣèré náà, ẹni ọdún mọ́kànlélọ́gbọ̀n, ti sọ̀rọ̀ burúkú àwọn tóńṣe bí akọni ọkùnrin náà, tó sì ńs̵ọpé irú àwọn ipa bẹ́ẹ̀ lójú ìbòjú túmọ̀sí pé àwọn ọ̀dọ́mọkùnrin máa ńrò lọ́pọ̀ ìgbà wipe àwọn níláti jẹ́ ẹniti o le koko kí wọ́n tó leè bọ̀wọ̀ fún wọn.

rows.source: Speaking to The Sunday Times Culture, Kit said he believes 'something's gone wrong' and questioned how to tackle the problem of toxic masculinity in the #MeToo era.
rows.output: Ní sọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú The Sunday Times Culture, Kit sọ pé òun gbàgbọ́ pé 'ohún kan ti lọ́wọ́' ó sì béèrè bí a ṣe lè yanjú ìṣòro ìbínú ọkùnrin tó lè léwu nínú àkókò #MeToo.
rows.reference: Nígbátí ó ńbá The Sunday Times Culture, Kit sọpé òun gbàgbọ́ wipe 'ohun kan ti mẹ̀hẹ' tí ó sì béèrè bí wọ́n ti ṣe leè kojú ìṣòro ti ìṣebí-ọkùnrin tólóró náà ninu ìgbà #Me Too Erà.

rows.source: Kit, who recently married his Game of Thrones co-star Rose Leslie, also 31, admitted he feels 'quite strongly' about addressing the issue.
rows.output: Ìwé, ẹni tí ó ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ fẹ́ ìyàwó rẹ̀ Game of Thrones, Rose Leslie, ẹni tí ó jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún 31, sọ pé ó ní ìmọ̀lára “pupọ̀” nípa bíbọ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ náà.
rows.reference: Kit, ẹnití ó ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ ṣe ìgbéyàwó pẹ̀lú ìràwọ akẹgbẹ́ rẹ̵̀ ninu Games of Thrones Rose Leslie, ẹnití òun náà jẹ́ ẹni ọdún mọ́kànlélọ́gbọ̀n, gbà wipe òun náà rò 'lọ́nà tólágbára gidi' nípa mímójútó ọ̀rọ̀ náà.

rows.source: 'I feel personally, quite strongly, at the moment - where have we gone wrong with masculinity?,' he said.
rows.output: "Mo ní ìmọ̀lára ti ara ẹni, gan-an, ni àkókò yìí - kínni a ti ṣe àṣìṣe pẹ̀lú akọni?," ni ó wí.
rows.reference: Ó sope ̣.'Mo rò gidigidi nítèmi, lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ báyìi pé - níbo ni a ti ṣe àṣ̀iṣe pẹ̵̀lú ìṣebí-ọkùnrin?’.

rows.source: 'What have we been teaching men when they're growing up, in terms of the problem we see now?'
rows.output: 'Kíni a ti ńkọ́ àwọn ọkùnrin nígbà tí wọ́n ń dàgbà, ní àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ nípa ìṣoro tí a rí báyìí?'
rows.reference: 'Kínni a ti ńkọ́ àwọn ọkùnrin nigbati wọ́n ńdàgbàsókè, nípa ì̀ṣòró nàà tí a rí nísinsìnyí?'

rows.source: Kit believes television may be partly responsible for the rise in toxic masculinity thanks to its very masculine characters.
rows.output: Kìt gbàgbọ́ pé tẹlifíṣọ̀n lè jẹ́ apá kan nínú ìdàgbà ìbínú ọkùnrin tó lè léwu nítorí àwọn akópa ọkùnrin tó lè léwu.
rows.reference: Kit gbàgbọ́ wipe ó ṣeé ṣe kí ẹ̀rọ amóhùnmáwòrán jẹ́ okùnfà lápá kàn fún pípọ̀síi ìṣebí-ọkùnrin tólóró ọpẹ́ ni fún un nítorí àwọn àbùdá ọkùnrin rẹ̀.

rows.source: He continued: 'What's innate and what's taught?
rows.output: Ó tẹ̀síwájú: 'Kínni tí a bí pẹ̀lú àti kínni tí a kọ́?
rows.reference: Ó tẹ̀síwájú: Kínni ohun tí a bímọ́ni àtipé kínni a kọ́ni?

rows.source: What is taught on TV, and in the streets, that makes young boys feel they have to be this certain side of being a man?
rows.output: Kínni a kọ́ lórí tẹlifíṣọ̀n àti ní àwọn òpópónà, tí ó sì mú kí àwọn ọmọkùnrin kékeré ní ìmọ̀lára pé wọ́n níláti jẹ́ ẹ̀gbẹ́ kan pàtó ti jíjẹ́ ọkùnrin?
rows.reference: Ohun tí a kọ́ni lóri ẹrọ ámóhὺnmáwòran, àti ní àwọn òpópóna, eyiti ó ńjẹ́ kí àwọn ọ̀dọ́mọkùnrin máa lérò wipe àwọn níláti jẹ́ apá kan tódájú ti jíjẹ́ ọkùnrin?

rows.source: I think that's really one of the big questions in our time - how do we change that?
rows.output: Mo rò pé èyí jẹ́ ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìbéèrè tó tóbi jù lọ ní àkókò yìí - báwo ni a ṣe lè yípadà ìyẹn?
rows.reference: Mo ròpé ìyẹn gan-an ni ọ̀kan ninu àwọn ìbéèrè ńlá ní àkókò tiwa - báwo ni a ó ṣe yí ìyẹn padà?

rows.source: Because clearly something has gone wrong for young men.'
rows.output: Nítorí ó hàn gbangba pé ohun kan ti lọ́wọ́ fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́kùnrin náà.'
rows.reference: Nitoripe ní kedere ohun ti o mẹ́hẹ̀ fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́mọkùrin.'

rows.source: In the interview he also admitted that he wouldn't be doing any Game of Thrones prequels or sequels when the series comes to an end next summer, saying he is 'done with battlefields and horses'.
rows.output: Nínú ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò náà, ó tún jẹ́wọ́ pé kò ní ṣe èyíkéyìí àwọn eré Game of Thrones tàbí àwọn àtẹ̀yìnwá nígbà tí jara náà parí ní ìgbà ọ̀sán tó ń bọ̀, ó sì sọ pé òun ti “parí pẹ̀lú àwọn pápá ogun àti ẹṣin”.
rows.reference: Ninu ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò náà o tún gbà wipe òun kòní ṣe èyíkéyìí àwọn àṣesíwáju tàbí àwọn àtẹ̀lé Game of Thrones nigbati ṣíṣẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé náà bá wá sópin ní ìparí ìgbà ooru tókàn, tí ó ńsọpé òun ti 'ṣetán pẹ̀lú àwọn pápá ogun jíjà àti àwọn ẹsin'.

rows.source: From November Kit will star in a revival of Sam Shepard's True West which is the story of a film producer and his brother, who is a robber.
rows.output: Láti November Kit yóò kópa nínú ìmúpadabọ̀sípò ti Sam Shepard's True West èyí tó jẹ́ ìtàn ti olùṣàkóso fíìmù kan àti àbúrò rẹ̀, ẹni tó jẹ́ ọ̀daràn.
rows.reference: Láti oṣù Bélú Kit yóò máa jẹ́ ìràwọ ninu ìsọjí ti True West láti ọwọ́ Sam Shepard eyiti i ṣe ìtàn ti aṣàgbéjáde sinnimá àti arákùnrin rẹ̀, ẹniti o jẹ́ olè.

rows.source: The actor recently revealed that he considers meeting his wife Rose to be the best thing to come out of Game of Thrones.
rows.output: Olùṣèrànwọ́ náà ṣàwarí láìpẹ́ yìí pé ó kà pé ìpàdé aya rẹ̀ Rose sí jẹ́ ohun tó dára jùlọ láti jáde kúrò nínú Game of Thrones.
rows.reference: Òṣèré náà sí ọ̀rọ̀ náà payá láìpẹ́ wipe òun ńròpé pípàdé aya òun Rose lójẹ́ ohun tòdára jùlọ láti jáde síta láti inú Game of Thrones.

rows.source: 'I met my wife in this show, so in that way it gave me my future family, and my life from here on in,' he said.
rows.output: Mo pàdé ìyàwó mi nínú eré yìí, nítorí náà ní ọ̀nà yẹn ó fún mi ní mọ̀lẹ́bí ọjọ́ iwájú mi, àti ìgbé ayé mi láti ibi yìí lọ.
rows.reference: Ó s̵ọpé 'Mo pàde aya mi ninu ètò yìì, nípasè́ ọ̀nà yii ó fún mi ní ìdílé ọjọ́ ọ̀la mi, àti ayé mi láti ibí losi iwaju’

rows.source: Rose played Ygritte, the love interest of Kit's character Jon Snow, in the Emmy award-winning fantasy series.
rows.output: Rose ṣe Ygritte, olólùfẹ́ ti ìtara Kit, Jon Snow, nínú jara fantasy tí ó gba ẹ̀bùn Emmy.
rows.reference: Rose ṣe bíi Ygritte, ìfẹ́ tówuni náà ti ìkópa Kit Jon Snow, ninu ṣíṣẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé aláàlá náà eyiti ó gba àmì-ìdálọ́lá ti Emmy.

rows.source: The couple married in June 2018 on the grounds of Leslie's family estate in Scotland.
rows.output: Àwọn tọkọtaya náà fọwọ́ sí ní Okudu 2018 lórí ilẹ̀ ilé àwọn òbí Leslie ní Scotland.
rows.reference: Tọkọtaya náà ṣe ìgbéyàwó ní oṣù Òkúdu lọ́dún 2018 lórí ilẹ̀ agbo-ilé ńlá ti ìdíle Leslie ní Sikọtilandi.

rows.source: HIV/Aids: China reports 14% surge in new cases
rows.output: Àrùn HIV/AIDS: Ṣáínà ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ìdàgbà 14% nínú àwọn ọ̀ràn tuntun
rows.reference: Ààrùn HIV/Aids: Orilẹ̵-ede Ṣáínà ròyìn ìlọsókè ìdá mẹ́rìnlá ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún ninu àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tuntun

rows.source: China has announced a 14% jump in the number of its citizens who are living with HIV and Aids.
rows.output: China ti kede ilosoke 14% ninu nọmba awọn ara ilu rẹ ti wọn n gbe pẹlu HIV ati Aids.
rows.reference: Orilẹ̵-ede Ṣáínà ti kéde ìfòsókè ìdá mẹ́rìnlá ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún ninu iye àwọn ọmọ ilẹ̀ náà tíwọ́n ńgbé pẹ̀lú ààrùn HIV àti Aids.

rows.source: More than 820,000 people are affected in the country, health officials say.
rows.output: Láàárín àwọn ènìyàn 820,000 ni ó ti ṣe àkóbá, àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera sọ.
rows.reference: Àwọn eniyan tólé ní ẹgbẹ̀rún lọ́nà okòólélẹ̀gbẹrin ní wọn ni ààrun náà ní orilẹ-èdè náà, ni àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ètò ìlera sọ.

rows.source: About 40,000 new cases were reported in the second quarter of 2018 alone.
rows.output: Ní ìdá 40,000 àwọn ọ̀ràn tuntun ni wọ́n royin ní ìdá kejì ọdún 2018 nìkan.
rows.reference: Bíi ẹgbẹ̀rún lọ́nà ogójì àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tuntun ni wọ́n ròyìn rẹ̀ ninu kọ́tà ìkejì ti ọdún 2018 nìkan.

rows.source: The vast majority of new cases were transmitted through sex, marking a change from the past.
rows.output: Pupọ julọ awọn ọran tuntun ni a tan nipasẹ ibalopo, ti o nfihan iyipada lati igba atijọ.
rows.reference: Ọ̀pọ̀ ninu àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tuntun náà níwọn kó nípaṣẹ̀ ìbáraẹnilòpọ̀, eyiti ó ńṣàmì ìyípadà  kúrò ní tàtijọ́ náà.

rows.source: Traditionally, HIV spread rapidly through some parts of China as a result of infected blood transfusions.
rows.output: Ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú àwọn àṣà, HIV ń tànkálẹ̀ lọ́pọ̀lọpọ̀ ní àwọn apá kan Ṣáínà nítorí àwọn ìtọ́jú ẹ̀jẹ̀ tí ó ti ní ìkọlù.
rows.reference: Níti ìṣe tí a mọ̀, HIV ńtàn kálẹ̀ ní kíakía ní àwọn apá orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà kan nítorí àwọn ìfẹ̀jẹ̀tóníkòkòrò ààrùn sínilára.

rows.source: But the number of people contracting HIV in this way had been reduced to almost zero, Chinese health officials said at a conference in Yunnan province.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n iye àwọn ènìyàn tí ń gba HIV ní ọ̀nà yìí ti dín kù tó féré, àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera Ṣáínà sọ ní ìpàdé kan ní ìpínlẹ̀ Yunnan.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọn iye àwọn eniyan tó ńkó ààrùn HIV lọ́nà yìí ni wọ́n ti dínkù sí bíi òdo, ni àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ètò ìlera orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà sọ níbi àpérò kan ni ẹkùn Yunnan.

rows.source: Year-on-year, however, the number of those living with HIV and Aids in China has risen by 100,000 people.
rows.output: Ní ọdún tó kọjá, iye àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ń gbé pẹ̀lú HIV àti AIDS ní Ṣáínà ti pọ̀ sí i ní 100,000 ènìyàn.
rows.reference: Láti ọdún-dé-ọdún, botiwukori, iye àwọn tíwọn ńgbé pẹ̀lú kòkòrò ààrùn HIV àti Aids lorilẹ-ede Ṣáínà ti lọ sókè síi nípa ẹgbẹ̀rún lọ́nà ọgọ́ọ̀rún eniyan.

rows.source: HIV transmission through sex is an acute issue in China's LGBT community.
rows.output: Ìtànkálẹ̀ HIV nípasẹ̀ ìbálòpọ̀ jẹ́ ìṣòro tó ńpọ̀si ní àwùjọ LGBT ní China.
rows.reference: Títaǹkalẹ̀ ààrùn HIV nípa ìbáraẹnilòpọ̀ jẹ ọrọ tóṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ bẹ̀rẹ̀ láàrin àwùjọ ti LGBT lorilẹ-ede Ṣáínà.

rows.source: Homosexuality was decriminalised in China in 1997, but discrimination against LGBT people is said to be rife.
rows.output: Ìfẹ́ akọ tàbí abo jẹ́ ìdàrúdàpọ̀ ní Ṣáínà ní ọdún 1997, ṣùgbọ́n ìdààmú lòdì sí àwọn ènìyàn LGBT jẹ́ ohun tí a sọ pé ó pọ̀.
rows.reference: Ìwà kí ọkùnrin máa bá ọkùnrin lòpọ̀ ni wọ́n ti yọ kúrò ninu ìwà ọ̀daràn lorilẹ-ede Ṣáínà lọ́dún 1997, ṣùgbọ́n ìwà dídẹ́yẹsí àwọn eniyan LGBT ni wọn sọpé ó sìpọ̀.

rows.source: Because of the country's conservative values, studies have estimated that 70-90% of men who have sex with men will eventually marry women.
rows.output: Nítorí àwọn ìye ìwà ìbàjẹ́ orílẹ̀-èdè náà, àwọn ìwádìí ti sọ pé 70-90% àwọn ọkùnrin tí wọ́n ń bá àwọn ọkùnrin ṣe ìbálòpọ̀ yóò wá f'áya.
rows.reference: Nitori ìwà àifààyègba-ìyípadà orilẹ-ede náà, àwọn ìkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ti ṣe àfojúda wipe ìdà àádọrin sí àádọ́ọ̀rún ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún àwọn ọkùnrin tí wọ́n ńbá àwọn ọkùnrin lòpọ̀ ni wọn yóò gbé àwọn obìnrin níyàwo nígbẹ̀yìn.

rows.source: Many of the transmissions of the diseases come from inadequate sexual protections in these relationships.
rows.output: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ìtànkálẹ̀ àrùn wọ̀nyí ni ó ńwá láti inú ìbálòpọ̀ tí kò péye nínú àwọn ìbáṣepọ̀ wọ̀nyí.
rows.reference: Ọ̀pọ̀ ninu àwọn ọ̀nà ìtànkálẹ̀ ààrùn náà ńwá láti inú àwọn àìtó ìdáààbòbò ara ẹni nígbà ìbálòpọ̀ ninu àwọn ìbáṣepọ̀ wọ̀nyí.

rows.source: Since 2003, China's government has promised universal access to HIV medication as part of an effort to tackle the issue.
rows.output: Lati ọdun 2003, ijọba China ti ṣe ileri iraye si gbogbo eniyan si oogùn HIV gẹgẹbi apakan eto lati koju ọran naa.
rows.reference: Láti ọdún 2003, ni ìjọba orilẹ-ede Ṣáínà ti ṣè ìlérí ìráyèsí tókáríayé sí àwọn òògùn ààrun HIV gẹ́gẹ́bí ara ìgbìyànjú kan láti dójukọ ọ̀rọ̀ náà.

rows.source: Maxine Waters denies staffer leaked GOP senators' data, blasts 'dangerous lies' and 'conspiracy theories'
rows.output: Maxine Waters kọ̀ pé òṣìṣẹ́ rẹ̀ ṣe ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn sénétọ̀ Republikani, ó sì ń bu ẹnu àtáǹànkàn “àwọn irọ́ tí ó léwu” àti “àwọn ìtàn ìrònú”
rows.reference: Maxine Walter ńṣẹ́ wipe òṣìṣẹ́ kan ló tú àṣírí àkọsílẹ̀ dátà àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin àgbà ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú GOP, ó sọ̀rọ̀ burúkú sí 'àwọn irọ́ tóléwu' àti 'àwọn ìrònútófẹ́di-òtítọ́ wípé ọ̀tẹ̀ wà'

rows.source: U.S. Rep. Maxine Waters on Saturday denounced allegations that a member of her staff had posted the personal information of three Republican U.S. senators onto the lawmakers' Wikipedia pages.
rows.output: Ààrẹ ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà, Maxine Waters, ní ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta, kọ àwọn ẹ̀sùn pé ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ ti fi àlàyé ara ẹni ti àwọn sẹ́nétọ̀ mẹ́ta ti ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà Republikáànì sínú ojúewé Wikipedia àwọn aṣáájú.
rows.reference: Orilẹ-ede U.S. Aṣojú-ṣòfin kékeré Maxine Walters lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta kọ̀ jálẹ̀ lórí àwọn ẹ̀sùn wipe ọ̀kan ninu àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ rẹ̀ ti ṣàgbéjáde àwọn ìwífúnni ti ara ẹni ti àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin àgbà ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Republican mẹ́ta ti  orilẹ-ede U.S. sínu àwọn ojú-ewé Wikipedia ti àwọn àṣofin náà.

rows.source: The Los Angeles Democrat asserted that the claims were being pedaled by "ultra-right wing" pundits and websites.
rows.output: Ìwé ìròyìn Los Angeles Democrat sọ pé àwọn ẹtọ́ náà ń di títà nípa “àwọn olùfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò tó ga jù lọ” àti àwọn wẹ́ẹ̀bù.
rows.reference: Ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Democrat ní Los Angeles tẹnumọ́ ọn wipe àwọn ẹ̀sùn náà níwọ́n ńwá kẹ̀kẹ́ rẹ̀ láti ọwọ́ àwọn onímọ̀ àti àwọn ojú-òpó ti ''òṣèlú ọlọ́wọ́-ọ̀tún''.

rows.source: "Lies, lies, and more despicable lies," Waters said in a statement on Twitter.
rows.output: "Ìwà ọ̀daràn, ìwà ọ̀daràn, àti àwọn ọ̀ràn ìwà ọ̀daràn mìíràn," Waters sọ nínú ìfiránṣẹ́ Twitter kan.
rows.reference: ''Àwọn irọ́, àwọn irọ́, àti àwọn irọ́ tíkòwúlò,'' ni Walters sọ ninu gbólóhùn kan lórí Twitter.

rows.source: The released information reportedly included the home addresses and phone numbers for U.S. Sens. Lindsey Graham of South Carolina, and Mike Lee and Orrin Hatch, both of Utah.
rows.output: Ìwé ìròyìn tí wọ́n tú sílẹ̀ jẹ́ èyí tí ó sọ pé ó ní àwọn àdírẹ́sì ilé àti nọ́ḿbà fóònù fún àwọn Sẹ́nétọ̀ U.S. Lindsey Graham ti South Carolina, àti Mike Lee àti Orrin Hatch, méjèèjì ti Utah.
rows.reference: Ìwífúnni náà ni ìròyìn sọpé ó ní àwọn àdírẹ́sì àti àwọn nọmba ẹẹrọ ìbànisϙrϙ fún orilẹ-ede U.S. nínú. Àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin àgbà Lindsey Graham ti Gúúsú Carolina, àti Mike Lee àti Orrin Hatch, méjèèjì ti Utah.

rows.source: The information appeared online Thursday, posted by an unknown person on Capitol Hill during a Senate panel's hearing on the sexual misconduct allegations against Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Ìwé ìròyìn náà hàn lórí ayélujára ní ọjọ́ Kẹrìnlá, tí ènìyàn kan tí a kò mọ̀ tí ó wà ní Ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣòfin Capitol Hill ṣe nígbà ìpàdé ilé ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣòfin kan tí ó ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa àwọn ẹ̀sùn ìbálòpọ̀ tí wọ́n fi kan olùdíje ilé ẹjọ́ gíga, Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: Ìwífúnni náà farahàn lórí ojú-òpò ayelujara lọ́jọ́ 'Ru, tí ẹnìkan tíwọ́n kòmọ̀ sàgbéjáde rẹ̀ lórí Capitol Hill nígbà ìgbẹ́jọ́ ìgbìmọ ti Àwọn Aṣojú-ṣòfin Àgbà kan lórí àwọn ẹ̀sùn ìwàkiwà ti ìbáraẹnilòpọ̀ tíwọ́n fi kan ẹnití wọ́n fàkalẹ̀ fún iṣẹ́ ní Ilé Ẹjọ́ Tógajùlọ Brett Kavanaugh.

rows.source: The leak came sometime after the three senators had questioned Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Ìsọ̀rí náà wá lẹ́yìn tí àwọn sẹ́nétọ̀ mẹ́ta náà ti béèrè lọwọ Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: Àṣìrí náà tú lẹ́yìn ìgbà tí àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin àgbà  mẹ́ta náà ti Kavanaugh ní àwọn ìbéèrè.

rows.source: Conservative sites such as Gateway Pundit and RedState reported that the IP address that identifies the source of the posts was associated with Waters" office and released the information of a member of Waters' staff, the Hill reported.
rows.output: Àwọn ibi ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò ìdúróṣinṣin bíi Gateway Pundit àti RedState sọ pé àdírẹ́sì IP tí ó ń ṣe àfihàn orísun àwọn ìfiránṣẹ́ náà ní a so mọ́ ọ́fíísì Waters, wọ́n sì tẹ̀ jáde àlàyé ti ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ staff Waters, ní Hill.
rows.reference: Àwọn ojú-òpò ayelujara ti àwọn òṣèlu tí kìí fààyègba-ìyípadà bíi Gateway Pundit RedState ròyìn wipe àdírẹ́sì IP náà eyiti ó ńdá orísun àwọn àgbéjáde náà mọ̀ ní wọ́n ní àjọṣe pẹ̀lú ọ́fíìsì Waters tí o sì tú ìwífúnni ti ọ̀kan ninu àwọn òsìṣẹ́ Waters kan sílẹ̀, ni The Hill sọ níhú l̀ròyìn rẹ̀.

rows.source: "This unfounded allegation is completely false and an absolute lie," Waters continued.
rows.output: "Ìròyìn yìí tí kò ní ìpìlẹ̀ jẹ́ èyítí kò tọ́ àti irọ́ tó ga jù," Waters tẹ̀síwájú.
rows.reference: ''Ẹ̀sùn yìí jẹ eyiti kò fẹsẹ̀múlẹ̀ ní gbogbo ọ̀nà àtipé irọ́ pátápátá kan ni,'' Waters tẹ̀síwájú.

rows.source: "The member of my staff - whose identity, personal information, and safety have been compromised as a result of these fraudulent and false allegations - was in no way responsible for the leak of this information.
rows.output: "Ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ mi - ẹni tí orúkọ, àlàyé, àti ààbò rẹ̀ ti jẹ́ ìdààmú nítorí àwọn ẹ̀sùn ìfipá-bánilòpọ̀ àti èké yìí - kò ní ìdánilójú kankan fún ìfipá-bánilòpọ̀ yìí.
rows.reference: ''Ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ti àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ mi - ẹnití ìdánimọ̀, ìwìfúnni ti ara-ẹni, àti ààbò rẹ̀ leè ti di eyiti ó ti gbọ̀jẹ̀gẹ́ nitori àwọn ẹ̀sùn oníjìbìtí ati irọ́ - lọ́nàkọ́nà kìi ṣe ẹnití ó ṣe okùnfà títú ìwífúnni yìí síta.

rows.source: This unfounded allegation is completely false and an absolute lie."
rows.output: Ìròyìn yìí kò ní ìpìlẹ̀ kan, ó sì jẹ́ èyítí kò tọ́ àti irọ́ tó ga jù lọ.
rows.reference: 'Ẹ̀sùn ti kòfẹsẹ̀múlẹ̀ yìí ní gbogbo ọ̀nà jẹ eyiti ó jìnnà sí òtítọ àtipé irọ́ pátápátá ni.''

rows.source: Waters' statement quickly drew criticism online, including from former White House press secretary Ari Fleischer.
rows.output: Ìkéde Waters ni kiakia fa ìjìyà lórí ayélujára, títí kan Akọ̀wé Ìbáraẹniṣepọ̀ White House tẹ́lẹ̀rí, Ari Fleischer.
rows.reference: Gbólóhùn Walters fa ìbẹnuàtẹ́síni ní kíákíá láti ojú-òpó ayelujara, àti láti ọ̀dọ̀ akọ̀wé ìròyìn ilé ìjọba White House tẹ́lẹ̀rí Ari Fleischer.

rows.source: "This denial is angry," Fleischer wrote.
rows.output: "Ìdánilójú yìí bínú," Fleischer kọ̀wé.
rows.reference: ''Kíkọ̀jálẹ̀ yìí ńbínu,'' ni Fleischer kọsí ìwé.

rows.source: "This suggests she doesn't have the temperment to be a Member of Congress.
rows.output: "Èyí ń fi hàn pé kòní ìhùwàsí láti jẹ́ ọmọ ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin.
rows.reference: Èyí ńsọpe kòní ìṣeṣí ti ìrònú láti jẹ́ Ọmọ Ilé Ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣojú-ṣòfin Kékeré.

rows.source: When someone is accused of something they didn't do, they must not be angry.
rows.output: Nígbà tí ẹnìkan bá jẹ́ ẹ̀sùn kan tí kò ṣe, kò gbọdọ̀ bínú.
rows.reference: Nigbati a báfi ẹ̀sùn kan ẹnìkan nípa ohun tí wọn kòṣe, wọn kò gbọdọ̀ bínú.

rows.source: They must not be defiant.
rows.output: Wọn kò gbọdọ̀ kọ̀ láti tẹ̀lé àwọn òfin.
rows.reference: Wọn kò gbọdọ̀ jẹ́ olórikunkun.

rows.source: They must not question the motives of the accuser.
rows.output: Wọn kò gbọdọ̀ béèrè nípa àwọn ìdí ti olùfọkànsìn náà.
rows.reference: Wọn kò gbọdọ̀ máa béère àwọn èrèdí ti olùfisùn náà.

rows.source: They must be calm and serene."
rows.output: Wọn gbọ́dọ̀ wà ní ìfọ̀kànbalẹ̀ àti ìfọkàbalẹ̀."
rows.reference: Wọ́n gbọ́dọ̀ farabalẹ̀ kí wọ́n sì dákẹ́jẹ́jẹ́.''

rows.source: Fleischer was appearing to compare Waters' reaction to the Democrats' criticism of Judge Kavanaugh, who was accused by critics of seeming too angry during Thursday's hearing.
rows.output: Fleischer n ṣàfihàn bi Waters ṣe fesi si ibawi awọn Democrats si Onidajọ Kavanaugh, ẹni ti awọn alariwisi fi ẹsun pe o dabi ẹni ti o ni ibinu lasiko igbẹjọ naa ni ọjọẹẹmejì.
rows.reference: Fleischer ńfarahàn láti ṣe àfiwé ìdáhùn Waters sí ìbẹnuàtẹluni tí àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Democrat ṣe sí Adájọ́ Kavanaugh, ẹnití àwọn abẹnuàtẹluni fẹ̀sùn kàn wipe ó dàbí ẹnipé ó ńbínú púpọ̀ jù nígbà ìgbẹ́jọ́ lọ́jọ́ 'Bọ̀.

rows.source: Omar Navarro, a Republican candidate running to unseat Waters in the midterm elections, also voiced his thoughts on Twitter.
rows.output: Omar Navarro, olùdíje òṣèlú Republikani kan tí ó ńwá láti yọ Waters kúrò ní ìdìbò àárín-òru, sọ èrò rẹ̀ nípa Twitter.
rows.reference: Omar Navarro, olùdíje ẹgbẹ́ Republican kan tó ńdíje láti yẹ àga mọ́ Waters ní ìdí ninu àwọn ìdìbò ààrin-sáà náà, bákannáà sọ àwọn èrò ọkàn rẹ̀ jáde lori Twitter.

rows.source: "Big if true," he tweeted.
rows.output: "Big if true," he tweeted.
rows.reference: ''Ó tóbi bí ó bájẹ́ òtítọ́, ní àtẹ̀ránṣẹ́ tuwiti tí o kọ.

rows.source: In her statement, Waters said her office had alerted "the appropriate authorities and law enforcement entities of these fraudulent claims.
rows.output: Nínú ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀, Waters sọ pé ọ́fíísì rẹ̀ ti sọ fún “àwọn aláṣẹ tó yẹ àti àwọn ẹ̀ka ìdájọ́ òfin nípa àwọn ẹ̀sùn ìwà ọ̀daràn wọ̀nyí.
rows.reference: Ninu gbólóhùn rẹ̀, Waters sọpé ọ́fíìsì òun ti ṣe ìtanilóbo fún ''àwọn aláṣẹ tóyẹ àti àwọn ẹ̀ka agbófinró nípa àwọn ẹ̀sùn oníjìbìtì wọ̀nyí.

rows.source: "We will ensure that the perpetrators will be revealed," she continued, "and that they will be held legally liable for all of their actions that are destructible and dangerous to any and all members of my staff."
rows.output: "A ó ríi dájú pé àwọn tó ṣe é yóò di mọ̀," ó tẹ̀ síwájú, "a sì yóò fi ẹ̀sùn kàn wọ́n ní òfin fún gbogbo ìwà wọ́n tí ó lè ba ènìyàn jẹ́ àti tí ó lè léwu fún ẹnikẹ́ni nínú àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ mi."
rows.reference: ''A ó ríi dájú wipe wọn fi àwọn tóṣiṣẹ́ náà hàn,'' ó tẹ̀síwájú, ''àtipe wọ́n mú wọn dáhùn nípa ti òfin fún gbogbo ohun tíwọ́n ṣe eyiti o leè ba nǹkan tí ò sì tún léwu fún gbogbo àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ mi.''

rows.source: Johnny English Strikes Again review - underpowered Rowan Atkinson spy spoof
rows.output: Àyẹ̀wò Johnny English Strikes Again - àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àdàpọ̀ àd
rows.reference: Àtúngbéyẹ̀wò Àwọn Ìkọlu Àìtàṣé ti Johnny English - sọ ẹ̀gàn alamí Rowan Atkinson di aláìlágbára

rows.source: It's traditional now to look for Brexit significances in any new film with a British slant and that does seem applicable to this revival of the Johnny English action-comedy spoof franchise - which started back in 2003 with Johnny English and spluttered back to life in 2011 with Johnny English Reborn.
rows.output: Ó ti di àṣà báyìí láti wá fún Brexit nínú fíìmù tuntun kankan tí ó ní ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, ó sì dàbíi pé ó yẹ fún ìmúpadabọ̀sípò yìí ti Johnny English, eré oníṣé aláwọ̀dà, tí ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní 2003 pẹ̀lú Johnny English, tí ó sì tún bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní 2011 pẹ̀lú Johnny English Reborn.
rows.reference: O tí di àṣà báyìí láti máa fojú wa àwọn ìṣepàtàki Brexit ninu èyíkéyìí sinnima tuntun tí ó ní ọ̀rọ̀ èébú ti èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sìti ìyẹn sì dàbí pé ó ṣ̵̵eé múlò fún ìsọjí ti àṣẹ-ìtaja ẹ̀gàn fún eré  aláwàdà-oníṣegírí ti Johnny English - eyiti o bẹ̀rẹ̀ lọ́dún 2003 ţí ó sì tún padà s'áyé lọ́dún 2011 pẹ̀lú Àtúnbi Johnny English.

rows.source: Will tongue-in-cheek self-satire on the subject of how obviously rubbish we are be the nation's new export opportunity?
rows.output: Ǹjẹ́ ìfọwọ́kan ara-ẹni tí a fi ẹ̀rín ṣe lórí kíkọ́ nípa bí a ti jẹ́ ọwọ́ tí kò dára ni yóò jẹ́ àǹfààní ìtajà tuntun fún orílẹ̀-èdè náà?
rows.reference: Ǹjẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀ ìfọgbọ́nbúraẹni léèébu apanilẹ́ẹ̀rín lórí àkòrí bí a tiṣe ya ọ̀pọ̀ aláìníyelórí tó pẹ̀lu pé a ńjẹ ànfààní tuntun ìkó-ọjàjádesíta ti orilẹ̵-ede?

rows.source: At any rate, the pop-eyed, rubber-faced incompetent Johnny English has had his licence to cock things up renewed for the second time - that name of his signalling more than anything else that he is a broad comic creation designed for non-English-speaking cinemagoing territories.
rows.output: Ni eyikeyi ọran, Johnny English ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni oju ti o ni
rows.reference: Ní gbogbo ọ̀nà, ẹlẹ́yinjú-ńlá, olójú-rọ́bà aláìkójú-ìwọ̀n Johnny English ti tún ṣọ ìwé-àṣẹ rẹ̀ dọ̀tun láti máaṣe nǹkan lọ́nà burúkú fún ìgbà kejì -  orúkọ tirẹ̀ yẹn tó ńfihàn ju ohunkohun lọ wipe ó jẹ́ ìṣẹ̀dá aláwàdà kan tí a ṣẹ̀dá fún àwọn tó ńlọ síbi sinnimá ní àwọn ilẹ̀ tíwọn kìí sọ èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.

rows.source: He is of course the daft secret agent who despite his bizarre pretensions to smoothie glamour has got a little bit of Clouseau, a dash of Mr Bean and a dollop of that chap contributing a single note to the Chariots of Fire theme tune at the London 2012 Olympics opening ceremony.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn olùṣàkóso àṣirí tó jẹ́ aláìlábùkù tó, láibikita àwọn ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ rẹ̀ tó jẹ́ àjèjì sí ìrísí oníṣègùn, ó ní ìdá kan nínú Clouseau, ìdá kan nínú Mista Bìàn àti dollop kan nínú ọ̀dọ́mọkùnrin tó ń kọ́ ọ̀rọ̀ kan sí orin Chariots of Fire ní ayẹyẹ ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ eré ìdárayá London 2012.
rows.reference: Òun ni bí a ti ńretí òpònú ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ́ alami náà ẹnití o jẹ́pé láìka àwọn ẹ̀tàn tóyaṣa rẹ̀ afẹfẹ yẹ̀yẹ̀ aláìlójúrere rẹ̀ sí ti ni kékeré ti Clouseau, bíńtín ti Mr Bean ati ìwọn díẹ̀ ti ẹni yẹn ti fi àkíyèsí kan ṣoṣo sí orin àkọmọ̀nà ti Chariots of Fire níbi ayẹyẹ sísí ìdíje Olympics lọ́dún 2012 ní Lọndọnu.

rows.source: He's also originally based on the traveller and international man of mystery Atkinson once played in the now forgotten Barclaycard TV ads, leaving chaos in his wake.
rows.output: Ó tún jẹ́ ti ìtàn ìrìn-àjò àti ọkùnrin àgbáyé tó jẹ́ olóye Atkinson tí ó ṣe tẹ́lẹ̀ nínú àwọn ìpolówó Barclaycard tó ti gbàgbé, tó sì fi ìdàrúdàpọ̀ sílẹ̀ ní ẹ̀yìn rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Òun tún ni ẹnitójẹ ojúlówo ní idúró lóri ọkùnrin àdììtú arìnrìn-àjò àti ti àgbáyé Atkinson tí wọn ṣe eré rẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀ ninu àwọn ìpolówó Barclaycard tíwọ́n ti gbàgbé báyìí, eyiti ó fi ìdàrúdàpọ̀ sílẹ̀ lẹ́yìn rẹ̀.

rows.source: There are one or two nice moments in this latest JE outing.
rows.output: Àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tó dára kan tàbí méjì wà nínú ìrìn àjò JE tó ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ bẹ̀rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Àwọn àkókò tódára kan tàbi méjì wá ninu JE tuntun tóṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ jáde yìí.

rows.source: I loved Johnny English approaching a helicopter while dressed in a medieval suit of armour and the rotor blades briefly clanging against his helmet.
rows.output: Mo fẹ́ràn Johnny English tó ń bọ́ sí ọkọ̀ òfurufú nígbà tó wọ aṣọ àkísà àtijọ́ àti pé àwọn ẹ̀yà ẹ̀rọ náà ń kọlu helmet rẹ̀ fún ìgbà díẹ̀.
rows.reference: Mo fẹ́ràn Johnny English bóti ńsúnmọ́ ọkọ òfurufú hẹlikoputa nigbati ó wọ kóòtù àtijọ́ ti ìhámọ́ra irin tí àwọn abẹ sí pariwo lòdì sí àsíborí rẹ̀.

rows.source: Atkinson's gift for physical comedy is on display, but the humour feels pretty underpowered and weirdly superfluous, especially as the "serious" film brands like 007 and Mission Impossible themselves now confidently offer comedy as an ingredient.
rows.output: Ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ Atkinson fún ẹ̀rín-ọ̀rọ̀ ni a rí, ṣùgbọ́n ẹ̀rín náà dàbí ẹni pé kò lágbára tó, ó sì dàbí ẹni pé kò ṣe pàtàkì, pàápàá bí fíìmù “óminú” bíi 007 àti Mission Impossible ti ń ṣe ìgbádùn ẹ̀rín gẹ́gẹ́ bí èròjà kan.
rows.reference: Ẹ̀bùn Atkinson fún àwàdà àfojúrí wà lórí àfihàn, ṣùgbọ́n ẹ̀fẹ̀ náà dàbí aláìlágbárá àti eyiti kò wúlò papàá bí àwọn olórúkọ sinnimá ''gidi'' náà bíi 007 àti Mission Impossible fúnrawọn ti ńfi ìgboyà fúnni ní àwàdà bí èròja kan.

rows.source: The humour feels as if it is pitched at kids rather than adults, and for me Johnny English's wacky misadventures aren't as inventive and focused as Atkinson's silent-movie gags in the persona of Bean.
rows.output: Ìrònú náà dàbíi pé ó jẹ́ fún àwọn ọmọdé dípò àwọn àgbàlagbà, àti fún mi Johnny English's wacky misadventures kò jẹ́ ìmúlò tó dára tó àti ìfojúsùn tó péye bí Atkinson's silent-movie gags nínú àkòrí Bean.
rows.reference: Ẹ̀fẹ náà dàbí pé wọ́n jú u sọ́dọ̀ àwọn ọmọdé jú ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn àgbàlagbà, àtipé fún èmi ìrìnkerindò àìtọ́ tí òmùgọ̀ Johnny English kòní àgbéjáde àti àfojúsùn bíi tí àwọn aláwàdà oníìdákẹ́jẹ́ sinnimá ninu àwọ̀n òṣère ti Bean.

rows.source: The perennially topical premise now is that Great Britain is in serious trouble.
rows.output: Ìpìlẹ̀ tó ń ṣeé ṣe lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ báyìí ni pé ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì wà nínú ìṣòro ńlá.
rows.reference: Gbólóhùn ọ̀rọ̀ náà tó ńlọ lọ́wọ́ láti ìgbà dé ìgbà nipé orilẹ̵-ede Great Britain wà ninu ìyọnu gidigidi.

rows.source: A cyber-hacker has infiltrated Britain's super-secret web network of spies, revealing the identities of all Britain's agents in the field, to the dismay of the agent on duty - a regrettably small role for Kevin Eldon.
rows.output: Olùṣàkóso ayélujára kan ti wọ inú nẹ́tíwọkù ìwo ìwojú ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, ó sì ti fi àwọn orúkọ àwọn aṣáájú ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì hàn ní gbogbo ibi, èyí tó jẹ́ ìbànújẹ́ fún aṣáájú tí ó wà lórí iṣẹ́ - ipa kékeré kan fún Kevin Eldon.
rows.reference: Onímọ-kọ̀m̀pútà ajíniníròyìn kan ti rápálá wọ inú oju-òpó ìtàkùn àṣírí-alágbára ti àwọn amì orilẹ-ede Britain, tó sì ńfi àwọn ìdánimọ̀ tí gbogbo àwọn ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ ninu iṣẹ́ náà, sí ìyàlẹ́nu ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ náà tówà lẹ́nu iṣẹ́ - ojúṣe aláàbámọ̀ kékeré kan fún Kevin Eldon.

rows.source: It's the last straw for a prime minister who is a pompous and embattled figure, already suffering a complete meltdown of political unpopularity: Emma Thompson does her very best with this quasi-Teresa-May character but there's nothing much in the script to work with.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ ìdì fún Ààrẹ tó jẹ́ alágbára àti ẹni tí ó ń jà, ẹni tó ti ń jiyàn pẹ̀lú ìjìyà tó pọ̀jù: Emma Thompson ń ṣe ohun tó dára jùlọ pẹ̀lú ìdánilójú yìí tí ó jẹ́ Teresa-May, ṣùgbọ́n kò sí ohun púpọ̀ nínú àtòkọ náà láti ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú.
rows.reference: Ó jẹ́ ohun tóba gbogbo ọ̀rọ̀ jẹ́ fún adarí ìgbìmọ̀ ìjọbà ẹnití ó jẹ́ àwòrán ológe àti ẹnití ogun ńjà kan, tó ńjìyà ìyọ́bí-òrí pátápátá ti òṣèlú tíkò gbajúmọ̀: Emma Thompson ṣe ohun tí ó dára jùlọ tí o leè ṣe pẹ́lù ìwà tí kòfi-gbogbo-arajọti-Teresa-May ṣùgbọ́n kòsí nǹkan púpọ̀ ninu àkọsílẹ̀ eré náà láti ṣiṣ̵ẹ́ pẹ̀lú.

rows.source: Her intelligence advisers inform her that as every single active spy has been compromised, she will have to bring someone out of retirement.
rows.output: Àwọn olùgbaninímọ̀ràn rẹ̀ ní ìmọ̀ ọgbọ́n orí sọ fún un pé nítorí pé gbogbo àwọn ọlọ́pàá tó ń ṣiṣẹ́ lọ́wọ́ ti di ìdọ̀tí, òun yóò ní láti mú ẹnìkan wá láti ìsinmi.
rows.reference: Àwọn olùdámọ̀ràn iṣẹ́ ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ rẹ̀ sọ fún un pé níwọn ìgbàtí ìkọ̀ọ̀kan ninu àwọn àmì ti gbọ̀jẹ̀gẹ́, yóò nílò láti mú ẹnìkan wá láti inu ìfẹ̀yìntì.

rows.source: And that means bumbling Johnny English himself, now employed as a schoolmaster in some posh establishment, but giving off-the-record lessons in how to be an undercover operative: some nice gags here, as English offers a School of Rock-type academy of spying.
rows.output: Àti pé ìyẹn túmọ̀ sí Johnny English tó ń ṣe àṣìṣe, tó sì ń ṣiṣẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí olùkọ́ ní ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ tó ga jù lọ, ṣùgbọ́n ó ń fún àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ní ẹ̀kọ́ tí kò jẹ́ ìwé àkọsílẹ̀ nípa bí a ṣe lè jẹ́ olùṣàkóso: àwọn gags tó dára níbí, bí English ṣe ń fún ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ Rock-type Academy of spying.
rows.reference: Àtipé ìyẹn túmọ̀ si Johnny English aláìlọ́wọ́ fúnrarẹ̀, tíwọn ti fún níṣẹ́ bíi ọ̀gá ilé ìwé nílé iṣẹ́ tódùn un wò kan, ṣùgbọ́n fífún ni àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ aílàlákọsílẹ̀ nipa bí a ti ńjẹ́ òṣìṣẹ́ ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ̀ kan: àwọn ẹ̀fẹ̀ apanilẹ́ẹ̀rín níbí, bí English sooe ńfúnni ni irúfẹ́-Ilé-ìwé-ti-Àpáta ilé ẹ̀kọ́ ti amí ṣíṣe.

rows.source: English is whisked back to Whitehall for an emergency briefing and reunited with his former long-suffering sidekick Bough, played again by Ben Miller.
rows.output: Ẹ̀dá èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì padà sí Whitehall fún ìpàdé pàjáwìrì, wọ́n sì tún pín pẹ̀lú aláàrín-ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀, Bough, tí Ben Miller ṣe.
rows.reference: English níwọn ti gbé padà ní kíákía sí Whitehall fún ìbanisọ̀rọ̀ pàjáwìrì tí ó sì túnwà níṣọ̀kan pẹ̀lú ọ̀rẹ́ tímọ́tímọ́ tóńjìyà fúngbà pípẹ́ Bough, tí wọn ṣe eré rẹ̵̀ lẹ́ẹ́kan síi láti ọwọ́ Ben Miller.

rows.source: Bough is now a married man, hitched to a submarine commander, a jolly-hockey-sticks role in which Vicki Pepperdine is a bit wasted.
rows.output: Bough ni bayi ọmọbinrin ti o ti fẹ, ti o ti f'ẹ si ọmọ ogun ọkọ oju omi, ipa ere hockey ti Vicki Pepperdine ti o ti fẹnu.
rows.reference: Bough ní báyìí ti dí ọkùnrin tóti gbéyàwó kan, tíwọn sọ mọ́ balógun ọko ogun abẹ́-omi kan, ipa àwọn igi bọ́ọ̀lú-àfigigbá onídùnnú kan ninu eyiti wọn ti fi Vicki Pepperdine ṣòfo díẹ̀.

rows.source: So the Batman and Robin of getting things terribly wrong on Her Majesty's Secret Service are back in action, encountering Olga Kurylenko's beautiful femme fatale Ophelia Bulletova.
rows.output: Nítorí náà, Batman àti Robin ti ń ṣe àwọn ohun tí ó burú jù lọ ní Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé Ìṣé
rows.reference: Nítorínáà Batman àti Robin ti mimu àwọn nǹkan mẹ̀hẹ gidigidi níbi Iṣ̵ẹ́ Ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyẹ̵́ ti Ọbabìnrin Ọlọ́lá Jùlọ ti padà sẹnu iṣẹ́, tíwọn sì ńṣe aláàbápàdé obìnrin àrẹwà amúniṣagbère Ophelia Bulletova ti Olgs Kurylenko.

rows.source: Meanwhile, the prime minister is falling dangerously under the spell of the charismatic tech billionaire who claims he can solve Britain's computer woes: the sinister Jason Volta, played by Jake Lacy.
rows.output: Ní àkókò kan náà, Ààrẹ ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì ń wọ́ inú ewu tó le gan-an lọ́wọ́ ẹ̀bùn ẹ̀bùn ẹ̀rọ tó ń ṣe àfọwọ́gbá tó sì ń sọ pé òun lè yanjú àwọn ìṣòro ẹ̀rọ kọ̀m̀pútà ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì: ẹni tó ń bani lọ́kàn jù lọ, Jason Volta, tí Jake Lacy ṣe.
rows.reference: Ẹwẹ, adarí ìgbìmọ̀ ìjọba ǹsubú lọ́nà tóléwu lábẹ̵́ èèdì ti ọlọ̀pọ̀-èrò oníṣẹ́ ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ olówó rẹpẹtẹ tí ó sọpé òun leè yanjú awọn ìyọnu kọ̀m̀pútà ti orilẹ-ede Britain: aláàrékérekè Jason Volta, tí Jake Lacy ṣe.

rows.source: English and Bough begin their odyssey of farcical high-jinks: disguised as waiters, they set fire to a flash French restaurant; they create mayhem smuggling themselves aboard Volta's luxury yacht; and English triggers pure anarchy as he attempts to use a Virtual Reality headset to familiarise himself with the interior of Volta's house.
rows.output: English ati Bough bẹrẹ irin-ajo wọn ti o kun fun ẹrin: ti a bo bi awọn onídùro, wọn tan ina si ile ounjẹ Faranse ti o tan; wọn ṣẹda idiwọ smuggling ara wọn lori ọkọ oju-omiigaiga Volta; ati English fa aibikita bi o ti n gbiyanju lati lo ẹrọ otito foju lati mọ ara inu ile Volta.
rows.reference: English ati Bough bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìrìn-àjò gígùn ti àwàdà aláriwo kan: wọ́n múra bíi àwọn agbáwo, wọn fi iná sí ilé oúnjẹ tójọjú ilẹ̀ Faranse kan; wọ́n ṣẹ̀dá ìdàrúdàpọ̀ nìbití wọ́n ti ṣe fàyàwọ́ ara wọn wọnú ọkọ̀ oju-omi ọlọ́lá ti Volta; ti English sì ṣe okùnfà aáwọ̀ bí ó ti ńgbìyànjú láti lo agbékọ́rí láti fi ara rẹ̀ mọ inu ilé ti Volta náà.

rows.source: All the stops are certainly pulled out for that last sequence, but as amiable and boisterous as it is, there's quite a bit of kids' TV about the whole thing.
rows.output: Gbogbo àwọn ìdádúró náà ni wọ́n ti fa jáde fún ìparẹ́ náà, ṣùgbọ́n gẹ́gẹ́ bí ó ti jẹ́ aláàánú àti aláwọ̀dá, ó jẹ́ ohun tí ó pọ̀ jù lọ nípa tẹlifíṣọ̀n àwọn ọmọdé nípa gbogbo rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Gbogbo àwọn ibi ìdúró níwọ́n fàyọ pẹ̀lú ìdanílójú fún àtẹ̀lé tógbẹ̀yín yẹn, ṣùgbọ́n bí ó ti jẹ́ eyiti ó fanimọ́ra àti aláriwo aláìkóraẹni-níìjánu tó yẹn, àwọn ohun díẹ̀ ninu TV àwọn ọmọdé wà nípa gbogbo nǹkan náà.

rows.source: Pretty moderate stuff.
rows.output: Àwọn ohun tó dára tó.
rows.reference: Nǹkan alábọ́de tórẹwà.

rows.source: And as with the other Johnny English films I couldn't help thinking: can't the British film industry give Rowan Atkinson a role that really does justice to his talent?
rows.output: Àti gẹ́gẹ́ bí pẹ̀lú àwọn fíìmù Johnny English mìíràn, Mo kò lè ronú: Ṣé ilé iṣẹ́ fíìmù ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì lè fún Rowan Atkinson ní ipa kan tó ń fi agbára rẹ̀ hàn?
rows.reference: ̀Àtipé bí ó ti rí pẹ̀lú àwọn sinnimá Johnny English N kò leè ran ara mi lọ́wó àfi kí ńronú: ṣe ilé iṣẹ́ sinnimá ilẹ́ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì náà kò leè fún Rowan Atkinson ni ipa kan eyiti yóò ṣe ìdájọ́ tòótọ́ sí tálẹ́ǹtì rẹ̀ ni?

rows.source: Labour denies it is devising a plan for Britons to work a four day week but be paid for five days
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ òṣìṣẹ́ náà kọ̀ láti ṣe àgbékalẹ̀ ètò kan fún àwọn ará ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì láti ṣiṣẹ́ ọjọ́ mẹ́rin lọ́sẹ̀ ṣùgbọ́n kí wọ́n sanwó fún ọjọ́ márùn-ún
rows.reference: Ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Labour ṣẹ wipé àwọn ti ńdọ́gbọ́n ètò kan fun àwọn ọmọ ilẹ̀ Britain láti ṣe iṣẹ́ ọjọ́ mẹ́rin lọ́sẹ̵̀ ṣùgbọn kí wọ́n san owó ọjọ́ máàrún fún wọn

rows.source: Jeremy Corbyn's Labour Party is to consider a radical plan which will see Britons working a four day week - but getting paid for five.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ òṣìṣẹ́ Jeremy Corbyn ń ronú nípa ètò tó lágbára kan èyítí yóò jẹ́ kí àwọn ará ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì ṣiṣẹ́ ọjọ́ mẹ́rin lọ́sọ̀ọ̀sẹ̀ - ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n yóò gba owó fún ọjọ́ márùn-ún.
rows.reference: Ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Labour ti Jeremy Corbyn fẹ́ lati ronú nípa ètò tóyàtọ̀ pátápátá kan eyiti yóò rísì kí àwọn ọmọ ilẹ̀ Britain máaṣe iṣẹ́ ọjọ́ mẹ́rin lọ́sẹ̵̀ - ṣùgbọn kí wọ́n gba owó fún ọjọ́ máàrún.

rows.source: The party reportedly wants company bosses to pass on savings made through the artificial intelligence (AI) revolution to workers by giving them an extra day off.
rows.output: Ẹgbè náà sọ pé ó fẹ́ kí àwọn olórí ilé-iṣẹ́ náà fi ìdínkù tí wọ́n ṣe nípa ìyípadà ìmọ̀ ẹ̀rọ (AI) fún àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ nípa fífi ọjọ́ àfikùn fún wọn.
rows.reference: Ẹgbẹ́ náà ni wọn ròyin pé ó fẹ̵ àwọn olórí ilé iṣẹ́ láti fí àwọn ìfowópamọ́ tí wọ́n ṣe nípaṣẹ̀ ìyípadà ọpọlọ àtọwọ́dá sí àwọn òṣìṣẹ̵̵́ nípa fífún wọn ní àfikún ọjọ́ kan láti sinmi.

rows.source: It would see employees enjoy a three-day weekend - but still take home the same pay.
rows.output: Ó máa rí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ náà ní ìsinmi ọjọ́ mẹ́ta - ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n ṣì máa gba owó kan náà.
rows.reference: Yóò ríi pé àwọn òṣiṣẹ́ gbádùn òpin ọ̀sẹ̀ ọlọ́jọ́-mẹ́ta kan - ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n yóò mú iye owó náà lọ ilé síbẹ̀.

rows.source: Sources said the idea would 'fit' with the party's economic agenda and plans to tilt the country in favour of workers.
rows.output: Àwọn orísun sọ pé èrò náà yóò 'dé' pẹ̀lú ètò ọrọ̀ ajé ẹgbẹ́ náà àti àwọn ètò láti yí orílẹ̀-èdè náà padà ní ìfẹ́ àwọn òṣìṣẹ́.
rows.reference: Àwọn orísún sọpé èròǹgbà náà 'ṣe déédé' pẹ̀lú  ètò ọ̀rọ̀-ajé ti ẹgbẹ́ náà àti àwọn àgbékalẹ̀ láti dẹ̀gbẹ́ orilẹ-ede náà fún ojú rere àwọn òṣìṣẹ́.

rows.source: Shifting to a four-day week has been endorsed by the Trades Union Congress as a way for workers to take advantage of the changing economy.
rows.output: Ìyípadà sí ọ̀sẹ̀ mẹ́rin ni Ẹgbẹ́ Ìṣọ̀kan Ìṣòwò ti fọwọ́ sí gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀nà fún àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ láti lo àǹfààní nínú ètò ọrọ̀ ajé tó ń yí padà.
rows.reference: Sísún sí ọ̀sẹ̀ ọlọ́jọ́-mẹ́rin kan ni Ìgbìmọ̀ Ẹgbẹ́ Àwọn Òṣìṣẹ́ ti fọwọsí bí ọ̀nà kan láti ṣàmúlò àǹfààní ti ọrọ̀-ajé tó ńyípadà náà.

rows.source: A senior Labour Party source told The Sunday Times: 'A policy review is expected to be announced before the end of the year.
rows.output: Agbaninimọran ẹgbẹ oselu Labour kan sọ fun The Sunday Times: 'Ipele eto imulo jẹ ohun ti a nireti lati kede ṣaaju opin ọdun naa.
rows.reference: Orísun ọ̀gá Ẹgbẹ̵̇́ Òṣèlú Labour kan sọ fún Sunday Times:  'Àtúgbéyẹ̀wò ìlàna ètò kan ni a ńreti láti kéde saájú òpin ọdún náà.

rows.source: 'It won't happen overnight but a four-day working week is an aspiration that fits in with the party's approach to rebalancing the economy in favour of the worker as well as the party's overall industrial strategy.'
rows.output: 'Kìí ṣe ohun tí yóò ṣẹlẹ̀ lálẹ́ kan, ṣùgbọ́n ọ̀sẹ̀ iṣẹ́ mẹ́rin ni ìfọkànsìn tí ó bára mu pẹ̀lú ọ̀nà ẹgbẹ́ náà sí ìtúnṣòro ètò ọrọ̀ ajé ní ìfẹ́ àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú ọ̀nà gbogbogbòò ẹgbẹ́ náà sí ètò ìṣelọ́pọ̀.
rows.reference: 'Kòní ṣẹ́lẹ̀ ni òòru ọjọ́ kan ṣùgbọ́n ọ̀sẹ̀ iṣẹ́-ṣíṣe ọlọ́jọ́-mẹ́rin jẹ ìmísí kan eyiti ó ṣe déédéé wọnú ìgbéṣẹ̀ ẹgbẹ́ náà láti túnṣe ìmúdúró ọrọ̀-ajé náà fún ṣíṣe ojú rere sí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ àti bíi ọgbọn-àtiṣe ìdáṣẹ́sílẹ̀ ti ẹgbẹ́ náà.

rows.source: The Labour Party would not be the first to endorse such an idea, with the Green Party pledging a four-day working week during its 2017 general election campaign.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ Ìṣiṣẹ́ kò ní jẹ́ ẹni àkọ́kọ́ láti fọwọ́ sí èrò bẹ́ẹ̀, pẹ̀lú ẹgbẹ́ Green tí ó ṣe ìlérí láti ṣiṣẹ́ ọjọ́ mẹ́rin nínú ọ̀sẹ̀ nígbà ìdìbò gbogbogbòò 2017.
rows.reference: Ẹgbẹ́ Òṣèlú Labour kòní jẹ̵̵́ aláàkọ́kọ́ láti fọwosí irú èròǹgbà bẹ́ẹ̀, pẹ̀lú Ẹgbẹ́ Òṣèlú Green tó ńṣe ìléri ọ̀sẹ̀ iṣẹ́-ṣíṣe ọlọ́jọ́-mẹ́rin kan nígbà ìpolongo ìdìbò gbogbogbòò lọ́dún 2017.

rows.source: The aspiration is currently not being endorsed by the Labour Party as a whole, however.
rows.output: Ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ náà kò jẹ́ èyí tí ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Labour gbà gbọ́ lọ́wọ́ gbogbo rẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n.
rows.reference: Ìlépa náà ni gbogbo Ẹgbẹ́ Òṣèlú Labour kò tíì fọwọsí bíi odidi kan lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́, botiwukori.

rows.source: A Labour Party spokesman said: 'A four-day working week is not party policy and it is not being considered by the party.'
rows.output: Agbẹnusọ ẹgbẹ́ òṣìṣẹ́ kan sọ pé: “Ìṣẹ́ ọjọ́ mẹ́rin ni ọ̀sẹ̀ iṣẹ́ kò jẹ́ ìlànà ẹgbẹ́ náà kò sì ń ṣe àbójútó rẹ̀.”
rows.reference: Agbẹnusọ Ẹgbẹ́ Òṣèlú Labour kan sọpé: 'Ọ̀sẹ̀ iṣẹ́-ṣíṣe ọlọ́jọ́-mẹ́rin kan kìí ṣe ìlànà ètò ẹgbẹ́ àtipé kì i ṣe ohun tí ẹgbẹ́ náà ńronú lé lórí.'

rows.source: Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell used last week's Labour conference to flesh out his vision for a socialist revolution in the economy.
rows.output: Ààrẹ John McDonnell lo àjọpọ̀ Labour náà ní ọ̀sẹ̀ tó kọjá láti ṣe àlàyé nípa ìyípadà ìṣọ̀kan rẹ̀ nínú ètò ọrọ̀ ajé.
rows.reference: Olórí Ìjọba Alátakò John McDonnell lo àpérò ti ọ̀sẹ̀ tókọjá ti Ẹgbẹ Òṣèlú Labour láti gbé ìran rẹ̀ fún àyipadà ti òṣèlu ọwọ-òsì ninu ọrọ̀-ajé náà jade.

rows.source: Mr McDonnell said he was determined to claw back power from 'faceless directors' and 'profiteers' at utility firms.
rows.output: Ọgbẹni McDonnell sọ pé ó pinnu láti gba agbára padà lọ́wọ́ àwọn “àwọn olùdarí tí kò ní ojú” àti “àwọn olùókìkí” ní àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ ohun èlò.
rows.reference: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni McDonnell sọpé òun ti pinnu làti fi èékánná gba agbára padà kuro lọ́wọ́ 'àwọn olùdari tíwọn kò lójú' àti àwọn 'àwọn tó ńkórè' ninu àwọn ilé isẹ́ tó ńpèsè ohun ìgbáyé-gbádùn.

rows.source: The shadow chancellor's plans also mean current shareholders in water companies may not get back their entire stake as a Labour government could make 'deductions' on the grounds of perceived wrongdoing.
rows.output: Àwọn ètò tí ọ̀gá àgbà náà ń ṣe tún túmọ̀ sí pé àwọn tó ní ìdá nínú àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ omi lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ lè má gba ìdá wọn padà pátápátá bí ìjọba Labour bá ṣeé ṣe kí wọ́n yọ owó kan kúrò nítorí pé wọ́n rò pé wọ́n ti ṣe ohun tí kò tọ́.
rows.reference: Àwọn ètò olóri ìjọba alátako náà túmọ̀ sí wipe àwọn oníìpín ìdókòòwò lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ ní àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ omi-ẹ̀rọ leè má gba gbogbo ìpín wọn padà nitoripe ìjọba ẹgbẹ́ òṣ̵èlú Labour kan leè ṣe 'awọn àyọkúrò' lori àwọn ìdí ti ìwàkiwà ti wọn lérò.

rows.source: He also confirmed plans to put workers on company boards and create Inclusive Ownership Funds to hand 10 per cent of private-sector firms' equity to employees, who stand to pocket annual dividends of up to £500.
rows.output: Ó tún jẹ́rìsíí àwọn ètò láti fi àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ sí àwọn ìgbimọ́ ilé-iṣẹ́ àti láti dá Àwọn Ìdókòwò Ìṣọ̀kan sílẹ̀ láti fún àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ní 10 ogorun ìdá owó ìdókòwò ilé-iṣẹ́ aládàáni, tí wọ́n lè gba owó ìdókòwò ọdún kan tó lé ní £500.
rows.reference: Ó tún fi ìdí rẹ̀ múlẹ̀ nípa àwọn ètò láti fi àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ sínú àwọn ìgbìmọ aláṣẹ ilé iṣẹ̵́ àti láti ṣẹ̀dá Àwọn Owó Alájọni ti Oníǹkan lati máa fi ìdá mẹ́wàá ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀rún àwọn ìpìn ìdóòkòwò ti àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ aláàdáni fún àwọn abániṣiṣẹ́, ti wọn duro láti da àwọn èrè ìpìn ìdóòkòwò tí ó tó ẹ̀ẹ́dẹ́gbẹ̀ta pọ́ùn sápo.

rows.source: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy tell "60 Minutes" whether the FBI's investigation of Kavanaugh could change their minds
rows.output: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy sọ fun "60 Iṣéju" bóyá ìwádìí FBI ti Kavanaugh lè yí ọpọlọ wọn padà
rows.reference: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy sọ ''Ọgọ́ta Ìṣẹ́jú'' bóyá ìwáàdí ti FBI nípa Kavanaugh leè yí ọkan wọn padà

rows.source: The FBI investigation into accusations against Judge Brett Kavanaugh has delayed a final vote on his nomination to the Supreme Court by at least a week, and raises the question of whether the bureau's findings could sway any Republican senators into pulling their support.
rows.output: Ìwádí FBI sí ẹ̀sùn tí wọ́n fi kan Adájọ́ Brett Kavanaugh ti ṣe ìdádúró ìdúró lórí ìdìbò rẹ̀ sí Ilé Ẹjọ́ Gíga Jù Lọ, ó kéré tán ọ̀sẹ̀ kan, ó sì mú kí ìbéèrè kan wá bí àwọn ìwádìí náà ṣe lè mú kí àwọn sénétọ̀ Republikáànì kan yọ ìtìlẹ́yìn wọn kúrò.
rows.reference: Ìwáàdí FBI náà sínú àwọn ẹ̀sùn tíwọ́n fi kan Adájọ́ Brett Kavanaugh ti dá ìdìbò tógbẹ̀yìn lórí ìfàkalẹ rẹ̀ fún iṣẹ́ Ilé Ẹjọ́ Tógajùlọ duro fún ó kéré tán ọ̀sẹ̀ kan, tí ó sì ńgbé ìbéèrè náà lori boya àwọn ohun ti àjọ náà rí leè sún èyíkéyìí àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin àgbà ti ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Republican láti fa àtìlẹyìn kuro.

rows.source: In an interview airing Sunday, "60 Minutes" correspondent Scott Pelley asked Republicans Sens. John Kennedy and Lindsey Graham whether the FBI could unearth anything that would lead them to change their minds.
rows.output: Ní ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò tí yóò wà ní ọjọ́ Sundee, olùsáré ìròyìn "60 Ìṣéju" Scott Pelley béèrè lọ́wọ́ àwọn Sénátọ̀ Republikani John Kennedy àti Lindsey Graham bóyá FBI lè rí nǹkankan tí yóò mú wọn yípadà ọ̀kan wọn.
rows.reference: Ninu ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹnuwò kan tó ńbọ́ sórí afẹ́fẹ́ lọ́jọ́ Àìkú, akọ̀ròyìn ''Ọgọ́ta Ìṣẹ́jú Scott Pelley béèrè lọ́wọ́ Àwọn Aṣojú-ṣòfin Àgbà John Kennedy àti Lindsey Graham bóyá FBI náà leè tú àṣírí ohunkóhun eyiti yóò darí wọn láti yí àwọn ọ̀kan wọn padà.

rows.source: Kennedy appeared more open than his colleague from South Carolina.
rows.output: Kennedy dà bíi ẹni pé ó ṣí sílẹ̀ ju alágbára rẹ̀ lọ ní South Carolina.
rows.reference: Kennedy farahàn bí ẹnití ó ńkó àkóyawọ́ ju akẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ lati Gúúsù Carolina lọ.

rows.source: "I mean, of course," said Kennedy.
rows.output: "Mo ń sọpé, dájúdájú," ni Kennedy wí.
rows.reference: ''Mo fẹ́ sọ, bí a tì ńretí,'' ni Kennedy sọ.

rows.source: "I said going into the hearing, I said, I've talked to Judge Kavanaugh.
rows.output: "Mo sọ pé n ó lọ sí ìgbọ́ ti ilé ẹjọ́ náà, mo sọ, mo ti bá Onísòfin Kavanaugh sọ̀rọ̀.
rows.reference: ''Mo sọpé lílọ síbi ìgbẹ́jọ́ náà, mo sọ, mo ti bá adájọ́ Kavanaugh sọ̀rọ̀.

rows.source: I called him after this happened, that allegation came out, said, 'Did you do it?'
rows.output: Mo pe e lẹ́yìn èyí, tí ìpinnu náà jáde, tí mo sì wí pé, 'Ǹjẹ́ o ṣe é?'
rows.reference: Mo pè é lẹ́yìn tí èyí ṣẹlẹ̀, tí ẹ̀sùn náà jáde, sọpé 'Ǹjẹ́ ó ṣe é?'

rows.source: He was resolute, determined, unequivocal."
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ aláàánú, aláàánú, aláìlàkàkà."
rows.reference: Ó jẹ́ ẹnití ó ṣọkàn gíri, tóti pinnu, láìsiyèméji.''

rows.source: Graham's vote, however, appears set in stone.
rows.output: Ìdìbò Graham, sibẹsibẹ, han pe o ti ṣeto ninu okuta.
rows.reference: Ìbò ti Graham, botiwukori, farahàn bí eyiti wọ́n ṣètò ninu òkúta.

rows.source: "My mind's made up about Brett Kavanaugh and it would take a dynamite accusation," he said.
rows.output: "Ẹ̀rù mi kò lọ́wọ́ nípa Brett Kavanaugh àti pé yóò gba ẹ̀sùn tí ó lágbára," ó sọ.
rows.reference: ''Ọkàn mi ti pinnu nípa Brett Kavanaugj àtipe yóò gba ẹ̀sùn abúgbàmu kan,'' ni o sọ.

rows.source: "Dr. Ford, I don't know what happened, but I know this: Brett denied it vigorously," Graham added, referring to Christine Blasey Ford.
rows.output: "Dọkita Ford, mi ò mọ ohun tí ó ṣẹlẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n mo mọ èyí: Brett kọ̀ láti sọ pé ó jẹ́ òtítọ́," Graham tún sọ, tó ń tọ́ka sí Christine Blasey Ford.
rows.reference: Ọ̀mọwé Ford, Èmi kò mọ ohun tí ó ṣẹlẹ̀, ṣûgbọn Mo mọ èyí: Brett ṣẹ́ nípa rẹ̀ pẹ̀lù agbára,'' Graham fi kún un, tó ńtọ́kasí Chritine Blassey Ford.

rows.source: "And everybody she names couldn't verify it.
rows.output: "Àtipé gbogbo ènìyàn tí ó ń pè orúkọ rẹ̀ kò leè sọ pé ó jẹ́ òtítọ́."
rows.reference: ''Àtipe gbogbo ẹnití ó dárúkọ̀ kò leè jẹ́ ẹ̀ri sí i.

rows.source: It's 36 years old.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún 36.

rows.source: This Saturday New York will host the Global Citizen Festival, an annual music event which has a hugely impressive line-up of stars performing and an equally impressive mission; ending world poverty.
rows.output: Ní ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta tó ń bọ̀, New York yóò gbalejo Àpérò Àgbáyé ti Citizens, ayẹyẹ orin tí ó ń wáyé lọ́dọọdún tí ó ní àtòkọ àwọn òṣèré tó gbajúmọ̀ tí wọ́n ń ṣe eré àti ìpèníjà tó ṣe pàtàkì; kí ó parí òṣì àgbáyé.
rows.reference: Lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta ìlú New York yóò gbàlejò Àjọ̀dun Ọmọ Ìlú Àgbáyé, ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ orin ọlọ́ọdọdún kan eyiti ó ní lórí-ìlà àwọn ìràwọ̀ púpọ̀ amóríwú tó ńṣeré àti ìlépa amóríwú tóbáa dọ́gba; fífi òpin sí ìṣẹ́ àgbáyé.

rows.source: Now in its seventh year, the Global Citizen Festival will see tens of thousands of people flock to Central Park's Great Lawn to not only enjoy acts such as Janet Jackson, Cardi B and Shawn Mendes, but also to raise awareness for the event's true goal of ending extreme poverty by 2030.
rows.output: Ni ọdun keje rẹ, Ayẹyẹ Ayẹyẹ Ayẹyẹ Agbaye yoo ri ẹgbẹẹgbẹrun awọn eniyan ti n lọ si Meadow Great ti Central Park lati ma gba awọn iṣẹ bii Janet Jackson, Cardi B ati Shawn Mendes, ṣugbọn lati tun mu imọ si ibi-afẹde otitọ ti iṣẹlẹ naa ti o jẹ lati pari òṣì pupọ nipasẹ ọdun 2030.
rows.reference: Ninu ọdún ìkeje rẹ̀, Àjọ̀dun Ọmọ Ìlú Àgbáyé yóò rí ẹgbẹ-ẹgbẹ̀rún àwọn eniyan tó ńrọ́ lọsí Pápá Ńlá ti Central Park láti máṣe lọ gbádùn àwọn eléré bíi Janet Jackson, Cardi B àti Shawn Mendes, ṣùgbọ́n láti tún jẹ́kí àwọn eniyan mọ ìlépa tòótọ́ fún ayẹyẹ naa tííṣe fifi òpin sí ìṣẹ́ tóti bọ́sódi kí ó tó di ọdún 2030.

rows.source: The Global Citizen Festival, which stated in 2012, is an extension of the Global Poverty Project, an international advocacy group hoping to end poverty by increasing the number of people actively fighting against it.
