rows.output: Ba abu mai ban mamaki ba ne cewa Pennsylvania ta 17th tana ganin yawanudun kudi, godiya ga sake fasalin mazabu na majalisar dokoki da ya sanya wasu masu zama a wajen neman kujerar guda.
rows.reference: Ba abun mamaki bane cewa 17 na Pennsylvania yana ganin kuɗi masu yawa, godiya ga sake daidaituwar gundumar majalisa da ya kawo ga masu sarauta biyu a gasar kujera ɗaya.

rows.source: This recently redrawn suburban Pittsburg district pits Democrat Rep. Conor Lamb - who won his seat in another district in a special election last spring.
rows.output: Wannan sabon zanen yanki na birni na kusa da Pittsburg ya sa 'yan jam'iyyar Democrat Rep. Conor Lamb - wanda ya lashe kujerar sa a wani yanki a zaben musamman da aka yi a bazara.
rows.reference: Wannan sabon tsarin yankunan wajen Pittsburg ya haɗda Ɗan Majalisar Jam’iyyar Damokraɗiya Conor Lamb - wanda ya ci kujerar a wata gundumar a wani zaben musamman bazarar da ta wuce.

rows.source: Lamb is running against another incumbent, Republican Keith Rothfus, who currently represents the old Pennsylvania 12th district, which overlaps heavily with the new 17th.
rows.output: Lamb tana gudu da wani mai ci gaba, Republican Keith Rothfus, wanda a halin yanzu yana wakiltar tsohon yankin Pennsylvania 12, wanda ya yi kama da sabon 17.
rows.reference: Lamb yana takarar tare da wani Ɗan Majalisa, Ɗan jam’iyar Republican Keith Rothfus, wanda ke wakiltar tsohon Gundumar Pennsylvania na 12, wanda ya haɗda sosai da sabon na 17.

rows.source: The maps were redrawn after the Pennsylvania Supreme Court ruled in January that the old districts were unconstitutionally gerrymandered in Republicans' favor.
rows.output: An sake zana taswirar bayan Kotun Supreme ta Pennsylvania ta yanke hukuncin a watan Janairun cewa tsofaffin yankuna sun kasance ba bisa ka'ida ba a cikin favor na jam'iyyar Republican.
rows.reference: An sake zane taswirar ne bayan Babban Kotun Pennsylvania ta yanken hukunci a Janairu cewa an haɗe iyakan tsofaffin gundumomin na ba akan shari’a ba dan a yima jam’iyar Republicans ni’ima.

rows.source: The race in the new 17th has touched off a campaign finance slugfest between the major party finance arms, the Democratic Campaign Congressional Committee (DCCC) and the National Republican Campaign Committee (NRCC).
rows.output: An fara yakin neman zabe a cikin sabon matsayi na 17, wanda ya haifar da takaddama kan kudi tsakanin manyan kungiyoyin kudi na jam'iyyun, Kwamitin Yakin Neman Zabe na Majalisar Dokoki ta Democratic (DCCC) da Kwamitin Yakin Neman Zabe na Jam'iyyar Republican ta Kasa (NRCC).
rows.reference: Takarar a sabon na 17 ɗin ya buɗe hanyar gasar kuɗi tsakanin saasan kuɗaɗen manyan jam’iyu, Kwamitin Yakin Zaben Majalisa na Damokraɗiya (DCCC) da Kwamitin Yakin Zaben na Kasa na Republicans (NRCC).

rows.source: Lamb became a familiar name in Pennsylvania after a narrow win in a widely watched in March special election for Pennsylvania's 18th Congressional District.
rows.output: Lamb ta zama sunan da aka sani a Pennsylvania bayan nasara mai karamci a zaben musamman da aka yi a watan Maris na zabenar da majalisar dokokin Pennsylvania ta 18.
rows.reference: Lamb ya zama sanannen suna a Pennsylvania bayan matsatten nasara a wani zaben mussamman da aka kalla sosai a Maris na Majalisar 18 na Gundumar Pennsylvania.

rows.source: That seat had been held by a Republican for over a decade, and President Donald Trump won the district by 20 points.
rows.output: Wajen da ya ke da shi na da jam'iyyar Republican sama da shekaru goma, kuma shugaban kasa Donald Trump ya lashe yankin da kashi 20 na kuri'u.
rows.reference: Wannan kujerar da tana hannun Republican ne fiye da shekaru goma, kuma shugaban kasa Donald Trump ya ci gundumar da maki 20.

rows.source: Political pundits have given Democrats a slight edge.
rows.output: Masu sharhi siyasa sun ba 'yan jam'iyyar Democrat dan karamin fa'ida.
rows.reference: Manazartan siyasa sun ba wa jam’iyar Ɗamokraɗiya ɗan matsatsen sa’ar nasara.

rows.source: U.S. Weighed Penalizing El Salvador Over Support for China, Then Backed Off
rows.output: An yi la'akari da hukuncin da Amurka za ta yi wa El Salvador kan goyon bayan Sin, sai aka janye hakan.
rows.reference: Amurka Ta yi Nazarin Hukunta El Salvador Don Goyon Bayan China, Sai ta Fasa

rows.source: Diplomats noted that the Dominican Republic and Panama had already recognized Beijing, with little pushback from Washington.
rows.output: Diplomats sun lura cewa Jamhuriyar Dominica da Panama sun riga sun amince da Beijing, tare da kadan daga Washington.
rows.reference: Ma’aikatan hulɗa sun lura cewa Jamhuriryar Dominican da Panama sun riga sun shaida da Beijing, tare da ɗan karamin turi daga Washington.

rows.source: Mr. Trump had a warm meeting with President Juan Carlos Varela of Panama in June 2017 and had a hotel in Panama until partners evicted the Trump Organization's management team.
rows.output: Mista Trump ya yi taro mai kyau da shugaban kasa Juan Carlos Varela na Panama a watan Yuni 2017, kuma yana da otal a Panama har sai abokan cinikinsa suka kori tawagar gudanar da Trump Organization.
rows.reference: Mr. Trump ya yi taron fara’a da Shugaba Juan Carlos Varela na Panama a Yuni 2017 kuma yana da otel a Panama har sai da abokanan sana’a suka kori masu gudanar da aikin kungiyar Trump.

rows.source: State Department officials decided to call back the American chiefs of diplomatic missions from El Salvador, the Dominican Republic and Panama over the "recent decisions to no longer recognize Taiwan," Heather Nauert, the department's spokeswoman, said in a statement early this month.
rows.output: Jami'an Ma'aikatar Hulda da Hulda da Kasashen Waje sun yanke shawarar dawowa da shuwagabanninta na Amurka daga El Salvador, Jamhuriyar Dominica, da Panama kan "yanke shawarar da suka yi na kin amincewa da Taiwan," in ji Heather Nauert, mai magana da yawun ma'aikatar a wani bayanin da ta fitar a farkon watan.
rows.reference: Jami’an Sassan Kasa sun yanke hukunci su dawo da manyan ma’aikatan hulɗar Amurka da ke El Salvador, Jamhuriyar Dominacan da Panama akan wannan “hukuncin kwanan nan na daina shaida Taiwan,” Heather Nauert, kakakin sashen, ta faɗa a bayani farkon wannan watan.

rows.source: But penalties were only considered against El Salvador, which received an estimated $140 million in American aid in 2017, including for narcotics controls, development and economic support.
rows.output: Amma an yi la'akari da hukunci ne kawai akan El Salvador, wanda ya samu kusan dala miliyan 140 a cikin taimakon Amurka a shekarar 2017, ciki har da don sarrafa miyagun kaya, ci gaba da tallafi na tattalin arziki.
rows.reference: Amma kawai tara aka yi nazari akan El Salvador, waɗanda suka samu kimanin agajin dala miliyan 140 daga Amurka a 2017, harda kula da kwayoyi, goyon bayan ci gaba da tattalin arziki.

rows.source: The proposed penalties, which included cuts to financial aid and targeted visa restrictions, would have been painful for the Central American country and its high unemployment and murder rates.
rows.output: An ba da shawarar hukunci, wanda ya haɗa da rage tallafin kudi da kuma takaita izinin shiga Amurka, zai yi matuƙar wahala ga kasar tsakiyar Amurka da kuma yawan rashin aikin yi da kuma yawan kashe-kashen da take fuskanta.
rows.reference: Taran da aka yi nazarin, wanda har da yanke agajin kuɗi da kuntatawar takardun izinin shiga, da za su yi zafi wa Kasar ta Tsakiyar Amurka da ke fama da rashin aiki da kashe-kashe.

rows.source: As internal meetings progressed, North American and Central American officials postponed a high-level conference focused on security and economic prosperity to follow up a similar gathering last year that was seen as a step forward in efforts to prevent migrants from heading to the United States.
rows.output: Yayin da tarurruka na cikin gida suka ci gaba, jami'an Arewacin Amurka da tsakiyar Amurka sun jinkirta taron manyan jami'an da suka mayar da hankali kan tsaro da ci gaban tattalin arziki don bin taron da aka yi a shekarar da ta gabata wanda aka ga wani ci gaba a kokarin hana 'yan gudun hijira zuwa Amurka.
rows.reference: A yayin da taron cikin gidan ke guduna, Jami'ai na Arewacin Amurka da na tsakiya sun dakatar da wani taro mai zurfi kan batun tsaro da wadataccen tattalin arziki don bitan wannan taron na bara wanda aka ganshi a matsayin matakin kokarin hana masu gudun hijirar zuwa Amurka.

rows.source: But by mid-September, top administration officials made clear that they wanted the conference to go forward, effectively ending any consideration of penalties for El Salvador.
rows.output: Amma a tsakiyar Satumba, manyan jami'an gudanarwa sun nuna cewa suna son taron ya ci gaba, wanda ya kawo karshen duk wani la'akari na hukunci ga El Salvador.
rows.reference: Amma a tsakiyar watan Satumba, manyan jami'an gwamnati sun bayyana cewa su na so taron ya ci gaba, yadda ya kamata a kawo karshen hukuncin da ake yi wa El Salvador.

rows.source: Vice President Mike Pence is now slated to address the conference, now scheduled for mid-October, in a signal of the import the administration places on the gathering, the diplomats said.
rows.output: Yanzu Mataimakiyar Shugaban Kasa Mike Pence za ta yi jawabi a taron, wanda aka tsara a tsakiyar Oktoba, a matsayin alamar muhimmancin da gwamnatin ke da shi a kan taron, a cewar jakadun.
rows.reference: Mataimakin shugaban kasar Mike Pence yanzu an tsara zai yi bayani a taron, wanda aka shirya a tsakiyar watan Oktoba, a wata alama ta shigo da ayyukan gwamnati a taron, in ji jakadan.

rows.source: And the three American envoys quietly returned to El Salvador, Panama and the Dominican Republic with no new tough messages or punishments from Washington.
rows.output: Kuma masu ba da shawara uku na Amurka sun koma El Salvador, Panama, da Jamhuriyar Dominika cikin shuru, ba tare da wasu saƙonni masu karfi ko hukunci daga Washington ba.
rows.reference: Kuma wakilan Amurka guda uku sun koma El Salvador, Panama da Jamhuriyar Dominica ba tare da sababbin saƙonni ko azabtarwa daga Washington ba.

rows.source: A White House spokesman for Mr. Bolton declined to comment on the details of the debate that were described by the three American officials, including two diplomats, who agreed to discuss the internal deliberations on the condition of anonymity.
rows.output: Wani mai magana da yawun fadar White House na Mr. Bolton ya ki yin tsokaci kan bayanai game da muhawara da jami'an Amurka uku suka bayyana, ciki har da jami'an diflomaɗiyya biyu, wadanda suka amince da tattauna kan tattaunawar da aka yi a cikin fadar White House a kan sharadin rashin suna.
rows.reference: Kakakin Fadar White House Mr. Bolton ya ƙi yin sharhi game da cikakken muhawarar da jami'an Amurka uku suka bayyana, ciki harda ma'aikatan diplomasiyya guda biyu, waɗanda suka amince da su tattauna boye a ciki.

rows.source: Their accounts were corroborated by an outside analyst who is close to the administration and also spoke on the condition of anonymity.
rows.output: An tabbatar da bayanan su ta hanyar wani mai bincike wanda ke kusa da hukumar kuma ya yi magana a kan sharuɗɗan rashin suna.
rows.reference: an tabbatar da bayanansu daga manazarci wanda ke kusa da gwamnati kuma yayi magana a yanayin boye.

rows.source: Study History
rows.output: Yi Nazari a Tarihin
rows.reference: Karanta Tarihi

rows.source: The next shoe to drop could be the special counsel Robert Mueller's report on Mr. Trump's possible obstruction of justice, of which there now is very substantial evidence in the public record.
rows.output: Shinun na gaba da za a yi shi ne rahoton babban mai ba da shawara na musamman Robert Mueller kan Mr. Trump mai yiwuwa ya hana shari'a, wanda yanzu akwai shaidar da ta yi yawa a cikin bayanan jama'a.
rows.reference: Takalmi na gaba da za a sauke zai iya kasancewa na mai bada shawara na musamman Robert Mueller ne rahoto game da yiwuwar tsayar da adalci na Mr. Trump, wanda a yanzu akwai hujja sosai a cikin rajistar jama'a.

rows.source: Mr. Mueller is reportedly also turning his investigation to whether Mr. Trump's campaign colluded with Russia in its attack on our elections.
rows.output: An ruwaito cewa Mr. Mueller kuma yana baje a kan bincike kan ko Mr. Trump ya yi aiki da Rasha wajen kai hari kan zabenmu.
rows.reference: An ruwaito cewa Mr. Mueller ya mayar da akalansa kan gano ko kamfen din Mr. Trump ya hada kai da Rasha a harin da aka yi a kan zabukanmu.

rows.source: Should Congress change hands, Mr. Trump will find himself facing accountability in that body, just as he prepares to go again before the voters, and perhaps eventually a jury of his peers.
rows.output: Idan Majalisar Dokoki ta canza hannu, Mr. Trump zai fuskanci lamarinsa a cikin wannan majalissar, kamar yadda yake shiryaawa don sakeawa a gaban masu jefa kuri'a, kuma wataƙila daga baya a gaban masu kawuna.
rows.reference: idan har majilisar ta chanza hannu, Mr. Trump zai samu kanshi cikin tuhumar daukar alhakin a wannan gamayyar, kamar yadda yake shirin komawa gaban masu zabe, kuma kila ta kasance a tsakanin sa’oin shi.

rows.source: That is a lot of ifs, and I do not mean to suggest that Mr. Trump's fall is inevitable - nor that of his equivalents in Europe.
rows.output: Wannan na da yawa a cikin "idan," kuma ba na nufin cewa faduwar Mr. Trump ba ta da tabbas - ko kuma na masu kama da shi a Turai.
rows.reference: akwai alamomin tambaya da yawa, kuma bawai ina nufin faduwar Mr. Trump ba zai iya yiyuwa ba-kawai na tsaran shi a turai.

rows.source: There are choices to be made by all of us on both sides of the Atlantic that will affect how prolonged the struggle may be.
rows.output: Akwai zaɓuɓɓuka da za mu yi a dukkan ɓangaren Tekun Atlantika da za su iya shafar yadda za a�ɗaƙe ƙalubalen.
rows.reference: Akwai zaɓin da za a yi da mu duka a bangarorin biyu na Atlantic wanda zai shafi yadda za a iya yin dogon gwagwarmaya wata kila.

rows.source: In 1938, German officers were ready to stage a coup d"état against Hitler, if only the West had resisted him and backed the Czechoslovaks at Munich.
rows.output: A shekarar 1938, jami'an Jamus sun shirya yin juyin mulki a kan Hitler, idan kawai yamma ta yi adawa da shi kuma ta goyi bayan Czechoslovaks a Munich.
rows.reference: A shekara ta 1938, jami'an Jamus sun shirya juyin mulki a kan Hitler, idan Yammacin Amurka suka ki shi kuma sun goyi bayan Czechoslovaks a Munich.

rows.source: We failed, and missed an opportunity to avoid the years of carnage that ensued.
rows.output: Mun gaza, kuma mun rasa damar gujewa shekaru na tashin hankali da ya biyo baya.
rows.reference: Mun kasa, kuma mun rasa damar da za mu kauce wa shekarun da aka yi na kisan kai da ya auku.

rows.source: The course of history pivots around such inflection points, and democracy's inexorable march is accelerated or delayed.
rows.output: Hanyar tarihi tana juyawa a kan irin waɗannan wurare, kuma dimokiradiyya ba ta iyaawa ko jinkirta.
rows.reference: Hanyoyin tarihi su na faɗakarwa game da irin wannan matsala, kuma ana tafiyar da dimokuradiyya dole ba tare da sauri ko jinkiri ba.

rows.source: Americans face several of these inflection points now.
rows.output: Yanzu Amurka na fuskantar wasu muhimman wurare na sauyawa.
rows.reference: Amurkawa sun fuskanci da yawa wannan gajiyawar makin yanzu.

rows.source: What will we do if Mr. Trump fires Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein, the man who controls the fate of Mr. Mueller's investigation?
rows.output: Mene ne za mu yi idan Mr. Trump ya kore Mataimakiyar Babban Lauyan Jamhuriyyar Rod Rosenstein, wanda ke da alhakin yanke hukunci kan bincike na Mr. Mueller?
rows.reference: Menene za mu yi idan Mr. Trump ya kori mataimakin Babban mai Shari'a Janar Rod Rosenstein, mutumin da yake jagorancin binciken Mr. Mueller?

rows.source: Rosenstein has been in hot water ever since this paper reported that, last year, he suggested secretly recording the president and speculated about his being unfit for office.
rows.output: Rosenstein ya kasance cikin ruɗani tun bayan wannan takarda ta ruwaito cewa, a shekarar da ta gabata, ya yi shawarar yin leƙen asiri ga shugaban kasa kuma ya yi hasashe game da rashin cancantarsa na zama shugaban kasa.
rows.reference: Rosenstein ya kasance a cikin ruwan zafi tun lokacin da wannan takarda ta ruwaito cewa, a bara, ya bada shawara a asirce ga shugaban kasa kuma ya yi la'akari game da rashin cancantar sa ga ofishin.

rows.source: Mr. Rosenstein says The Times's account is inaccurate.
rows.output: Mr. Rosenstein ya ce labarin Times ba daidai ba ne.
rows.reference: Mr. Rosenstein ya ce asusun Times ɗin ba daidai ba ne.

rows.source: "How will we respond if the newly requested F.B.I. investigation of Brett Kavanaugh is not full or fair - or if he is confirmed to the Supreme Court despite credible accusations of sexual assault and dishonest testimony?
rows.output: "Ya yaya za mu amsa idan binciken F.B.I. da aka nemi a sake yi wa Brett Kavanaugh ba na gaba ba ko kuma ba na gaskiya ba - ko kuma idan aka ba shi damar shiga Kotun Koli duk da zargin da ake masa na cin zarafi da kuma yin ƙarya?
rows.reference: "Yaya za mu amsa idan sabon bincike na binciken F.B.I. na Brett Kavanaugh bai cika ba ko ba gaskiya - ko kuma idan an tabbatar da shi a Kotun Koli duk da kwakwaran zargin da ake yi na cin zarafin jima’i da kuma shaidar rashin gaskiya?

rows.source: And above all, will we vote in the midterms for a Congress that will hold Mr. Trump accountable?
rows.output: Kuma a sama da komai, za mu yi zabe a zaben tsakiya don Majalisar Dokoki da za ta sa Mr. Trump ya zama mai alhakin da ya yi?
rows.reference: Kuma a duka, za mu yi zabe a tsakiyar don majalisar dokoki da za ta rike Mr. Trump da alhaki?

rows.source: If we fail those tests, democracy will be in for a long winter.
rows.output: Idan mun gaza yin waɗannan gwaje-gwaje, demokraɗiyyar za ta yi dogon lokacin sanyi.
rows.reference: Idan muka fadi wadancan gwajegwajen, dimokuradiyya zai kasance a cikin hunturu mai tsawo.

rows.source: But I believe we will not fail, because of the lesson I learned in Prague.
rows.output: Amma ina ganin ba za mu gaza ba, saboda darasi da na koya a Prague.
rows.reference: Amma inada yakinin bazamu fadi ba, saboda darasin da na koya a Prague.

rows.source: My mother was a Czechoslovak Jew who was deported to Auschwitz by the same Nazi regime that once occupied my ambassadorial home.
rows.output: Mahaifiyata ta kasance 'yar Yahudawa ta Czechoslovak wacce aka kwashe ta zuwa sansanonin tarwa da Nazi suka yi wa mulkin da suka yi a gidan jakadancin da na zama.
rows.reference: Mahaifiyata bayahudiyar Czechoslovak ce wacce aka maida ta zuwa Auschwitz ta wannan tsarin mulkin na Nazi wanda ya taba zama a gidan jakadanci na.

rows.source: She survived, immigrated to America and, 60 years later, sent me off to light Sabbath candles on that table bearing the swastika.
rows.output: Ta rayu, ta yi hijira zuwa Amurka kuma, shekaru 60 bayan haka, ta aika ni don in kunna fitilun Sabbath a kan teburin da ke ɗauke da swastika.
rows.reference: Ta tsira, ta yi hijira zuwa Amirka, kuma bayan shekaru 60, ta tura ni zuwa kunna kendir din sabbath a kan tebur din can da ke dauke da swastika.

rows.source: With that as my heritage, how can I not be an optimist about our future?"
rows.output: Tare da haka a matsayin gadon da na samu, ta yaya zan iya zama mai jin daɗin nan gaba?"
rows.reference: Da wannan a matsayin abun gado na, yaya zan zama mai tsatsauran ra’ayi a game da nan gaba ba?”

rows.source: Norman Eisen, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, is the chairman of Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington and the author of "The Last Palace: Europe's Turbulent Century in Five Lives and One Legendary House."
rows.output: Norman Eisen, wani babban jami'in Brookings Institution, shi ne shugaban kungiyar 'yan kasa da kasa don alhaki da dabi'u a Washington da kuma marubuci na "The Last Palace: Europe's Turbulent Century in Five Lives and One Legendary House."
rows.reference: Norman Eisen, babban dan’uwa a ma’aikatar Brookings, shi ne shugaban kungiyar Jama'ar Alhaki da kuma da’a, a Birnin Washington da marubucin "The Last Palace: Rikitaccen karnin Turai a rayuka biyar da gidan tarihi daya.”

rows.source: Rangers' Graham Dorrans optimistic ahead of Rapid Vienna clash
rows.output: Graham Dorrans na Rangers ya yi farin ciki kafin haduwar da Vienna ta Sauri
rows.reference: Rangers' Graham Dorrans yana da yakini gabanin haduwar Rapid Vienna

rows.source: Rangers host Rapid Vienna on Thursday, knowing that victory over the Austrians, following the impressive draw in Spain against Villarreal earlier this month, will put them in a strong position to qualify from Group G of the Europa League.
rows.output: Rangers za su karbi bakuncin Rapid Vienna a ranar Alhamis, suna sane da cewa nasarar da suka samu a kan 'yan kasar Austria, bayan wasan da suka yi da Villarreal na Spain a watan da ya gabata, zai sanya su cikin yanayi mai kyau na samun nasarar shiga gasar Europa League daga rukunin G.
rows.reference: Rangers sun karbi bakuncin Rapid Vienna a ranar Alhamis, inda suka san cewa nasarar da ta samu a kan Austrians, bayan zira kwallo a Spain da Villarreal a farkon wannan watan, zai sanya su cikin matsayi mai karfi don samun damar shiga kungiyar G na Europa League.

rows.source: A knee injury prevented midfielder Graham Dorrans from making his first appearance of the season until the 2-2 draw with Villarreal but he believes Rangers can use that result as a springboard to greater things.
rows.output: Rashin lafiya a ƙafa ya hana dan wasan tsakiya Graham Dorrans ya fara buga wasansa na farko a kakar wasa har zuwa wasan da aka tashi 2-2 da Villarreal, amma ya yi imani cewa Rangers za su iya amfani da wannan sakamako a matsayin hanyar samun nasara mafi girma.
rows.reference: Raunin gwiwa ya hana dan wasan tsakiya Graham Dorrans buga farkon kakar wasa ta bana har zuwa 2-2 da Villarreal amma ya yi imanin cewa Rangers zai iya amfani da wannan sakamakon a matsayin matashi zuwa ga manyan abubuwa.

rows.source: "It was a good point for us because Villarreal are a good side," said the 31-year-old.
rows.output: "Ya kasance wani abu mai kyau a gare mu saboda Villarreal tana da 'yan wasa masu kyau," in ji mutumin mai shekaru 31.
rows.reference: "Wannan maki ne mai kyau a gare mu saboda Villarreal na da kyau," a cewar dan shekaru 31.

rows.source: "We went into the game believing we could get something and came away with a point.
rows.output: "Muka shiga wasan ne da tunanin za mu iya samun wani abu kuma muka fita da maki ɗaya.
rows.reference: "Mun fara wasan da imani cewa mu na iya samun wani abu kuma muka tsira da maki daya

rows.source: Maybe we could have nicked it in the end but, overall, a draw was probably a fair result.
rows.output: Wataƙila za mu iya yin rashin nasara a ƙarshe amma, gabaɗaya, nasarar da aka yi ta dace.
rows.reference: Wataƙila da mun ci su a ƙarshen amma, gaba ɗaya, kunnen dokin yana iya zama kyakkyawar sakamako.

rows.source: They were probably better in the first half and we came out in the second half and were the better side.
rows.output: Tabbas sun fi kyau a rabin farko kuma mun fito a rabin na biyu kuma mun fi kawuna.
rows.reference: Sun kasance mafi kyau a farkon rabin kuma mun fito a cikin rabi na biyu kuma mun kasance mafi kyau gefen.

rows.source: Going into Thursday, it's another big European night.
rows.output: A ranar Alhamis, wani babban dare na Turai ne.
rows.reference: Nufatar ranar Alhamis, wani babban dare ne a Turai.

rows.source: Hopefully, we can get three points but that will be tough game because they had a good result in their last game but, with the crowd behind us, I'm sure we can push on and get a positive result.
rows.output: Ina fatan za mu samu maki uku amma wannan wasan zai yi wuya saboda sun samu nasara a wasan da suka yi a baya amma, tare da goyon bayan magoya bayanmu, na tabbata za mu iya matsawa kuma mu samu sakamako mai kyau.
rows.reference: Mu na fatan, za mu iya samun maki uku amma wannan zai zama matsala mai wuya saboda su na da kyakkyawar sakamako a wasan karshe amma, da taron magoya bayan mu, na tabbata za mu iya turawa don samun sakamako mai kyau.

rows.source: Last year was definitely tough, between everything that happened with my injuries and the changes at the club itself but there's a feelgood factor about the place now.
rows.output: A shekarar da ta gabata ta yi wuya, tsakanin komai da ya faru da raunukana da kuma sauye-sauye a kulab din da kansa amma yanzu akwai yanayi mai daɗi a wurin.
rows.reference: A bara ya kasance da wuya, tsakanin abin da ya faru da raunin da na yi da kuma canje-canje a kungiyar amma yanzu akwai alamun dadi a wurin yanzu.

rows.source: The squad's good and the boys are really enjoying it; the training's good.
rows.output: Tawagarta na da kyau kuma yara suna jin daɗin hakan; horarwar tana da kyau.
rows.reference: Tawagar nada kyau kuma yaran na jin dadi haka; motsa jikin na da kyau.

rows.source: Hopefully, we can push on now, put last season behind us and be successful."
rows.output: Ina fatan za mu ci gaba yanzu, mu bar kakar da ta gabata a baya mu kuma mu samu nasara."
rows.reference: Da fatan, za mu iya turawa yanzu, mu sanya kakar bara a baya don kuma mu ci nasara."

rows.source: Women are losing sleep over this retirement savings fear
rows.output: Mata na rasa barcin dare saboda tsoron ceto kuɗin ritayar su
rows.reference: Mata na kasa barci saboda tsoron rasa kudin ajiyarsu na ritaya

rows.source: Despite the fact that survey participants had a clear idea of how they wanted to be cared for, few people were talking to their family members about it.
rows.output: Duk da cewa masu halartar binciken sun bayyana yadda suke son a kula da su, babu da yawa da suka yi magana da 'yan uwansu a kan hakan.
rows.reference: Duk da cewa mahalarta binciken su na da ra'ayi game da yadda suke so a kula da su, kadan daga cikin mutane su na magana da' yan uwansu game da shi.

rows.source: About half of the individuals in the Nationwide study said they were speaking with their spouses about the cost of long-term care.
rows.output: Kusan rabin mutanen da ke cikin binciken na ƙasa sun ce suna magana da abokan tarayyarsu game da kuɗin kula da su na tsawon lokaci.
rows.reference: Kusan rabin mutane a nazarin duk kasar sun ce su na magana da matansu game da kudin da ake kulawa da dadewa.

rows.source: Only 10 percent said they spoke with their kids about it.
rows.output: Kawai kashi 10 na mutanen sun ce suna magana da yaransu a kan hakan.
rows.reference: Kashi 10 bisa dari ne kawai sukayi magana da yayan su game da haka.

rows.source: "People want a family member to care for them, but they aren't taking the steps to have the conversation," said Holly Snyder, vice president of Nationwide's life insurance business.
rows.output: "Mutane suna son wani daga cikin 'yan uwa ya kula da su, amma ba sa ɗaukar matakin da ya dace don su yi magana a kan hakan," in ji Holly Snyder, mataimakiyar shugaban kamfanin Nationwide na harkokin inshorar rayuwa.
rows.reference: "Mutane su na son dangi su kula da su, amma ba su daukan matakai don tattaunawa," in ji Holly Snyder, Mataimakin Shugaban Hukumar Harkokin inshura.

rows.source: Here's where to begin.
rows.output: Ga inda za ka fara.
rows.reference: Ga inda za a fara.

rows.source: Talk to your spouse and the kids: You can't prepare your family to provide care if you don't make your wishes known well ahead of time.
rows.output: Ka yi magana da matar da yara: Ba za ka shirya iyalanka don su samar da kulawa ba idan ba ka yi wa iyalanka bayani ba kafin lokacin.
rows.reference: Kayi ma matar ka magana da yaran: Bazaka iya shirya iyalin ka don samun kulawa ba idan baka bayyanar da fatan ka an sani ba kafin lokaci.

rows.source: Work with your advisor and your family to discuss where and how to receive care, as those choices can be a significant factor in determining the cost.
rows.output: Ka yi aiki da mai ba ka shawara da kuma iyalanka domin tattaunawa kan inda da kuma yadda za ka samu kulawa, saboda waɗannan zaɓuɓɓukan na iya zama babban abu wajen tantance farashi.
rows.reference: Kayi aiki da masu baka shawara da iyalin ka don tattauna ina da yanda za’a karbi kulawa, don wadannan zabubbukan nada muhimman abubuwa don kayyade kudin.

rows.source: Bring in your financial advisor: Your advisor can also help you come up with a way to pay for those expenses.
rows.output: Kawo mai kula da kudi: Mai kula da kudi zai iya taimaka maka wajen fitar da hanyar biyan kuɗin waɗannan kuɗin.
rows.reference: Shigo da mai bada shawara akan harkokin kudin ka: Mai baka shawara na iya taimaka maka ne wajen nuna maka hanyoyin da zaka iya biyan wadancan kudin da aka kashe.

rows.source: Your funding choices for long-term care can include a traditional long-term care insurance policy, a hybrid cash-value life insurance policy to help cover these expenses or self-insuring with your own wealth - as long as you have the money.
rows.output: Zabin kuɗin da za ku yi na kula da dogon lokaci ya haɗa da: tsarin inshorar kula da dogon lokaci na gargajiya, tsarin inshorar rayuwa mai daraja mai daraja don taimakawa wajen biyan kuɗin waɗannan abubuwan, ko kuma ku yi wa kanku kuɗi - idan kuna da kuɗi.
rows.reference: Zaɓen kuɗin daukar nauyin ka na kulawar dogon zangona iya haɗawa da manufofin inshora na kula da dogon zango na gargajiya, wani matashin manufofin inshoran muhimmancin kudi don taimakawa wajen rufe wadancan kudaden da aka kashe ko inshoran kai da kudin ka -matukar kanada kudin.

rows.source: Hammer out your legal documents: Head off legal battles at the pass.
rows.output: Ƙara ƙudirin shari'a: Ka yi nasara a faɗan shari'a kafin ya yi yawa.
rows.reference: Fito da takaddun shari’ar ka: Kashe fadace-fadace na doka a lokacin baya.

rows.source: Get a health-care proxy in place so that you designate a trusted individual to oversee your medical care and ensure that professionals comply with your wishes in case you're unable to communicate.
rows.output: Samu wani mai kula da lafiyarka ya zama mai kula da lafiyarka, don haka ka sanya wani wanda ka yarda da shi ya kula da lafiyarka da kuma tabbatar da cewa likitoci sun bi buƙatunka idan ka kasa magana.
rows.reference: Nemi wani wakili na kiwon lafiya a wurin domin ka zaɓi mutumin da ka amincema don kula da lafiyar ya kuma tabbatar da cewa kwararru sunbi bukatun ka koda ka kasa magana.

rows.source: Also, consider a power of attorney for your finances.
rows.output: Haka kuma, ka yi la'akari da wani ikon bayar da umarni na doka game da harkokin kudi.
rows.reference: Har ila yau, kayi la'akari da ikon lauya don kudaden ka.

rows.source: You would select a trusted person to make financial decisions for you and ensure your bills get paid if you're incapacitated.
rows.output: Za ka zaɓa mutum mai yarda da shi domin ya yanke hukunci a kan kuɗin ka kuma ka tabbatar da cewa an biya kuɗin ka idan ka kamu da rashin lafiya.
rows.reference: Zaka zabi mutum daya da ka yarda da shi don yanke shawara game da kudaden ka da kuma tabbatar da an biya cajin kudade koda bazaka iya biya ba.

rows.source: Don't forget the small details: Imagine that your elderly parent has a medical emergency and is on the way to the hospital.
rows.output: Kada ka manta da ƙananan bayanai: Yi tunanin cewa iyayenkana na tsufa suna da matsalar rashin lafiya kuma suna kan hanyar zuwa asibitin.
rows.reference: kar ka manta da kananan cikakkun bayanan: Ka yi tunanin cewa iyayen ka tsofaffi su na da cuta mai bukatar taimakon gaggawa kuma su na kan hanyar zuwa asibiti.

rows.source: Would you be able to answer questions on medications and allergies?
rows.output: Shin za ka iya amsa tambayoyin da suka shafi magunguna da kuma rashin lafiya?
rows.reference: Zaka iya amsa tambayoyi game da magunguna da cututtuka?

rows.source: Spell out those details in a written plan so that you're ready.
rows.output: Ka bayyana waɗannan bayanai a cikin wani tsari na rubutu don haka ka shirya.
rows.reference: Rubuta wadannan cikakkun bayanan a shiryayyen rubutu don ka shirya.

rows.source: "It's not just the financials that are in play, but who are the doctors?" asked Martin.
rows.output: "Ba wai kawai kuɗin da ake magana a kai ba ne, amma wa su likitoci ne?" Martin ya tambaya.
rows.reference: "Ba wai kudi kawai ake magana ba, amma suwaye likitocin?" Martin ya tambaya.

rows.source: "What are the medications?
rows.output: "Me ake amfani da magunguna?"
rows.reference: “Menene magungunan?

rows.source: Who will care for the dog?
rows.output: Wa zai kula da karen?
rows.reference: Wa zai kula da karen?

rows.source: Have that plan in place."
rows.output: Ka samu tsarin a wajen."
rows.reference: ka samu wannan shirin a rai.”

rows.source: Man shot multiple times with air rifle in Ilfracombe
rows.output: An harbe mutum da bindigar iska a Ilfracombe
rows.reference: An harbe mutum sau da yawa da bindigar iska a Ilfracombe

rows.source: A man has been shot multiple times with an air rifle as he walked home from a night out.
rows.output: Wani mutum ya samu bugu da bindigar iska yayin da yake tafiya gida daga lokacin da ya fita.
rows.reference: An harbi wani mutum sau da yawa da bindigar iska yayin da yake tafiya gida daga fitar dare.

rows.source: The victim, in his 40s, was in the Oxford Grove area of Ilfracombe, Devon, when he was shot in the chest, abdomen and hand.
rows.output: Wanda aka azabtar, wanda yake cikin shekarun 40, yana cikin yankin Oxford Grove na Ilfracombe, Devon, lokacin da aka harbe shi a kirji, ciki, da hannu.
rows.reference: Wanda aka harban, yana cikin shekarunsa na 40, yana yankin Oxford Grove din llfracombe, Devon, a yayin da aka harbe shi a kirji, cibiya da hannu.

rows.source: Officers described the shooting, which took place at about 02:30 BST, as a "random act."
rows.output: An bayyana harbin da ya faru ne da misalin ƙarfe 2:30 na safe, a matsayin "aiki na bazuwar."
rows.reference: Jami’an sun bayyana harbin, wanda ya gudana da misalin 02:30 BST, a matsayin “mai aukuwa akai-akai.”

rows.source: The victim did not see his attacker.
rows.output: Wanda aka azabtar ba ya ganin wanda ya azabtar da shi.
rows.reference: Wanda aka harban baiga wanda ya harbe shi ba.

rows.source: His injuries are not life-threatening and police have appealed for witnesses.
rows.output: Raunukansa ba su da hatsari ga rayuwar sa kuma 'yan sanda sun yi kira ga shaidu.
rows.reference: Raunukan shi ba masu barazana ga rayuwa bane kuma yan sanda na rokon shaidu su fito.

rows.source: Earthquakes and tsunamis in Indonesia
rows.output: Girgizar ƙasa da tsunami a Indonesia
rows.reference: Girgizar kasa da tsunamis a Indonesia

rows.source: At least 384 people have been killed by a powerful earthquake and tsunami that hit the Indonesian city of Palu on Friday, officials said, with the death toll expected to rise.
rows.output: Aƙalla mutane 384 ne aka kashe a cikin wani babban girgizar ƙasa da tsunami da suka afku a birnin Palu na Indonesia a ranar Juma'a, a cewar jami'an, tare da yawan asarar rayuka da ake sa ran za su ƙaru.
rows.reference: Akalla mutane 384 ne suka rasa rayukansu sakamakon wani girgizar kasa da tsunami mai tsanani da suka faru a birnin Palu ranar Juma’a, Jami'an suka ce, ana sa ran karuwar waɗanda suka mutu.

rows.source: With communications knocked out, relief officials have not been able to get any information from Donggala regency, an area north of Palu that is closer to the epicenter of the 7.5 magnitude quake.
rows.output: Tare da sadarwa ta lalace, jami'an agajin gaggawa ba su iya samun wani bayani daga yankin Donggala, wanda ke arewa da Palu, kuma kusa da tsakiyar girgizar ƙasa mai karfin 7.5.
rows.reference: Saboda rashin hanyar sadarwa, jami'an tsaro ba su samu kowane bayani daga Donggala regency ba, wani yanki a arewacin Palu wanda ya fi kusa da farfadowar girgizar kasa mai karfin 7.5.

rows.source: In Palu, more than 16,000 people were evacuated after the disaster struck.
rows.output: A Palu, sama da mutane 16,000 an kwashe su bayan faruwar lamarin.
rows.reference: A Palu, an kwashe mutane fiye da 16,000 bayan da bala'in ya fara.

rows.source: Here are some key facts about Palu and Donggala, on the island of Sulawesi:
rows.output: Ga wasu muhimman bayanai game da Palu da Donggala, a tsibirin Sulawesi:
rows.reference: Ga wadansu bayanai game da Palu da Donggala, akan tsibirin Sulawesi:

rows.source: Palu is the capital of Central Sulawesi province, located at the end of a narrow bay on the west coast of Sulawesi island, with an estimated population of 379,800 in 2017.
rows.output: Palu shine babban birnin yankin Sulawesi ta tsakiya, wanda yake a ƙarshen wani kunkurun teku a gabar tekun yammacin tsibirin Sulawesi, tare da yawan jama'a kusan 379,800 a shekarar 2017.
rows.reference: Palu shi ne babban birnin lardin Sulawesi na tsakiya, wanda yake a ƙarshen bakin teku a yammacin bakin tekun tsibirin Sulawesi, tare da kimanin mutane 379,800 a 2017.

rows.source: The city was celebrating its 40th anniversary when the quake and tsunami hit.
rows.output: Birnin na bikin cikar shekaru 40 da suka gabata lokacin da girgizar ƙasar da tsunami suka afku.
rows.reference: Birnin yana bikin tunawa da shekaru 40 a lokacin da girgizar kasa da tsunami suka fara.

rows.source: Donggala is a regency stretching along more than 300 km (180 miles) of coastline in the northwest of Sulawesi island.
rows.output: Donggala yanki ne da ke da tsawon layi fiye da 300 km (180 mil) na bakin tekun a arewa maso yammacin tsibirin Sulawesi.
rows.reference: Donggala wani tsari ne wanda ke tafiya fiye da kilomita 300 (kilomita 180) na bakin teku a arewa maso yammacin tsibirin Sulawesi.

rows.source: The regency, an administrative region below a province, had an estimated population of 299,200 in 2017.
rows.output: Mallakar mulki, yanki na gudanarwa a ƙasa da larduna, yana da yawan jama'a kusan 299,200 a shekarar 2017.
rows.reference: Tsarin mulki, wani yanki na kasa da ke ƙasa a lardin, nada kimanin mutane 299,200 a shekarar 2017.

rows.source: Fishing and farming are the mainstays of the Central Sulawesi province's economy, especially the coastal region of Donggala.
rows.output: Kifi da noma sune manyan abubuwan da ke haifar da tattalin arzikin yankin Sulawesi ta tsakiya, musamman yankin bakin teku na Donggala.
rows.reference: su da aikin noma sune ainihin yanayin tattalin arzikin lardin Sulawesi, musamman ma yankunan bakin teku na Donggala.

rows.source: Nickel mining is also important in the province, but is mostly concentrated in Morowali, on the opposite coast of Sulawesi.
rows.output: Hako nickel ma yana da muhimmanci a lardin, amma ana yawan mayar da hankali ne a Morowali, a gefenin wani yanki na Sulawesi.
rows.reference: Nickel mining ma yana da mahimmanci a lardin, amma mafi yawa ya fi mayar da hankali ne a Morowali, a gefen kudancin Sulawesi.

rows.source: Palu and Donggala have been hit by tsunamis several times in the past 100 years, according to Indonesia's Disaster Mitigation Agency.
rows.output: Palu da Donggala sun fuskanci tsunami sau da yawa a cikin shekaru 100 da suka gabata, a cewar Hukumar Kula da Bala'i ta Indonesia.
rows.reference: Paman da Donggala sun sha samun aukuwar tsunamis a cikin shekaru 100 da suka gabata, in ji kamfanin Indonesia's Disaster Mitigation.

rows.source: In 1938, a tsunami killed more than 200 people and destroyed hundreds of houses in Donggala.
rows.output: A shekarar 1938, tsunami ya kashe sama da mutane 200 kuma ya lalata gidaje da dama a Donggala.
rows.reference: A 1938, tsunami ya kashe mutane fiye da 200 kuma ya hallaka daruruwan gidaje a Donggala.

rows.source: A tsunami also struck western Donggala in 1996, killing nine.
rows.output: Wani tsunami ya afku a yammacin Donggala a shekarar 1996, wanda ya kashe mutane tara.
rows.reference: Wani tsunami kuma ya bugi yammacin Donggala a shekarar 1996, ya kashe mutane tara.

rows.source: Indonesia sits on the seismically Pacific Ring of Fire and is regularly hit by earthquakes.
rows.output: Indonesiya tana kan layin seismic na Pacific Ring of Fire kuma sau da yawa ana bugu da girgizar ƙasa.
rows.reference: Indonesia na zaune a kan tsaunuka na Pacific Ring na Wuta kuma girgizar kasa na yawan samunsu.

rows.source: Here are some of the major quakes and tsunamis in recent years:
rows.output: Ga wasu daga cikin manyan girgizar ƙasa da tsunami a cikin shekarun nan:
rows.reference: Ga wasu manyan girgizar ƙasa da tsunami a cikin 'yan shekarun nan:

rows.source: 2004: A major quake on the western coast of Indonesia's Aceh province in northern Sumatra on Dec. 26 triggered a tsunami that struck 14 countries, killing 226,000 people along Indian Ocean coastline, more than half of them in Aceh.
rows.output: 2004: Wani babban girgizar ƙasa a gabar tekun yammacin Indonesia a lardunan Aceh a arewa maso yammacin Sumatra a ranar 26 ga Disamba ya haifar da tsunami wanda ya shafa kasashe 14, inda ya kashe mutane 226,000 a gabar tekun Tekun Indiya, fiye da rabin su a Aceh.
rows.reference: 2004: Babban girgizar kasa a yammacin tekun Aceh dake arewacin Sumatra a ranar 26 ga Disamban bara ya haifar da tsunami wanda ya shafi kasashe 14, inda ya kashe mutane 226,000 a bakin tekun Indiya, fiye da rabin su a Aceh.

rows.source: 2005: A series of strong quakes hit the western coast of Sumatra in late March and early April.
rows.output: 2005: An yi jerin girgizar ƙasa mai ƙarfi a gabar tekun yammacin Sumatra a karshen Maris da farkon Afrilu.
rows.reference: 2005: Jerin girgizar kasa ya faru a yammacin tsibirin Sumatra a cikin karshen Maris da farkon Afrilu.

rows.source: Hundreds died in Nias Island, off the coast of Sumatra.
rows.output: Dubbai sun mutu a tsibirin Nias, a gabar tekun Sumatra.
rows.reference: Daruruwa sun mutu a tsibirin Nias, a bakin tekun Sumatra.

rows.source: 2006: A 6.8 magnitude hit south of Java, Indonesia's most populated island, triggering a tsunami that smashed into the southern coast, killing nearly 700 people.
rows.output: 2006: Wani girgizar ƙasa mai ƙarfi 6.8 a kudu da Java, tsibirin da ke da yawan jama'a a Indonesia, ya haifar da tsunami wanda ya bugi gabar tekun kudu, inda ya kashe kusan mutane 700.
rows.reference: 2006: Girman 6.8 auku a kudancin Java, tsibirin da yafi kowanne cika a Indonesia, wanda ya haifar da tsunami wanda ya shiga har kudancin bakin teku, inda ya kashe kusan mutane 700.

rows.source: 2009: A 7.6 magnitude quake struck near the city of Padang, capital of West Sumatra province.
rows.output: 2009: Wani girgizar ƙasa mai girma 7.6 ya afku kusa da birnin Padang, babban birnin yankin West Sumatra.
rows.reference: 2009: Girgizar kasa mai girma ta 7.6 ta auku a kusa da birnin Padang, babban birnin lardin yammacin Sumatra.

rows.source: More than 1,100 people were killed.
rows.output: Fiye da mutane 1,100 ne aka kashe.
rows.reference: Fiye da mutane 1,100 aka kashe.

rows.source: 2010: A 7.5 magnitude quake hit one of the Mentawai islands, off Sumatra, triggering up tsunami of up to 10 meters that destroyed dozens of villages and killed around 300 people.
rows.output: 2010: Wani girgizar ƙasa mai girma 7.5 ya afku a ɗaya daga cikin tsibiran Mentawai, a kusa da Sumatra, wanda ya haifar da tsunami mai tsayi na kusan mita 10 wanda ya lalata wasu ƙauyuka da suka yi yawa kuma ya kashe kusan mutane 300.
rows.reference: 2010: Girgizar kasa mai girma ta 7.5 ta auku a daya daga cikin tsibirin Mentawai, daga Sumatra, inda ta haifar da tsunami har zuwa mita 10 da suka lalata kananan garuruwa masu yawa kuma suka kashe kimanin mutane 300.

rows.source: 2016: A shallow quake hit the Pidie Jaya regency in Aceh, causing destruction and panic as people were reminded by the devastation of the deadly 2004 quake and tsunami.
rows.output: 2016: Wani girgizar ƙasa ta yi a yankin Pidie Jaya a Aceh, wanda ya haifar da lalacewa da firgici yayin da mutane suka tuna da lalacewar da ta biyo bayan girgizar ƙasa mai muni da tsunami a shekarar 2004.
rows.reference: 2016: Wani mummunan girgizar kasa ya auku a yankin Pidie Jaya a Aceh, ya haddasa rugurgujewar abubuwa da tsoro yayin da aka tunatar da mutane game da mummunan girgizar kasa da tsunami da ta auku a 2004.

rows.source: No tsunami was triggered this time, but more than 100 were killed by fallen buildings.
rows.output: Ba a yi tsunami ba a wannan karon, amma sama da 100 ne suka mutu sakamakon ginin da ya fadi.
rows.reference: Ba a sami tsunami ba a wannan lokaci, amma fiye da mutane 100 suka mutu sakamakon gine-ginen da suka fadi.

rows.source: 2018: Major quakes hit Indonesia's tourist island of Lombok, killing more than 500 people, mostly on the northern side of the island.
rows.output: 2018: Girgizar ƙasa mai girma ta afka a tsibirin Lombok na yawon bude ido na Indonesia, inda ta kashe mutane fiye da 500, musamman a gefen arewa na tsibirin.
rows.reference: 2018: Babban girgizar kasar ya auku a tsibirin Lombok dake Indonesiya, inda ya kashe mutane sama da 500, mafi yawa a arewacin tsibirin.

rows.source: The quake destroyed thousands of buildings and left thousands of tourists temporarily stranded.
rows.output: Girgizar ƙasar ta lalata dubunnun gidaje kuma ta bar dubunnun masu yawon bude ido a cikin wani yanayi na makale.
rows.reference: Girgizar ta ruguza dubban gine-gine kuma ta bar dubban masu 'yan yawon bude ido cikin wani hali na dan lokaci.

rows.source: Sarah Palin's Eldest Son Arrested on Domestic Violence Charges
rows.output: An kama Sarah Palin 'Yar Eldest a kan Zargin Cin Zarafi
rows.reference: An kama babban dan Sarah Palin kan tuhumar rikicin cikin gida

rows.source: Track Palin, the eldest son of former Alaska governor and vice presidential candidate Sarah Palin, has been arrested on assault charges.
rows.output: An kama Track Palin, babban ɗa ga tsohon gwamnan Alaska da kuma dan takarar mataimakiyar shugaban ƙasa, Sarah Palin, bisa laifin cin zarafi.
rows.reference: Track Palin, babban dan tsohon gwanan Alaska kuma mataimakin shugaban dan takara Sarah Palin, an kama shi kan tuhumar cin zarafi.

rows.source: Palin, 29, of Wasilla, Alaska, was arrested on suspicion of domestic violence, interfering with a report of domestic violence and resisting arrest, according to a report released Saturday by Alaska State Troopers.
rows.output: Palin, mai shekaru 29, daga Wasilla, Alaska, an kama shi bisa zargin cin zarafin gida, tsangwama daarar cin zarafin gida, da kuma kin bin umarnin kama, a cewar rahoton da jami'an tsaron jihar Alaska suka fitar a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: An kama Palin, mai shekaru 29, na Wasilla, Alaska, kan zargin da ake yi na tada hankalin cikin gida, tare da yin katsalandan ga rahotannin tada hankali cikin gida da, a cewar wani rahoton da Alaska State Troopers ta fitar, a ranar Asabar.

rows.source: According to the police report, when a female acquaintance attempted to call police to report the alleged crimes, he took her phone from her.
rows.output: A cewar rahoton ‘yan sanda, lokacin da wata mata da take da alaƙa da shi ta yi ƙoƙarin kiran ‘yan sanda domin sanar da laifukan da ake zargin, sai ya kwace mata waya.
rows.reference: A cewar rahoton 'yan sanda, idan wata mata tayi kokarin ta kira' yan sanda don bayar da rahoton laifukan da ake zargin, sai ya dauki wayarta daga gareta

rows.source: Palin is being remanded in Mat-Su Pretrial Facility and is being held on a $500 unsecured bond, reported KTUU.
rows.output: An sanya Palin a gidan yari na Mat-Su Pretrial Facility kuma ana rike ta a kan $500 bond mara tsaro, a cewar KTUU.
rows.reference: An sa Palin a cikin Mat-Su Pretrial Facility kuma ana gudanar da shi a kan yarjejeniyar takardar alkawali na $500, in ji KTUU.

rows.source: He appeared in court Saturday, where he declared himself "not guilty, for sure" when asked his plea, reported the network.
rows.output: Ya bayyana a kot a ranar Asabar, inda ya bayyana kansa "ba laifi, tabbas" lokacin da aka tambaye shi game da laifinsa, a cewarararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararararar
rows.reference: Ya bayyana a kotu a ranar Asabar, inda ya bayyana kansa "ba laifi ba, a gaskiya" lokacin da aka neme shi, ruwaitowar cibiyar sadarwa.

rows.source: Palin faces three Class A misdemeanours, meaning he could be imprisoned for up to a year and fined $250,000.
rows.output: Palin yana fuskantar laifuka uku na Aji A, wanda ke nufin zai iya zama a gidan yari har zuwa shekaru ɗaya kuma a biya $250,000.
rows.reference: Palin yana fuskantar nau'o'i uku na Aji na, ma'ana zai iya tsare shi har zuwa shekara guda kuma ya biya $ 250,000.

rows.source: He has also been charged with a Class B misdemeanour, punishable by a day in jail and a $2,000 fine.
rows.output: An kuma tuhume shi da laifin da ya kai Class B, wanda ya kai ga zaman gidan yari na rana da taran $2,000.
rows.reference: Ana kuma tuhuma shi da wani mummunan lakabi na Ajin B, wanda hukunci shi ne ya je kurkuku na rana guda da kuma tarar $2,000.

rows.source: It is not the first time criminal charges have been filed against Palin.
rows.output: Ba shine karon farko da ake tuhume shi da laifuka ba.
rows.reference: Ba shi ne karo na farko da aka gurfanar da Palin ba akan mayan laifuka.

rows.source: In December 2017, he was accused of assaulting his father, Todd Palin.
rows.output: A watan Disamba 2017, an zarge shi da cin zarafin mahaifinsa, Todd Palin.
rows.reference: A watan Disamba na shekara ta 2017, an zarge shi da kisa ga mahaifinsa, Todd Palin.

rows.source: His mother, Sarah Palin, called police to report the alleged attack.
rows.output: Mahaifiyarsa, Sarah Palin, ta kira ‘yan sanda domin sanar da lamarin da ake zargin.
rows.reference: Mahaifiyarsa, Sarah Palin, ta kira 'yan sanda don bayar da rahoto game da harin.

rows.source: The case is currently before Alaska's Veteran's Court.
rows.output: An gabatar da shari'ar a kotun Alaska ta Veteran.
rows.reference: Shari’ar tana gaban Kotun Tsohon Kotun Alaska a yanzu haka.

rows.source: In January 2016 he was charged with domestic assault, interfering with the report of a domestic violence crime, and possessing a weapon while intoxicated in connection with the incident.
rows.output: A watan Janairun 2016, an tuhume shi da cin zarafin gida, da kuma tsangwama wajen bayar da rahoton cin zarafin gida, da kuma mallakar makami yayin da yake maye.
rows.reference: A watan Janairu 2016 an zargi shi da aikata laifuka na gida, da rikici da rahoto game da aikata ta'addanci a cikin gida, da kuma samun makamin yayin da yake cike da haɗari dangane da wannan lamarin.

rows.source: His girlfriend had alleged that he punched her in the face.
rows.output: Matar sa ta yi zargin cewa ya buge ta a fuska.
rows.reference: Budurwar shi ta yi zargin cewa ya doke ta a fuska.

rows.source: Sarah Palin was criticised by veterans groups in 2016 after linking her son's violent behaviour to PTSD stemming from his service in Iraq.
rows.output: An yi wa Sarah Palin suka daga kungiyoyin da suka yi ritaya a shekarar 2016 bayan ta danganta halayyar da 'yarta ta yi da cutar PTSD da ta samo asali daga hidimarta a Iraki.
rows.reference: An soki Sarah Palin a lamarin ta hanyar kungiyoyin tsofaffin soja a shekara ta 2016 bayan ya haɗu da halayyar danginta ga PTSD daga aikinsa a Iraki.

rows.source: Indonesia earthquake tsunami: hundreds killed
rows.output: Girgizar ƙasa a Indonesia tsunami: anjima mutu
rows.reference: Girgizar kasar Indonesia ta tsunami: daruruwa sun mutu

rows.source: At least 384 people have died after an earthquake hit the Indonesian island of Sulawesi on Friday.
rows.output: Aƙalla mutane 384 ne suka mutu bayan girgizar ƙasa ta afku a tsibirin Sulawesi na Indonesia a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Akalla mutane 384 ne suka mutu bayan girgizar kasa ta mamaye tsibirin Sulawesi a Indonesia a ranar Juma’a.

rows.source: The 7.5-magnitude earthquake triggered a tsunami and has destroyed thousands of homes.
rows.output: Girgizar ƙasa mai ƙarfi 7.5 ya haifar da tsunami kuma ya lalata gidaje da yawa.
rows.reference: Girgizar kasa mai magnitude 7.5 ya haifar da tsunami kuma ya rushe dubban gidajen.

rows.source: Electricity and communication networks are down with death tolls expected to rise in coming days.
rows.output: Hasken lantarki da hanyoyin sadarwa sun lalace tare da adadin wadanda suka mutu na iya ƙaruwa a cikin kwanaki masu zuwa.
rows.reference: Harkokin lantarki da sadarwar sun lalace tare da tsammani karin matattu za' tashi a cikin kwanaki masu zuwa.

rows.source: The earthquake hit just off central Sulawesi which is northeast of the Indonesian capital, Jakarta.
rows.output: An yi girgizar ƙasar a kusa da tsakiyar Sulawesi, wanda ke arewa maso gabas da babban birnin Indonesia, Jakarta.
rows.reference: Girgizar ta fara ne kawai daga tsakiyar Sulawesi wanda ke arewa maso gabashin kasar Indonesia, Jakarta.

rows.source: Videos are circulating on social media showing the moment of impact.
rows.output: Ana ta baje da bidiyoyi a shafukan sada zumunta da ke nuna lokacin da aka samu hatsari.
rows.reference: Bidio na ta yawu a shafukan watsa labarai na nuna lokacin tasiri.

rows.source: Hundreds of people had gathered for a beach festival in the city of Palu when the tsunami smashed on shore.
rows.output: Mutane da dama sun taru domin bikin rairayin bakin teku a birnin Palu lokacin da tsunami ya buge bakin tekun.
rows.reference: Daruruwan mutane sun taru don bikin rairayin bakin teku a birnin Palu lokacin da tsunami ya rushe a bakin tekun.

rows.source: Federal prosecutors seeking rare death penalty for NYC terror attack suspect
rows.output: Mai shari'a na tarayya yana neman hukuncin kisa na musamman ga wanda ake zargin kisan kiyashi a birnin New York
rows.reference: Masu gabatar da kara na tarayya na neman hukuncin kisa na kisa ga dan ta’adda NYC

rows.source: Federal prosecutors in New York are seeking the death penalty for Sayfullo Saipov, the suspect in the New York City terror attack that killed eight people -- a rare punishment that hasn't been carried out in the state for a federal crime since 1953.
rows.output: An yi wa laifuka na tarayya a birnin New York, inda ake neman hukuncin kisa ga Sayfullo Saipov, wanda ake zargin da laifin kisan kiyashi da ya kashe mutane takwas a birnin New York. Wannan hukuncin kisa ya kasance ba a taba yi masa ba a jihar a kan laifukan tarayya tun 1953.
rows.reference: Masu gabatar da kara na tarayya a birnin New York suna neman hukuncin kisa ga Sayfullo Saipov, wanda ake zargin a harin da ya faru a birnin New York, wanda ya kashe mutane takwas - hukuncin da ba a yi ba a jihar don aikata laifukan tarayya tun shekara ta 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, 30, allegedly used a Home Depot rental truck to carry out an attack on a bike path along the West Side Highway in Lower Manhattan, mowing down pedestrians and cyclist in his path on Oct.
rows.output: Saipov, mai shekaru 30, ya yi zargin cewa ya yi amfani da motar haya ta Home Depot don kai hari kan hanyar keken a kan hanyar West Side a Lower Manhattan, inda ya yi ta harbin mutane da ke tafiya a kan hanya a watan Oktoba.
rows.reference: Saipov, mai shekaru 30, ya yi amfani da motoci mai hawa na gida domin gudanar da hare-haren kan hanyar machine da ta hanyar West Side Highway a Lower Manhattan, inda ya kaddamar akan masu tafiya a kafa da kekuna a hanyarsa a watan Oktoba.

rows.source: In order to justify a death sentence, prosecutors will have to prove that Saipov "intentionally" killed the eight victims and "intentionally" inflicted serious bodily injury, according to the notice of intent to seek the death penalty, filed in the Southern District of New York.
rows.output: Don tabbatar da hukuncin kisa, masu gabatar da kara za su tabbatar da cewa Saipov ya "nufa" kashe wadanda abin ya shafa takwas da kuma "nufa" ya haifar da munanan raunuka, bisa ga sanarwar neman hukuncin kisa, da aka gabatar a yankin kudu na New York.
rows.reference: Don tabbatar da hukuncin kisa, masu gabatar da kara za su tabbatar da cewa Saipov "da gangan" ya kashe mutane takwas da "ganganci" ya jawo mummunan rauni a jiki, bisa ga sanarwar na neman hukuncin kisa, aka a yankin Kudancin Sabon Gundumar New York.

rows.source: Both of those counts carry a possibly death sentence, according to the court document.
rows.output: Duk waɗannan ƙudirorin suna da hukuncin kisa, bisa ga takardun kot.
rows.reference: Dukkan waɗanda nan la'akari su na da hukuncin kisa, bisa ga takardun kotu.

rows.source: Weeks after the attack, a federal grand jury slapped Saipov with a 22-count indictment that included eight charges of murder in aid of racketeering, typically used by federal prosecutors in organized crime cases, and a charge of violence and destruction of motor vehicles.
rows.output: Mako kaɗan bayan harin, wani jury na tarayya ya sanya Saipov da laifin laifuka 22 da suka hada da laifukan kisan kai 8 da aka yi don tursasa, wanda aka saba amfani da shi ta hanyar masu shari'a na tarayya a cikin laifukaniyanci, da kuma laifin tashin hankali da lalata motoci.
rows.reference: Makonni bayan harin, babban kotun tarayya ta maka wa Saipov zarge-zarge 22 da suka hada da laifuffuka guda takwas na kisan kai don taimakon rashin gaskiya, yawanci sune masu gabatar da kara ke yi a laifukan shiryeyyen laifi, da kuma cajin tashin hankali da halakar da motoci.

rows.source: The attack required "substantial planning and premeditation," prosecutors said, describing the manner in which Saipov carried it out as "heinous, cruel and depraved."
rows.output: Harin ya buƙaci "tsare-tsaren da suka yi yawa da kuma shiryawa," a cewar masu gabatar da kara, inda suka bayyana yadda Saipov ya yi shi a matsayin "mai ban tsoro, mai mugunta da kuma rashin kunya."
rows.reference: Wannan harin ya bukaci "tsarawa mai mahimmanci da kaddamarwa," in ji masu gabatar da kara, inda ya bayyana irin yadda Saipov ya dauki shi a matsayin "mai mugunta, mummunan hali da kuma marar sa tausayi."

rows.source: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov caused injury, harm, and loss to the families and friends of Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, and Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," the notice of intent states.
rows.output: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov ya haifar da rauni, cutarwa, da asarar rayuwa ga iyalai da abokai na Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, da Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," sanarwar niyyar ta bayyana.
rows.reference: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov ya haifar da rauni, cuta, da hasara ga iyalai da abokai Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, da Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," sanarwa na niyyar jihohi.

rows.source: Five of the victims were tourists from Argentina.
rows.output: Dukkan mutanen da aka kashe sun fito ne daga Argentina.
rows.reference: Biyar daga cikin waɗanda aka kashe 'yan yawon bude ido daga Argentina

rows.source: It has been a decade since the Southern District of New York last prosecuted a death penalty case.
rows.output: Shekaru goma kenan da yankin kudu na New York ya yi shari'a a kan hukuncin kisa.
rows.reference: An yi shekaru goma tun lokacin da yankin kudancin New York ya kaddamar da hukuncin kisa.

rows.source: The defendant, Khalid Barnes, was convicted of murdering two drug suppliers but was ultimately sentenced to life in prison in September 2009.
rows.output: Wanda ake tuhuma, Khalid Barnes, an yanke masa hukuncin kisa biyu masu samar da miyagun kaya, amma a karshe aka yanke masa hukuncin da ya kai shekaru 100 a gidan yari a watan Satumba na 2009.
rows.reference: Wanda aka gurfanar da shi, Khalid Barnes, an yanke masa hukunci ne game da kashe masu raba kwaya biyu, amma an yanke masa hukuncin kisa a watan Satumba na 2009.

rows.source: The last time the death penalty was carried out in a New York federal case was in 1953 for Julius and Ethel Rosenberg, a married couple executed after they were convicted of conspiracy to commit espionage for the Soviet Union during the Cold War two years before.
rows.output: Matsayinta na ƙarshe da aka yi wa hukuncin kisa a shari'ar tarayya ta New York ita ce a shekarar 1953 ga Julius da Ethel Rosenberg, ma'aurata da aka yanke musu hukuncin kisa bayan an yanke musu hukunci kan cin amanar kasa ga Tarayyar Soviet a lokacin yakin sanyi shekaru biyu kafin haka.
rows.reference: karshen a lokacin da aka yanke hukuncin kisa a tarayya New York a 1953 ga Julius da Ethel Rosenberg, ma'aurata bayan da aka yanke musu hukuncin kulla makirci don Tarayyar Soviet a lokacin Yakin Tsana shekaru biyu da suka gabata.

rows.source: Both Rosenbergs were both put to death by the electric chair on June 19, 1953.
rows.output: An kashe Rosenbergs biyu ne ta hanyar zama a kan kujerar lantarki a ranar 19 ga Yuni, 1953.
rows.reference: Dukansu Rosenbergs sun mutu ne ta hanyar kujerar lantarki ranar 19 ga Yuni, 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, a native of Uzbekistan, demonstrated a lack of remorse in the days and months following the attack, according to court documents.
rows.output: Saipov, wanda ya fito daga Uzbekistan, ya nuna rashin nadama a cikin kwanakin da kuma watanni bayan harin, a cewar takardun kotun.
rows.reference: Saipov, dan kasar Uzbekistan, ya nuna rashin tausayi a cikin kwanaki da watanni bayan harin, bisa ga takardun kotu.

rows.source: He stated to investigators that he felt good about what he had done, police said.
rows.output: Ya gaya wa masu bincike cewa ya ji daɗin abin da ya yi, ‘yan sanda sun ce.
rows.reference: Ya bayyana wa masu binciken cewa ya jin daɗin abin da ya yi, 'yan sanda sun ce.

rows.source: Saipov told authorities he was inspired to carry out the attack after watching ISIS videos on his phone, according to the indictment.
rows.output: Saipov ya gaya wa jami'an cewa ya samu karsashi wajen kai hare-haren bayan ya kalli bidiyo na ISIS a wayarsa, a cewar tuhume-tuhumen.
rows.reference: Saipov ya shaida wa hukumomin da cewa ya samu kwarin guiwa bayan gudanar da harin bayan ya duba bidiyon ISIS a wayarsa, bisa ga zargin.

rows.source: He also requested to display the ISIS flag in his hospital room, police said.
rows.output: Ya kuma nemi a nuna tutar ISIS a ɗakin asibiti, a cewar 'yan sanda.
rows.reference: Har ila yau, ya bukaci a nuna tutar Isis a cikin dakin asibiti, in ji 'yan sanda.

rows.source: He has pleaded not guilty to the 22-count indictment.
rows.output: Ya yi shura da cewa ba shi da laifi ga tuhume-tuhumen da aka yi masa na 22.
rows.reference: Ya yi zargin ba shi da laifi ga tuhuma 22 na zargin.

rows.source: David Patton, one of the federal public defenders representing Saipov, said they are "obviously disappointed" with the prosecution's decision.
rows.output: David Patton, ɗaya daga cikin masu kare haƙƙin jama'a na tarayya da ke wakiltar Saipov, ya ce sun "gamsu sosai" da shawarar da mai gabatar da kara ya yanke.
rows.reference: David Patton, daya daga cikin masu kare hakkin jama'a na tarayya a jihar Saipov, ya ce su na da "takaici" tare da yanke shawara.

rows.source: "We think the decision to seek the death penalty rather than accepting a guilty plea to life in prison with no possibility of release will only prolong the trauma of these events for everyone involved," Patton said.
rows.output: "Muna tunanin cewa yanke hukuncin neman hukuncin kisa maimakon karɓar hukuncin da ya dace na tsawon rayuwa a gidan yari ba tare da yiwuwar sake shi ba zai kara tsananta raɗaɗin wannan lamurra ga kowa da kowa," Patton ya ce.
rows.reference: "Mu na tsammanin shawarar da za a nemi hukuncin kisa maimakon karɓar laifin mai laifi zuwa rai a kurkuku ba tare da yiwuwar saki ba zai shawo kan matsalolin abubuwan da ke faruwa ga kowa da kowa", inji Patton.

rows.source: Saipov's defense team had previously asked prosecutors not to seek the death penalty.
rows.output: Tawagarsa ta tsaron sun nemi a baya da masu gabatar da kara ba su nemi hukuncin kisa ba.
rows.reference: Lauyoyi masu kare Saipov sun nemi masu gabatar da kara kada su nemi hukuncin kisa.

rows.source: Tory MP says NIGEL FARAGE should be put in charge of Brexit negotiations
rows.output: Tory MP ta ce NIGEL FARAGE ya kamata a ba shi ikon tafiyarsu ta Brexit
rows.reference: Tory MP ya ce NIGEL FARAGE ya kamata a kula da tattaunawar Brexit

rows.source: Nigel Farage vowed to 'mobilise the people's army' today during a protest at the Tory conference.
rows.output: Nigel Farage ya yi alƙawarin "mobilise the people's army" a yau yayin da aka yi zanga-zanga a taron jam'iyyar Tory.
rows.reference: Nigel Farage ya yi alwashin yin 'yan tawaye a yau yayin zanga-zanga a taron Tory.

rows.source: The former Ukip leader said politicians had to 'feel the heat' from Eurosceptics - as one of Theresa May's own MPs suggested he should be in charge of negotiations with the EU.
rows.output: Tsohon shugaban jam'iyyar Ukip ya ce 'yan siyasa dole ne su "ji zafi" daga masu adawa da Tarayyar Turai - kamar yadda wani daga cikin 'yan majalisun Theresa May ya ba da shawarar ya zama mai kula da tattaunawa da Tarayyar Turai.
rows.reference: Tsohon shugaban Ukip ya ce 'yan siyasar sun' ji zafi 'daga' yan kasuwa na Eurosceptics - kamar yadda daya daga cikin wakilai na Theresa May ta ba da shawara cewa ya kamata tayi la'akari da tattaunawar da EU.

rows.source: Conservative backbencher Peter Bone told the march in Birmingham that the UK 'would have been out' by now if Mr Farage was Brexit Secretary.
rows.output: Dan jam'iyyar Conservative mai ra'ayin mazan jiya, Peter Bone, ya sanar da tafiyarsa a Birmingham cewa, kasar Birtaniya za ta kasance a waje yanzu idan Mr. Farage ya kasance Sakatare na Brexit.
rows.reference: Wani mai goyon baya na baya-bayan nan, Peter Bone, ya shaida wa manema labaru a Birmingham cewa Birtaniya za ta fita daga yanzu idan Mr Farage ya zama Sakatare Brexit.

rows.source: But the challenge Mrs May faces in reconciling her deeply divided ranks has been underlined by pro-Remain Tories joining a separate protest against Brexit in the city.
rows.output: Amma ƙalubalen da Mrs May ke fuskanta wajen sulhuntar da jam'iyyarta da ta rabu da juna ya bayyana ne ta hanyar 'yan jam'iyyar Tory masu goyon bayan Brexit da suka shiga wani zanga-zanga daban a birnin.
rows.reference: Amma ƙalubalen da Mrs May ta fuskanta wajen sulhu da ragamar da aka yi a tsakanin bangarori daban-daban da aka yi sun nuna cewa, Pro-Remain Tories na shiga cikin rashin amincewa da Brexit a birnin.

rows.source: The premier is struggling to keep her Chequers compromise plan on track amid attacks from Brexiteers, Remainers and the EU.
rows.output: Firaministan na ta gwabza yin ƙoƙarin ci gaba da tsarin ta na Chequers a kan hanyar Brexit, duk da hare-haren da 'yan Brexit da 'yan Brexit da kuma EU ke yi.
rows.reference: Fremiya na fama da matsalolin kulawa da masu bincikenta sunyi shiri akan hanya a cikin hare-hare daga Brexiteers, Remainers da EU.

rows.source: Allies insisted she will push ahead with trying to strike a deal with Brussels despite the backlash - and force Eurosceptics and Labour to choose between her package and 'chaos'.
rows.output: Dukkan abokan tarayya sun yi tsokaci cewa za ta ci gaba da kokarin ta da ta yi da Brussels duk da martanin da aka samu - kuma ta tilasta wa masu adawa da Turai da kuma Labour su zaɓa tsakanin kunshinta da 'rashin tsari'.
rows.reference: Abokai sun dage cewa ta tura gaba tare da ƙoƙarina buga yarjejeniyar tare da Brussels duk da sakamakon - kuma ta tilasta yan Turai da Labour don su zabi tsakaninta da 'rudani'.

rows.source: Mr Bone told the Leave Means Leave rally in Solihull that he wanted to 'chuck Chequers'.
rows.output: Mr Bone ya gaya wa taron Leave Means Leave a Solihull cewa yana son "jifa da Chequers".
rows.reference: Mista Bone ya shaida wa kamfanin dillancin labaran AFP cewa, yana son 'duba' 'Masu binciken'.

rows.source: He suggested Mr Farage should have been made a peer and given responsibility for negotiations with Brussels.
rows.output: Ya ba da shawarar cewa Mr Farage ya kamata a sanya shi a matsayin mai kula da harkokin kasuwanci da kuma zama mai kula da harkokin Brussels.
rows.reference: Ya ba da shawarar cewa Mr Farage ya kamata ya zama dan takara kuma ya ba da alhakin tattaunawar da Brussels.

rows.source: 'If he had been in charge, we would have been out by now,' he said.
rows.output: 'Idan ya kasance a kan mulki, da mun fito da sauri,' ya ce.
rows.reference: "In da ya kasance mai kula, da yanzu mun fita," in ji shi.

rows.source: The Wellingborough MP added: 'I will stand up for Brexit but we need to chuck Chequers.'
rows.output: Mataimakiyar Wellingborough ta kara cewa: 'Zan tsaya tsaye don Brexit amma muna buƙatar zubar da Chequers.'
rows.reference: The Wellingborough MP ya kara: 'Zan tsaya a kan Brexit amma mu na buƙatar mu duba masu bincike.'

rows.source: Setting out his opposition to the EU, he said: 'We didn't fight world wars to be subservient.
rows.output: Fada da EU, ya ce: ''Ba mu yi yaƙi na duniya ba don mu zama masu biyayya.
rows.reference: Da yake nuna adawa da EU, ya ce: 'Ba mu yi yaƙe-yaƙe na duniya ba don mu zama kaskantattu.

rows.source: We want to make our own laws in our own country.'
rows.output: Muna son mu yi dokoki namu a kasar mu.'
rows.reference: Mu na son yin dokokinmu a ƙasar mu.’'

rows.source: Mr Bone dismissed suggestions that public opinion had changed since the 2016 vote: 'The idea that the British people have changed their minds and want to remain is completely untrue.'
rows.output: Mr Bone ya yi watsi da shawarar cewa ra'ayin jama'a ya canza tun daga zaben 2016: 'Ra'ayin cewa mutanen Birtaniya sun canza ra'ayinsu kuma suna son su zauna a nan, ba gaskiya ba ne.'
rows.reference: Mr Bone ya yi watsi da cewa shawarwarin da ra'ayoyin jama'a sun canja tun lokacin zaben 2016: 'Da ra'ayin cewa mutanen Birtaniya sun canza tunaninsu kuma su na so su kasance ba daidai ba ne.'

rows.source: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns was also at the march, telling reporters: 'I am simply saying: Prime Minister, listen to the people.
rows.output: An kuma yi wa Andrea Jenkyns, mai ra'ayin Brexit na jam'iyyar Tory, jawabin cewa: 'Ina cewa kawai: Prime Minister, saurari mutanen.
rows.reference: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns ya kasance a cikin tafiyar, yana mai ba da rahotanni: ‘Ina cewa kawai: Frem minister ya saurari mutane.

rows.source: 'Chequers is unpopular with the general public, the Opposition's not going to vote for it, it's unpopular with our party and our activists who actually pound the streets and get us elected in the first place.
rows.output: 'Chequers ba shi da shahara a tsakanin jama'a, jam'iyyar adawa ba za ta yi wa shi kuri'a ba, ba shi da shahara a cikin jam'iyyar mu da masu fafutukar mu waɗanda ke ta wa mu kawanya kan titi kuma suna zaban mu a farko.
rows.reference: 'Masu bincike ba su da tsaurin ra'ayi tare da jama'a, da' Yan adawa ba za su yi zabe ba, ba tare da jam'iyyarmu da 'yan gwagwarmayarmu ba, waɗanda suka lalata tituna kuma suka sa mu zaɓa tun a farkon.

rows.source: Please drop Chequers and start listening.'
rows.output: Daure ka bar Chequers ka fara sauraro.'
rows.reference: Don Allah sauke Masu bincike kuma ka fara sauraro.'

rows.source: In a pointed message to Mrs May, she added: 'Prime ministers keep their jobs when they keep their promises.'
rows.output: A cikin saƙo mai ban mamaki ga Mrs May, ta kara: 'Firaministoci suna riƙe da ayyukansu idan sun kiyaye alkawuran su.'
rows.reference: A cikin sakon da aka nuna wa Mrs May, ta kara da cewa: 'Firaim Ministocin su na ci gaba da aikin su idan sun kiyaye alkawuransu.'

rows.source: Mr Farage told the rally politicians must be made to 'feel the heat' if they were about to betray the decision made in the 2016 referendum.
rows.output: Mr Farage ya gaya wa taron 'yan siyasa dole ne su "ji zafi" idan sun yi kamar za su yi watsi da shawarar da aka yi a zaben shekara ta 2016.
rows.reference: Mr Farage ya fadawa 'yan siyasa cewa dole ne' yan siyasar su fara 'jin zafi' idan su na son cin yaudara da aka yi a cikin referendum na 2016.

rows.source: 'This is now about a matter of trust between us - the people - and our political class,' he said.
rows.output: "Wannan yanzu ya zama batu na yarda da juna tsakaninmu - mutanen - da kuma jam'iyyarmu ta siyasa," ya ce.
rows.reference: 'Wannan shi ne yanzu game da batun yadda tsakaninmu - mutanen - kuma da 'yan siyasa ', inji shi.

rows.source: 'They are trying to betray Brexit and we are here today to tell them 'we won't let you get away with doing that'.'
rows.output: 'Suna ƙoƙarin yin satar Brexit kuma muna nan yau don mu faɗa musu 'ba za mu bar ku ku yi hakan ba'.'
rows.reference: 'Suna ƙoƙari su yaudare Brexit kuma mu na nan a yau don mu gaya musu' ba za mu bari ku tafi tare da yin haka ba '.

rows.source: In a message to the enthusiastic crowd he added: 'I want you to make our political class, who are on the verge of betraying Brexit, feel the heat.
rows.output: A saƙonni ga taruwar masu sha'awar, ya kara: 'Ina son ku sanya jam'iyyar siyasa, wanda ke kan hanyar cin amanar Brexit, su ji zafi.
rows.reference: A cikin sakon zuwa ga taron masu farin ciki sai ya kara da cewa: 'Ina so ku sanya' yan siyasarmu, waɗanda suke kusa da cin amana Brexit, su ji zafi.

rows.source: 'We are mobilising the people's army of this country that gave us victory in Brexit and will never rest until we have become an independent, self-governing, proud United Kingdom.'
rows.output: 'Muna tukin sojojin mutanen wannan ƙasa da ta ba mu nasara a Brexit kuma ba za ta taba hutawa ba har sai mun zama ƙasa mai cin gashin kanta, mai cin gashin kanta, mai alfahari da Birtaniya ta United Kingdom.'
rows.reference: 'Mu na tattara rundunonin sojoji na wannan kasa wanda ya ba mu nasara a Brexit kuma ba za mu huta ba har sai mun zama masu zaman kansu, mulkin kai, da Alfaharin Britaniya.'

rows.source: Meanwhile, Remainers marched through Birmingham before holding a two-hour rally in the city centre.
rows.output: A lokaci guda, masu ci gaba da zama sun yi zanga-zanga a Birmingham kafin su gudanar da taron sa'o'i biyu a tsakiyar birnin.
rows.reference: A halin yanzu, Remainers ya yi rangadi ta Birmingham kafin ya yi zagaye na sa'oi biyu a tsakiyar birnin

rows.source: A smattering of activists waved Tories Against Brexit banners after the launch of the group this weekend.
rows.output: Ƙungiyar masu fafutuka sun yi ta nuna tutar "Tories Against Brexit" bayan ƙaddamar da ƙungiyar a ƙarshen mako.
rows.reference: Rikakken dan gwagwarmaya ya daga kyalen Tories akan Brexit bayan an kaddamar da kungiyar a cikin ranakun hutu.

rows.source: Labour peer Lord Adonis mocked the Conservatives for the security issues they suffered with a party app as the conference opened.
rows.output: Abokin jam'iyyar Labour, Lord Adonis, ya yi dariya kan jam'iyyar Conservative saboda matsalolin tsaro da suka fuskanta da manhajar jam'iyyar a lokacin da taron ya fara.
rows.reference: Dan Labor Lord Adonis ya yi zoloya wa Conservatives game da matsalolin tsaro da suka sha wahala tare da aikace-aikace na jam'iyya yayin buɗe taron.

rows.source: 'These are the people who tell us they can have the IT systems in place and all of the technology for Canada plus plus, for the frictionless border, for free trade without borders in Ireland,' he added.
rows.output: Waɗannan su ne mutanen da suke faɗa mana za su iya samun tsarin IT da duk fasahar da za ta yi amfani da Kanada da plus, don iyakar da ba ta da matsala, don kasuwanci kyauta ba tare da iyaka ba a Ireland, ya kara.
rows.reference: ‘Waɗannan su ne mutanen da suka gaya mana cewa za su iya samun tsarin IT a wuri daya da kuma dukkanin fasaha na kara-karan Canada, don badaddiyar iyaka, don ciniki kyauta ba tare da iyakoki a Ireland ba,’ ya kara da cewa.

rows.source: 'It is a complete farce.
rows.output: 'Ba shi da ma'ana.
rows.reference: 'Cikakken barkwanci ne.

rows.source: There isn't such a thing as a good Brexit,' he added.
rows.output: Babu irin wani abu mai kyau da ake kira da Brexit,' ya kara.
rows.reference: Babu wani abu mai kyau kamar Brexit, ‘ya kara da cewa.

rows.source: Warren plans to take a 'hard look' at running for president
rows.output: Warren ya shirya ɗaukar 'hard look' a kan neman takarar shugaban ƙasa
rows.reference: Warren za ta yi "kyakkyawan nazari" ga Tsayawa takarar Shugaban kasa

rows.source: U.S. Sen. Elizabeth Warren says she'll take a "hard look at running for president" after the November elections.
rows.output: Sanatociyar Amurka Elizabeth Warren ta ce za ta "duba sosai game da neman takarar shugan kasa" bayan zaben watan Nuwamba.
rows.reference: Amurka Sen. Elizaberth ta ce za ta yi "kyakkyawan nazari akan Tsayawa takarar Shugaban kasa” bayan gudana zaben Nuwamba.

rows.source: The Boston Globe reports the Massachusetts Democrat spoke about her future during a town hall in western Massachusetts Saturday.
rows.output: Jaridar Boston Globe ta ruwaito cewa 'yar jam'iyyar Democrat ta Massachusetts ta yi magana game da makomarta a lokacin wani taron al'umma a yammacin Massachusetts a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Boston Globe ta ruwaito ce ‘yar Massachusetts Democrat tayi magana game da makomarta a lokacin da ake zauren gari a yammacin Massachusetts ranar Asabar.

rows.source: Warren, a frequent critic of President Donald Trump, is running for re-election in November against GOP state Rep. Geoff Diehl, who was co-chairman of Trump's 2016 Massachusetts campaign.
rows.output: Warren, wanda ke yawan sukar shugaban kasa Donald Trump, yana neman sake zaɓen a watan Nuwamba a kan GOP state Rep. Geoff Diehl, wanda ya kasance babban mai kula da Trump's 2016 Massachusetts campaign.
rows.reference: Warren, mai yawan sukan Shugaba Donald Trump, yana neman takarar sake neman zaben a watan Nuwamba tsakaninsa da dan majalisat Jaha GOP. mai suna Geoff Diehl, wanda ya kasance shugaban kungiyar neman takara Trump na 2016 Massachusetts.

rows.source: She has been at the center of speculation that she might take on Trump in 2020.
rows.output: Ta kasance a tsakiyar hasashe cewa za ta iya tsayawa takaran Trump a 2020.
rows.reference: Ta kasance a tsakiyar zancen cewa zata iya tsayawa takara da Trump a 2020.

rows.source: Saturday afternoon's event in Holyoke was her 36th meeting with constituents using the town hall format since Trump took office.
rows.output: Yin taro a Holyoke ranar Asabar da yamma shi ne taron ta na 36 da ta yi da 'yan mazabarta ta hanyar tsarin majami'ar garin tun bayan Trump ya hau mulki.
rows.reference: A taron rana na Asabar a Holyoke wanda shi ne taro 36 da mazabanta da yin amfani da tsarin zaure gari tun da Trump ya shiga ofishi.

rows.source: An attendee asked her if she planned to run for president.
rows.output: Wani mai halartar taron ya tambaye ta ko tana shirin neman takarar shugaban ƙasa.
rows.reference: Wani mahalarcin taron ya tambaye ta ko tana shirin tsayawa takaran shugaban kasa.

rows.source: Warren replied that it's time "for women to go to Washington to fix our broken government, and that includes a woman at the top."
rows.output: Warren ya amsa cewa lokaci ya yi "don mata su tafi Washington domin gyara gwamnatin da ta lalace, kuma hakan ya haɗa da mace a kan gaba."
rows.reference: Warren ta mai da martani cewa lokaci yayi “da mata za su je Washington domin gyara karrariya gwamnatinmu kuma wannan ya hada da matan dake sama,"

rows.source: Arrest made in shooting death of LSU's Sims
rows.output: An kama wanda ya kashe LSU's Sims
rows.reference: Anyi kame a harbin kisan da akayi wa LSU Sims

rows.source: Police in Baton Rouge, La., announced Saturday that a suspect has been arrested in the shooting death of LSU basketball player Wayde Sims on Friday.
rows.output: An sanar da jami'an tsaro a Baton Rouge, La., a ranar Asabar cewa an kama wanda ake zargin a harbin da ya kashe dan wasan kwallon kwando na LSU, Wayde Sims, a ranar Juma'a.
