rows.output: "Oké osimiri bụ nke anyị": Bolivia nke enweghị oke mmiri na-atụ anya na ụlọikpe ga-emepe ụzọ gaa n'Oké Osimiri Pacific
rows.reference: “Osimiri ahụ bụ nke anyị’: Bolivia ala gbara okirikiri na atụ anya na ụlọ ikpe ga-emepegharị ụzọ gara Pasifik

rows.source: Sailors patrol a rigging-clad naval headquarters in La Paz.
rows.output: Ndị ụgbọ mmiri na-ejikere n'ụgbọ mmiri na-ejikere n'ụgbọ mmiri na-ejikere n'ụgbọ mmiri na-ejikere n'ụgbọ mmiri na-ejikere n'ụgbọ mmiri na-ejikere n'ụgbọ mmiri na-ejikere n'ụgbọ mmiri na-ejikere n'ụgbọ mmiri na-ejikere n'ụgbọ mmiri na-ejikere n'ụgbọ mmiri na-ejikere n'ụgbọ mmiri na-ejikere n'ụgbọ mmiri na-ejikere n'ụgbọ mmiri na-ejikere n'ụgbọ mmiri na-ejikere n'ụgbọ mmiri na-ejikere n'ụ
rows.reference: Ndị ụgbọ mmiri na agagharị isi ụlọ ọrụ ndị agha mmiri ụgbọ juru na La Paz.

rows.source: Public buildings fly an ocean-blue flag.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọha na eze na-efe ọkpa mmiri.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọhaneze na efegharị ọkọlọtọ nnukwu osimiri na acha agba eluigwe.

rows.source: Naval bases from Lake Titicaca to the Amazon are daubed with the motto: "The sea is ours by right.
rows.output: Ebe ndị agha mmiri si n'Ọdọ Mmiri Titicaca ruo n'Ọdọ Mmiri Amazon na-ehicha ihe a na-ekwu: "Oké osimiri bụ nke anyị site n'ụzọ ziri ezi.
rows.reference: Ọdụ ndị agha mmiri site na Titicaca ruo Amazon juputara na ekuku: “Osimiri ahụ bụ anyị site n’ikike.

rows.source: To recover it is a duty."
rows.output: Iji weghachi ya bụ ọrụ."
rows.reference: Iweghachite ya bụ ọrụ.”

rows.source: Throughout landlocked Bolivia, the memory of a coastline lost to Chile in a bloody 19th-century resource conflict is still vivid - as is the yearning to sail the Pacific Ocean once more.
rows.output: N'ime Bolivia nke enweghị ókèala, ihe ncheta nke coastline furu efu na Chile n'oge agha akụ na ụba nke narị afọ nke 19 ka dị ndụ - dị ka ọ dịkwa ọchịchọ ịkwọ ụgbọ mmiri Pacific Ocean ọzọ.
rows.reference: N’okirikiri Bolivia niile ala gbara okirikiri, ncheta nke akụkụ mmiri etufuru n’aka Chile n’esemokwu ekereụwa nke narị afọ 19 jọrọ oke njọ ka pụtara ihie - otu ahụ ka agụụ ịkwọ ụgbọ na Nnukwu Osimiri Pasifik otu ugboro ọzọ si dị.

rows.source: Those hopes are perhaps at their highest in decades, as Bolivia awaits a ruling by the international court of justice on 1 October after five years of deliberations.
rows.output: Olileanya ndị ahụ nwere ike ịbụ nke kachasị elu n'ime afọ iri, ka Bolivia na-eche mkpebi nke ụlọikpe mba ụwa na 1 Ọktoba mgbe afọ ise nke mkparịta ụka gasịrị.
rows.reference: Ntụmanya ndị ahụ ikekwe kachasị ugbu a n’ime afọ iri, ka Bolivia na eche mkpebi nke ụlọ ọrụ ofesi nke akwụmọtọ na Ọktoba 1 ka afọ ise nrụrịta ụka gachara.

rows.source: "Bolivia has the momentum, a spirit of unity and serenity, and is of course expecting with a positive view the outcome," said Roberto Calzadilla, a Bolivian diplomat.
rows.output: "Bolivia nwere ike, otu mmụọ na udo, na n'ezie na-atụ anya na ọ ga-eme nke ọma," Roberto Calzadilla, onye nnọchi anya Bolivia kwuru.
rows.reference: “Bolivia ji agbamume ugbu a, mmụọ nke ịdị n’otu na ume ala, makwa jiri nlele dị mma wee na atụ anya ndapụta ahụ,” nke Roberto Calzadilla kwuru, onye nnọchite anya nke Bolivia.

rows.source: Many Bolivians will watch the ICJ ruling on big screens across the country, hopeful that the tribunal in The Hague will find in favour of Bolivia's claim that - after decades of fitful talks - Chile is obliged to negotiate granting Bolivia a sovereign outlet to the sea.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ ndị Bolivia ga-elele mkpebi ICJ na nnukwu ihuenyo n'ofe obodo ahụ, na-atụ anya na ụlọ ikpe dị na The Hague ga-ahụ na Bolivia nwere ikike ịkọriri Chile ka ọ kwurịta inye Bolivia ụzọ pụọ n'oké osimiri.
rows.reference: Imirikiti ndị Bolivia ga-elele mkpebi ICJ n’ihuenyo buru ibu n’ofe obodo ahụ niile, na atụ anya na ụlọ ikpe ahụ dị na The Hague ga-eme nchọpụta na mmasị nke ebubo nke Bolivia na - ka ọtụtụ afọ iri nke okwu dị mma gachara - Chile nwere mmanye ịkparịta nkata na enye Bolivia ụzọ nnwere onwe gara n’osimiri.

rows.source: Evo Morales, Bolivia's charismatic indigenous president - who faces a controversial battle for re-election next year - also has plenty riding on Monday's ruling.
rows.output: Evo Morales, onye isi ala Bolivia nwere àgwà na-adọrọ mmasị nke ndị obodo - onye na-eche ọgụ na-akpalite arụmarụ ụka maka ịhọpụta ya ọzọ n'afọ na-abịa - nwekwara ọtụtụ ihe na-adabere na mkpebi e mere na Mọnde.
rows.reference: Evo Morales, onye isi ala nke amaala Bolivia na adọrọ mmasị - onye na eche ọgụ siri ike maka nhọpụtagharị ntuli aka n’afọ na esote - nwekwara ọtụtụ ihe ọ na adabere na mkpebi nke Mọnde.

rows.source: "We are very close to returning to the Pacific Ocean," he vowed in late August.
rows.output: "Anyị dị nso na ịlaghachi na Pacific Ocean," ka o kwuru n'oge  late August.
rows.reference: “Anyị nọ nso na ịlaghachi na Nnukwu Osimiri Pasifik,” ọ ṅwụrụ iyi na Ọgọst gara aga.

rows.source: But some analysts believe that the court is unlikely to decide in Bolivia's favour - and that little would change if it did.
rows.output: Mana ụfọdụ ndị nyocha kwenyere na ụlọikpe ahụ agaghị kpebie n'ụzọ Bolivia - na ihe agaghị agbanwe ma ọ bụrụ na ọ mere.
rows.reference: Mana ụfọdụ ndị nyocha kwenyere na ụlọ ikpe ahụ nwere ike ha agaghị enye mkpebi ga-amasị Bolivia - na obere ihe ga-agbanwe ma ọ bụrụ na ha mere.

rows.source: The Netherlands-based UN body has no power to award Chilean territory, and has stipulated that it will not determine the outcome of possible talks.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ UN nke dị na Netherlands enweghị ike inye ala Chile, ma o kwuru na ọ gaghị kpebie ihe ga-esi na mkparịta ụka ndị nwere ike ime.
rows.reference: Ewumewu ahụ nọ na Netherland nwere ikike iji nye mpaghara Chile, ọ kọwara na ọ gaghị ekpebi ndapụta nke okwu ndị nwere ike ịdị.

rows.source: That the ICJ's ruling comes only six months after the final arguments were heard indicates the case "wasn't complicated," said Paz Zárate, a Chilean expert in international law.
rows.output: Na mkpebi nke ICJ na-abịa naanị ọnwa isii ka e nụrụ arụmụka ikpeazụ, na-egosi na okwu ahụ "abụghiela ihe mgbagwoju anya," ka Paz Zárate, onye ọkachamara mba ụwa nke Chile kwuru.
rows.reference: Na mkpebi nke ICJ na abịa naanị ọnwa isii ka anụchara ụbụbọ ndị ikpeazụ na egosi na okwu ahụ “agbagwojughi anya,” Paz Zárate kwuru, onye ọkachamara Chile n’iwu ofesi.

rows.source: And far from furthering Bolivia's cause, the past four years may have set it back.
rows.output: Na n'ezie, ọ bụghị ime ka Bolivia nwee ihe ịga nke ọma, afọ anọ gara aga nwere ike ime ka ọ daa azụ.
rows.reference: Nke tere aka na ịkwado ebumnuche ndị Bolivia, afọ anọ gara aga nwegoro ike ịdọghachi azụ.

rows.source: "The issue of access to the sea has been hijacked by the current Bolivian administration," said Zárate.
rows.output: "Nsogbu nke ịnweta oké osimiri ejirila n'aka ndị ọchịchị Bolivia ugbu a," ka Zárate kwuru.
rows.reference: “Okwu nke ịnweta ụzọ osimiri bụ nke ndị nchịkwa Bolivia nọ ugbu a weghagoro n’ike,” Zárate kwuru.

rows.source: Morales's belligerent rhetoric has sapped any residual Chilean goodwill, she suggested.
rows.output: Mmetụta Morales dị egwu emeela ka ọ dịkwuo mma n'ụzọ dị mma nke Chile, o kwuru.
rows.reference: Okwu ụtọ bụ asị nke Morales na akpasu iwe amịala amara onye Chile ọ bụla fọdụrụ, ọ tụnyere.

rows.source: Bolivia and Chile will at some point continue to talk, but it will be extremely difficult to hold discussions after this.
rows.output: Bolivia na Chile ga na-ekwu okwu n'oge ụfọdụ, mana ọ ga-adị nnọọ mfe ịkpọtụrụ ndị ọzọ mgbe nke a gasịrị.
rows.reference: Bolivia na Chile n’otu oge ga-amalitekwa na ekwu okwu, mana ọ ga-esi nnukwu ike ịnwe mkparịta ụka ka nke a mechara.

rows.source: The two countries have not exchanged ambassadors since 1962.
rows.output: Mba abụọ ahụ enwebeghị onye nnọchi anya kemgbe 1962.
rows.reference: Obodo abụọ ahụ agbanwetabeghị onye nnọchite obodo kemgbe 1962.

rows.source: Former president Eduardo Rodríguez Veltzé, Bolivia's representative at The Hague, rejected the idea that the court's decision-making was unusually speedy.
rows.output: Onye bụbu onye isi ala Eduardo Rodríguez Veltzé, onye nnọchi anya Bolivia na The Hague, jụrụ echiche na mkpebi nke ụlọ ikpe ahụ dị ngwa ngwa.
rows.reference: Onye isi ala gara aga Eduardo Rodríguez Veltzé, onye nnọchite nke Bolivia na The Hague, jụrụ alo na ịme mkpebi nke ụlọ ikpe ahụ na adịkebe ọsọ.

rows.source: Monday will bring Bolivia "an extraordinary opportunity to open a new era of relations with Chile" and a chance to "put an end to 139 years of disagreements with mutual benefits," he said.
rows.output: Mọnde ga-eweta Bolivia "okporo ụzụ pụrụ iche imepe oge ọhụrụ nke mmekọrịta na Chile" na ohere iji "mechie afọ 139 nke esemokwu na uru abụọ ahụ."
rows.reference: Mọnde ga-ewetere Bolivia “ohere pụrụ nnukwu iche iji mepee oge ọhụrụ na mmerịkọta n’etiti Chile” yana ohere iji “kwụsị afọ 139 nke esemokwu nwere elele nwekọrịta,” o kwuru.

rows.source: Calzadilla also denied that Morales - still one of Latin America's most popular presidents - was using the maritime issue as a political crutch.
rows.output: Calzadilla kwukwara na Morales - ka bụ otu n'ime ndị isi ala Latin America kacha ewu ewu - na-eji okwu mmiri dị ka ihe eji eme ihe.
rows.reference: Calzadilla gọnarịkwara na Morales - onye ka bụ otu ndị isi ala nke Latin America akachasị mara - na eji okwu mmiri ahụ ka nkwado ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị.

rows.source: "Bolivia will never give up its right to have access to the Pacific Ocean," he added.
rows.output: "Bolivia agaghị akwụsị ikike ya inwe ohere ịnweta oke osimiri Pacific," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Bolivia agaghị ahapụ ikike ya iji nweta ụzọ gara Nnukwu Osimiri Pasifik,” o tinyere.

rows.source: "The ruling is an opportunity to see that we need to overcome the past."
rows.output: "mkpebi ahụ bụ ohere ịhụ na anyị kwesịrị imeri ihe ndị gara aga."
rows.reference: “Mkpebi ahụ bụ ohere iji hụ na anyị kwesịrị imeri ihe ndị gara aga.”

rows.source: North Korea says nuclear disarmament won't come unless it can trust US
rows.output: North Korea kwuru na ịgbacha nuklia agaghị abịakwute ma ọ bụrụ na ha nwere ike ịtụkwasị obi na US
rows.reference: Ndị North Korea ekwuola na nkwasa ngwa agha nuklịa agaghị eme belụsọ na ha enwere ntụkwasị obi na US

rows.source: North Korean Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho says his nation will never disarm its nuclear weapons first if it can't trust Washington.
rows.output: Onye minista mba ofesi North Korea bụ Ri Yong Ho kwuru na obodo ya ga-ewerekwu ngwa agha nuklia ya ma ọ bụrụ na ha enweghị ike ịtụkwasị obi na Washington.
rows.reference: Minista Ofesi nke North Korea Ri Yong Ho kwuru na mba ya agaghị eburu ụzọ ma ncha kwasaa ngwa agha nuklịa ma ọ bụrụ na ọ nweghị ike ịnwe ntụkwasị obi na Washington.

rows.source: Ri was speaking Saturday at the United Nations General Assembly.
rows.output: Ri na-ekwu okwu na United Nations General Assembly na Satọde.
rows.reference: Ri nọ na ekwu na Satọde na Mgbakọ Ezumezu nke United Nations.

rows.source: He called on the United States to follow through on promises made during a summit in Singapore between the rivals' leaders.
rows.output: Ọ kpọrọ United States ka ha soro ihe ndị e kwere na ha ga-eme n'oge nzukọ dị n'etiti ndị isi abụọ ahụ na Singapore.
rows.reference: Ọ kpọrọ ndị United States ka ha mezuo nkwa ha mere na n’ọgbakọ ahụ na Singapore n’etiti ndị isi ahụ na ama aka.

rows.source: His comments come as US. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo seems to be on the verge of restarting deadlocked nuclear diplomacy more than three months after the Singapore with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.
rows.output: Okwu ya na-abịa ka onye ode akwụkwọ mba Amerịka bụ Mike Pompeo na-aga n'ihu na-eweghachi mkparịta ụka nuklia nke daraụrụụ mgbe ihe karịrị ọnwa atọ gachara na Singapore na onye isi ala North Korea bụ Kim Jong Un.
rows.reference: Okwu ya na abịa ka ndị US. Ọde Akwụkwọ nke Steeti Mike Pompeo dị ka ọ nọ nso na ibidogharị mkparịta ụka nuklịa kpọchiri akpọchi kemgbe n’ime ọnwa atọ ka Singapore gachara n’etiti Kim Jong Un nke North Korea.

rows.source: Ri says it's a "pipe dream" that continued sanctions and U.S. objection to a declaration ending the Korean War will ever bring the North to its knees.
rows.output: Ri kwuru na ọ bụ "ọchịch na-enweghị isi" na ntaramahụhụ ndị ọzọ na-akwadoghị na U.S. na-ajụ nkwupụta na njedebe nke Agha Korea ga-eme ka North daa.
rows.reference: Ri kwuru na ọ bụ “nrọ efu” na ntaramahụhụ gara n’ihu yana mgbochi U.S. na nkwupute nkwụsị nke Ọgụ Korea ga-ebute North n’ikpere ya.

rows.source: Washington is wary of agreeing to the declaration without Pyongyang first making significant disarmament moves.
rows.output: Ndozi Washington na-ekwetaghị nkwupụta ahụ na-enweghị Pyongyang ime ihe dị mkpa n'ịkwatu ngwa agha.
rows.reference: Washington na akpachapụ nnukwu anya ịkwenye na nkwupute ebe Pyongyang emebeghị ihe doro anya na nkwasasị.

rows.source: Both Kim and U.S. President Donald Trump want a second summit.
rows.output: Ndị Kim na Onye isi ala United States Donald Trump chọrọ nnọkọ nke abụọ.
rows.reference: Kim yana U.S. Onye isi ala Donald Trump chọrọ nzụkọ nke abụọ.

rows.source: But there is widespread skepticism that Pyongyang is serious about renouncing an arsenal that the country likely sees as the only way to guarantee its safety.
rows.output: Mana enwere ọtụtụ ndị na-enwerịrị obi abụọ na Pyongyang dị njikere ịgbarapụ ngwa agha nke obodo ahụ nwere ike ịhụ dị ka ụzọ isi hụ na nchekwa ya dị mma.
rows.reference: Mana enwere obi mgbagha gbasara agbasa na Pyongyang dị njikere ịjụ ngwa agha nke obodo ahụ nwere ike ị na ahụ ka naanị ụzọ iji chedo onwe ya.

rows.source: Pompeo is planning to visit Pyongyang next month to prepare for a second Kim-Trump summit.
rows.output: Pompeo na-eme atụmatụ ịga Pyongyang n'ọnwa na-abịa iji kwadebe maka nzukọ nke abụọ Kim-Trump.
rows.reference: Pompeo na akwadobe ịga Pyongyang n’ọnwa na abịa iji kwadobe nzụkọ Kim-Trump nke abụọ.

rows.source: Paris fashion shows reveal latest line in massive headwear on it's way to a High Street near you
rows.output: Ihe ngosi ejiji Paris na-egosi ihe kacha ọhụrụ na nnukwu isi nke na-aga n'ụzọ gị n'akụkụ okporo ama gị
rows.reference: Ihe ngosi ekike gosiri ahịrị kachasị ọhụrụ na nnukwu uwe isi na abịa Okporo Dị Elu nọketere gị

rows.source: If you want to upsize your hat collection or completely block out the sun then look no further.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ ịbawanye nchikota okpu gị ma ọ bụ kpọchie anwụ kpamkpam, lee ebe a.
rows.reference: Ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ iwegote mkpokọta okpu gị ma ọ bụ gbochie anwụ kpamkpam, achọna ebe ọzọ.

rows.source: Designers Valentino and Thom Browne unveiled an array of wacky oversized head gear for their SS19 collection on the runway which dazzled the style set at Paris Fashion Week.
rows.output: Ndị na-emepụta ihe Valentino na Thom Browne gosipụtara ụdị isi nke ukwuu nke na-adịghị mma maka nchịkọta SS19 ha na runway nke mere ka ndị na-ahụ maka ụdị dị iche iche n'izu nke Paris.
rows.reference: Ndị ọmebe ekike Valentino na Thom Browne kpughepuru ikpo uwe isi jọrọ njọ maka mkpokọta SS19 ha n’okporo nke masịrị nka atọrọ na Izu Ekike Paris.

rows.source: Highly impractical hats have swept Instagram this summer and these designers have sent their eye-popping creations down the catwalk.
rows.output: Uwe isi na-adịghị mma na-ewu ewu na Instagram n'oge okpomọkụ a na ndị na-emepụta ihe ndị a na-ebuga ihe ndị na-akpali mmasị ha n'okporo ụzọ.
rows.reference: Okpu ndị na atụ n’anya ejula Instagram n’ọkọchị a, ma ndị ọmebe ekike ndị a ezipula mmepụta ha dị egwu n’ụzọ warawara.

rows.source: The stand out piece by Valentino was an over-the-top beige hat adorned with a feather-like wide brim that swamped the models heads.
rows.output: Ihe kacha pụta ìhè nke Valentino bụ okpu beige nke nwere nnukwu brim nke yiri nku nke gbara ndị na-eme ihe nkiri n'isi.
rows.reference: Okpu nke Valentino pụrụ iche bụ okpu beji dị egwu etinyere okpuru okpu dị obosara dị ka nku kpuchiri isi model ndị ahụ.

rows.source: Other over-sized accessories included bejeweled watermelons, a wizard hat and even a pineapple - but they are not designed to keep your head warm.
rows.output: Ihe ndị ọzọ dị oke ibu gụnyere mmiri ara ehi nwere ihe ịchọ mma, okpu anwansi na ọbọgw - mana ha abụghị maka ịgbanye isi gị ọkụ.
rows.reference: Ngwa ndị ọzọ buru oke ibu gụnyere anyụ akwanyere ọla mma, okpo amusu yana nfueru - mana emeghị ka ha nye isi gị okpomọkụ.

rows.source: Thom Browne also revealed a selection of bizarre masks- and just in time for Halloween.
rows.output: Thom Browne gosipụtara nhọrọ nke ihe ndị na-adịghị mma- na naanị n'oge Halloween.
rows.reference: Thom Browne gosikwara ihe mkpuchi na ụtọ ụjọ - ọ bịara n’oge maka Halloween.

rows.source: Many of the colourful masks had sewn up lips and resembled more like Hannibal Lecter than haute couture.

rows.reference: Imirikiti mkpuchi ihu ndị ahụ mara mma nwere egbugbere ọnụ akwachiri akwachi wee yie Hannibal Lecter karịa haute couture.

rows.source: One creation resembled scuba diving gear complete with snorkel and goggles, while another looked like a melted ice cream cone.
rows.output: Otu ihe e kere eke yiri ngwa ịsa mmiri n'ime mmiri nwere snorkel na ugogbe anya mmiri, ebe nke ọzọ dị ka okpokoro ice cream gbawara agbawa.
rows.reference: Otu mmepụta yiri uwe eji adakpu n’ala mmiri n’uju ma nwee snọkel na ugogbe anya, ebe ọzọ yiri iko aịs krim gbazere agbaze.

rows.source: And if you continue the huge fashion statement- you are in luck.
rows.output: Na ọ bụrụ na ị na-aga n'ihu na nnukwu ihe ngosi ejiji- ị nọ n'ọnọdụ dị mma.
rows.reference: Ma ị gaa n’ihu na nkwupute ekike ahụ dị elu - ị nwere ihu ọma.

rows.source: Style watchers predict that the enormous bonnets could be making their way to high streets near you.
rows.output: Ndị na-ahụ maka ụdị na-atụ anya na nnukwu okpokoro isi nwere ike na-aga n'okporo ụzọ dị n'akụkụ gị.
rows.reference: Ndị nlele ụdị ekike buru amụma na nnukwu mkpuchi ndị ahụ nwere ike ịbịarute n’okporo ndị dị elu nọketere gi.

rows.source: The out-sized hats come hot on the heels of 'La Bomba', the straw hat with a two-foot wide brim that's been seen on everyone from Rihanna to Emily Ratajkowski.
rows.output: Otu n'ime okpokoro isi ndị ahụ buru ibu na-abịa n'oge na-adịghị anya mgbe 'La Bomba', okpokoro isi ahịhịa nwere okpokoro isi nke dị ka ụkwụ abụọ n'obosara. A na-ahụ ya n'ebe niile site n'aka Rihanna ruo Emily Ratajkowski.
rows.reference: Okpu ndị basara abasa na abịa ozugbo na ngafe ‘La Bomba’, okpu ahịhịa nwere okpuru dị nzọụkwụ abụọ n’obosara nke ahụgoro n’ahụ mmadụ niile bido na Rihanna ruo Emily Ratajkowski.

rows.reference: Akara nkwekọrịta kwadoro okpu ahụ na adịghị mma maka ojiji ebuputere n’ebe mgbasa ozi ọhaneze zipuru nnukwu mmepụta ọzọ n’okporo ngosipụta - agba akụkụ osimiri ahịhịa buru ibu ruo ka mọdel yi uwe eji egwu mmiri bu ya.

rows.source: The burnt orange raffia bag, trimmed with raffia fringing and topped with a white leather handle, was the stand out piece in Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 collection at Paris Fashion Week.
rows.output: Akpa raffia na-acha aja aja, nke e ji raffia fringing chọọ ya mma ma tinye ya n'elu aka ọkpa nro ọcha, bụ ihe kacha pụta ìhè na Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 nchọpụta na Paris Fashion Week.
rows.reference: Akpa raffia orenji gbara ọkụ, eji gịrịgịrị raffia dozie ma tinye ya aka akpụkpụ anụahụ dị ọcha, bụ ihe kwụpụrụ iche na mkpokọta SS19 nke Jacquemus’ La Riviera na Izu Ekike Paris.

rows.source: Celebrity stylist Luke Armitage told FEMAIL: 'I'm expecting to see large hats and beach bags arrive on the high street for next summer - as the designer has made such a huge impact it would be hard to ignore the demand for the oversized accessories.'
rows.output: Onye na-ahụ maka ejiji na-ewu ewu bụ Luke Armitage gwara FEMAIL: 'Ana m atụ anya ịhụ nnukwu okpu na akpa mmiri na-abịa n'okporo ámá maka oge okpomọkụ na-abịa n'afọ na-abịa - ebe onye na-emepụta ihe emeela nnukwu mmetụta, ọ ga-abụ ihe siri ike ịgbanarị ọchịchọ maka ihe ndị na-ewu ewu.'
rows.reference: Onye na eyi ndị ama ama uwe bụ Luke Armitage gwara FEMAIL: “M na atụ anya ịhụ nnukwu okpu na akpa akụkụ osimiri irute n’okporo ụzọ dị elu maka ọkọchị na esote - ebe onye ọmebe ekike ahụ enweela nnukwu mmetụta ọ ga-esi ike ịleghara ọchụchọ nke ihe enyemaka ndị buru oke ibu.’

rows.source: John Edward: Languages skills essential for global citizens
rows.output: John Edward: nka asụsụ dị mkpa maka ndị bi n'ụwa niile
rows.reference: John Edward: Nka asụsụ dị mkpa maka ndị amaala ụwa

rows.source: Scotland's independent schools maintain a track record of academic excellence, and this has continued in 2018 with another set of outstanding exam results, which is only strengthened by individual and collective success in sports, art, music and other community endeavours.
rows.output: Ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị na-achị onwe ha na Scotland na-edobe ndekọ nke ọma n'agụmakwụkwọ, na nke a agabigala na 2018 na usoro nke rizọọtụ ule dị egwu, nke na-eme ka ihe ịga nke ọma nke onye ọ bụla na nke otu na egwuregwu, nka, egwu na ihe omume obodo ndị ọzọ.
rows.reference: Ụlọ akwụkwọ nnwere onwe nke Scotland dowere ndekọ nzọụkwụ nke agụmakwụkwọ kachasị, ma nke a gara n’ihu na 2018 site na iji nsonaazụ ule ndị mara oke mma, nke a na agụzogide site na mmeri ndị mmadụ na ndị otu n’egwuregwu, nka, egwu na mbọ ogbe ndị ọzọ.

rows.source: With upwards of 30,000 pupils across Scotland, these schools, represented by The Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS), strive to deliver the best level of service to their pupils and parents.
rows.output: N'ime 30,000 ụmụ akwụkwọ n'ofe Scotland, ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị a, nke Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS) na-anọchite anya, na-agbalịsi ike inye ọkwa ọrụ kacha mma maka ụmụ akwụkwọ na ndị mụrụ ha.
rows.reference: Na mgbago ọnụọgụ nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 30,000 n’ofe Scotland, ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị a, nke The Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS) na anọchite, na agba mbọ iwete ọkwa ọrụ kachasị maka ụmụ akwụkwọ ha na ndị nne na nna ha.

rows.source: Independent schools aim to prepare their pupils for further and higher education, their chosen career and their place as global citizens.
rows.output: Ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị na-adịghị na ndị na-abụghị nke gọọmentị na-achọ ịkwadebe ụmụ akwụkwọ ha maka agụmakwụkwọ ọzọ na nke ka elu, ọrụ ha họroro, na ọnọdụ ha dị ka ndị obodo ụwa.
rows.reference: Ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe na agba mbọ ịkwadobe ụmụ akwụkwọ maka agụmakwụkwọ ọdịnihu na nke dị elu, ọrụaka ha họpụtara yana ọnọdụ ha ka ndị amaala ụwa.

rows.source: As an education sector that can design and implement a bespoke school curriculum, we are seeing modern languages continue as a popular and desired subject of choice within schools.
rows.output: Dị ka ngalaba agụmakwụkwọ nke nwere ike ịhazi na mejuputa usoro mmụta nke ụlọ akwụkwọ, anyị na-ahụ asụsụ nke oge a ka ọ na-aga n'ihu na-ewu ewu na ọchịchọ n'etiti ụlọ akwụkwọ.
rows.reference: Dị ka ngalaba agụmakwụkwọ nwere ike izube ma tinye usoro ọmụmụ nke ụlọ akwụkwọ dị elu, anyị na ahụ asụsụ ọhụụ ka ọ na aga n’ihu ka nke na akpọtụ yana isiokwu nke nhọrọ achọrọ n’ime ụlọ akwụkwọ.

rows.source: Nelson Mandela said: "If you talk to a man in a language he understands, that goes to his head.
rows.output: Nelson Mandela kwuru: "Ọ bụrụ na ị na-ekwu okwu na nwoke n'asụsụ ọ ghọtara, nke ahụ na-aga n'isi ya.
rows.reference: Nelson Mandela kwuru: “Ọ bụrụ na ịgwa nwoke okwu n’asụsụ ọ matara, nke ahụ na aga n’isi.

rows.source: If you talk to him in his own language that goes to his heart."
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-agwa ya okwu n'asụsụ ya, ọ na-aga n'obi ya."
rows.reference: Ọ bụrụ na ịgwa ya okwu n’asụsụ nke ya, nke ahụ na aga n’obi.”

rows.source: This is a powerful reminder that we can't just rely on English when wanting to build relationships and trust with people from other countries.
rows.output: Nke a bụ ihe ncheta siri ike na anyị enweghị ike ịtụkwasị obi naanị na Bekee mgbe anyị chọrọ iwulite mmekọrịta na ntụkwasị obi na ndị si mba ndị ọzọ.
rows.reference: Nke a bụ nnukwu ncheta na anyị enweghị ike ịdabere na Bekee mgbe anyị na achọ ịmebe mmekọrịta na ntụkwasị obi n’etiti ndị mmadụ si na obodo ndị ọzọ.

rows.source: From this year's recent exam results, we can see that languages are topping the league tables with the highest pass rates within independent schools.
rows.output: Site na rizọọtụ nke ule afọ a, anyị nwere ike ịhụ na asụsụ na-eme nke ọma na chaatị nke ụlọ akwụkwọ onwe ha.
rows.reference: Bido na nsonaazụ ule nke afọ a dị nso nso, anyị nwere ike ịhụ na asụsụ na agachasị na tebul asọmpi ahụ nke nwere ogo ntozu kachasị n’ime ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe.

rows.source: A total of 68 per cent of pupils who studied foreign languages achieved a Higher grade A.
rows.output: Otu pasentị iri isii na asatọ nke ụmụ akwụkwọ ndị na-amụ asụsụ mba ọzọ nwetara ọkwa A dị elu.
rows.reference: Mgbakọta nke pasentị 68 nke ụmụ akwụkwọ ndị gụrụ asụsụ ofesi nwetara akara A Dị Elu.

rows.source: The data, collected from SCIS's 74 member schools, showed that 72 per cent of students achieved a Higher grade A in Mandarin, while 72 per cent of those studying German, 69 per cent of those studying French and 63 per cent studying Spanish also achieved an A.
rows.output: Data ahụ, nke a na-anakọta site na ụlọ akwụkwọ 74 dị na SCIS, gosiri na 72 pasent nke ụmụ akwụkwọ nwetara ọkwa dị elu A na Mandarin, ebe 72 pasent nke ndị na-amụ German, 69 pasent nke ndị na-amụ French na 63 pasent nke ndị na-amụ Spanish nwetara A.
rows.reference: Data, anakọtara n’aka ụlọ akwụkwọ 74 sonyere na SCIS, gosiri na pasentị 72 nke ụmụ akwụkwọ nwetara akara A Dị Elu na Mandarin, ebe pasentị 72 nke ndị na agụ German, pasentị 69 nke ndị na agụ French na pasentị 63 na agụ Spanish nwetara A.

rows.source: This demonstrates that independent schools in Scotland are supporting foreign languages as vital skills that children and young people will undoubtedly require in the future.
rows.output: Nke a na-egosi na ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị na-adịghị na Scotland na-akwado asụsụ mba ọzọ dị ka nkà dị mkpa nke ụmụaka na ndị na-eto eto ga-achọ n'ezie n'ọdịnihu.
rows.reference: Nke a na egosi na ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe nọ na Scotland na akwado asụsụ ofesi ka nka dị mkpa nke ụmụaka na ndị ntorobịa ga-ejiriri n’ọdịnihu.

rows.source: Languages now, as a subject choice, are being held in the same regard as STEM subjects (science, technology, engineering and mathematics) in independent school curriculums and elsewhere.
rows.output: Asụsụ ugbu a, dị ka nhọrọ isiokwu, na-ewere otu n'otu n'otu dị ka isiokwu STEM (sayensị, teknụzụ, injinia na mgbakọ na mwepụ) na usoro akwụkwọ nkuzi ụlọ akwụkwọ onwe onwe na ebe ndị ọzọ.
rows.reference: Asụsụ ugbu a, dị ka nhọrọ isiokwu, ka a na ahụta n’otu anya ka isiokwu ndị STEM (sayensị, teknụzụ, ịnjinịarịn na mgbakọ na mwepu) n’usoro ọmụmụ ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe yana n’ebe ndị ọzọ.

rows.source: A survey by the UK Commission for Employment and Skills in 2014 found that of reasons employers gave for struggling to fill vacancies, 17 per cent were attributed to a languages skills shortage.
rows.output: Nnyocha nke UK Commission for Employment and Skills mere na 2014 chọpụtara na n'ime ihe ndị na-enye ndị ọrụ nsogbu iji juo oghere ndị ọrụ, 17 pasent bụ n'ihi ụkọ asụsụ.
rows.reference: Nyocha nke Ụlọ Ọrụ UK maka Arụmọrụ na Nka na 2014 hụrụ na ihe ndị na ewe n’ọrụ nyere ka ihe na egbochi ha na ikpoju ohere ọrụ, ekenyere pasenti 17 na ụkọ nka asụsụ.

rows.source: Therefore more and more, language skills are becoming imperative in order to prepare young people for their future careers.
rows.output: Ya mere, ọtụtụ ndị na-achọsi ike ịmụ asụsụ, n'ihi na nkà asụsụ na-adịwanye mkpa iji kwadebe ndị na-eto eto maka ọrụ ha n'ọdịnihu.
rows.reference: Ya mere ọtụtụ oge, nka asụsụ na abụkwazị ihe dị mkpa maka ndị ntorobịa iji kwadobe onwe ha maka ọrụaka ọdịnihu ha.

rows.source: With more prospective job opportunities requiring languages, these skills are essential in a globalised world.
rows.output: N'ihi na enwere ọtụtụ ohere ọrụ ga-eme n'ọdịnihu nke chọrọ asụsụ, nkà ndị a dị mkpa n'ụwa nke zuru ụwa ọnụ.
rows.reference: Ebe ọtụtụ ohere ọrụ ndị nwere ike ịpụta na achọ asụsụ, nka ndị a dị mkpa n’ụwa azụmahịa.

rows.source: Regardless of the career someone chooses, if they've learned a second language, they'll have a real advantage in the future having a life-long skill such as this.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị ọrụ onye ọ bụla họro, ọ bụrụ na ha amụtala asụsụ ọzọ, ha ga-enwe nnukwu uru n'ọdịnihu nwere nkà na-adịgide adịgide dị ka nke a.
rows.reference: Agbanyeghị ọrụaka mmadụ họrọ, ọ bụrụ na ha mụtara asụsụ nke abụọ, ha ga-enwe nnukwu uru n’ọdịnihu n’ihi ịnwe nka ogologo ndụ dị ka nke a.

rows.source: Being able to communicate directly with people from foreign countries will automatically put a multilingual person ahead of the competition.
rows.output: Inwe ike ịkparịta ụka ozugbo na ndị si mba ọzọ ga-eme ka onye na-asụ asụsụ dị iche iche nwee ihe ịga nke ọma n'ọrụ.
rows.reference: Ịnwe ike ikwukọrịta okwu ozugbo n’etiti ndị mmadụ si mba ofesi ga-etinye mmadụ na asụ ọtụtụ asụsụ n’ihu ndị ya na ya na ama aka ozugbo.

rows.source: According to a YouGov poll of more than 4,000 UK adults in 2013, 75 per cent were unable to speak a foreign language well enough to hold a conversation and with French being the only language spoken by a double-digit percentage, 15 per cent.
rows.output: N'afọ 2013, nyocha YouGov nke karịrị 4,000 ndị okenye Britain, 75 pasentị enweghị ike ikwu asụsụ mba ọzọ nke ọma iji nwee mkparịta ụka.
rows.reference: Site na nhọpụta YouGov nke ndị okenye karịrị 4,000 na 2013, pasentị 75 enwenwughi ike ịsụ asụsụ ofesi ole zuru oke iji kpaa nkata, ebe French bụ naanị asụsụ nwere mkpụrụọnụọgụ pasentị gbara mkpị, pasentị 15.

rows.source: This is why putting the investment into language teaching now is important for today's children.
rows.output: Nke a bụ ihe mere itinye ego n'ụzọ nkuzi asụsụ ugbu a dị mkpa maka ụmụaka taa.
rows.reference: Nke a kpatara itinye ego na nkuzi asụsụ ugbu a dị mkpa maka ụmụaka taa.

rows.source: Having multiple languages, particularly those of developing economies, will equip children with a better chance of finding meaningful employment.
rows.output: Inwe ọtụtụ asụsụ, karịsịa nke ndị na-emepe emepe, ga-enye ụmụaka ohere iji nweta ọrụ na-enye afọ ojuju.
rows.reference: Ịnwe ọtụtụ asụsụ, karịchara ndị akụnụba obodo na etolite, ga-akwadobe ụmụaka site na ịnye ha ohere ka mma na ịchọta ọrụ bara uru.

rows.source: Within Scotland, each school will differ in the languages they teach.
rows.output: N'ime Scotland, ụlọ akwụkwọ ọ bụla ga-adị iche na asụsụ ndị ha na-akụzi.
rows.reference: N’ime Scotland, ụlọ akwụkwọ ọ bụla ga-adị iche n’asụsụ ha na akuzi.

rows.source: A number of schools will focus on the more classic modern languages, whereas others will teach languages that are deemed to be most important for the UK when looking ahead to 2020, such as Mandarin or Japanese.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ ụlọ akwụkwọ ga-elekwasị anya n'asụsụ ndị oge a, ebe ndị ọzọ ga-akụzi asụsụ ndị a na-ewere dị ka ndị kacha mkpa maka UK mgbe ha na-ele anya n'ihu 2020, dị ka Mandarin ma ọ bụ Japanese.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ ụlọ akwụkwọ ga-agbado anya karịa n’asụsụ ọhụụ, ebe ndị ọzọ ga-akuzi asụsụ ndị a na ahụta ka ndị kachasị mkpa maka UK mgbe a na ele anya n’ihu na 2020, dị ka Mandarin ma ọ bụ Japanese.

rows.source: Whatever your child's interest, there will always be a number of languages to choose from within independent schools, with teaching staff who are specialists in this area.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị mmasị nwa gị, enwere ọtụtụ asụsụ ndị ga-ahọrọ n'ime ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị na-achị onwe ha, ndị ọrụ nkuzi ndị na-eme nke ọma n'ụzọ a.
rows.reference: Ihe ọ bụla bụ mmasị nwata gị, a ga-enwerịrị ọnụọgụ asụsụ ndị a ga-esi na ha họrọ n’ime ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe, ga-enwe ndị nkuzi bụ ọkachamara na mpaghara a.

rows.source: Scottish independent schools are dedicated to providing a learning environment that will prepare children and arm them with the skills required to succeed, whatever the future holds.
rows.output: Ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị Scotland nwere onwe ha na-eme ka ebe mmụta dị nke ga-akwadebe ụmụaka ma nye ha nkà ndị dị mkpa iji mee nke ọma, n'agbanyeghị ihe ọdịnihu ga-abụ.
rows.reference: Ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe nke Scotland wepụtara onwe ha na iwete gburugburu mmụta ga-akwadobe ụmụaka ma jiri nka ndị achọrọ wee kwadobe ha iji mee nke ọma, ihe ọ bụla ọdịnihu wetere.

rows.source: It can't be denied at this time, in a global business environment, that languages continue to be vitally important to the country's future, so this must be mirrored in education.
rows.output: Ọ nweghị ike ịjụ ya ugbu a, n'ime gburugburu azụmahịa zuru ụwa ọnụ, na asụsụ ka dị mkpa maka ọdịnihu obodo ahụ, ya mere nke a ga-egosi na mmụta.
rows.reference: Enweghị ike ịgọnarị ya n’oge a, na gburugburu azụmahịa ụwa, na asụsụ gara n’ihu na adị oke mkpa n’ọdịnihu nke obodo, yabụ ekwesịrị igosipụta nke a n’agụmakwụkwọ.

rows.source: Indeed, modern languages should really be considered "international communication skills."
rows.output: N'ezie, asụsụ ndị oge a kwesịrị ịbụ "nka nzikọrịta ozi mba ụwa."
rows.reference: N’ezie, ekwesịrị ịhụta asụsụ ọhụụ ka “nka nkwukọrịta ofesi.”

rows.source: Independent schools will continue to offer this choice, diversity and excellence for Scotland's young people.
rows.output: Ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị na-adịghị na-ekwe nkwa na ha ga-aga n'ihu na-enye nhọrọ, ọdịiche na ịdị mma maka ndị ntorobịa Scotland.
rows.reference: Ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe ga-aga n’ihu na enye nhọrọ a, ndịiche na ọkachamma maka ndị ntorobịa nke Scotland.

rows.source: Il faut bien le faire.
rows.output: Ọ dị mkpa ime ya.
rows.reference: Il faut bien le faire.

rows.source: John Edward is Director of the Scottish Council of Independent Schools
rows.output: John Edward bụ onye isi oche nke Scottish Council of Independent Schools
rows.reference: John Edward bụ Onye Nduzi nke Nzụkọ nke Ụlọ Akwụkwọ Ndị Nnwere Onwe nke Scotland

rows.source: LeBron to make Lakers debut Sunday in San Diego
rows.output: LeBron ga-eme egwuregwu mbụ ya na Lakers na Sọnde na San Diego
rows.reference: Lebron ga-apụta izizi maka ndị Lakers na Sọnde na San Diego

rows.source: The wait is nearly over for fans looking to see LeBron James make his first start for the Los Angeles Lakers.
rows.output: Ozugbo ndị na-akwado ya ga-ahụ LeBron James mee egwuregwu mbụ ya maka ndị Los Angeles Lakers.
rows.reference: Ọchịche abịabele na njedebe maka ndị nsuso na eche ịhụ LeBron James mee mbido izizi ya maka Los Angeles Lakers.

rows.source: Lakers coach Luke Walton has announced that James will play in Sunday's preseason opener against the Denver Nuggets in San Diego.
rows.output: Onye nchịkwa ndị Lakers bụ Luke Walton kwupụtara na James ga-egwu egwuregwu mmalite nke oge egwuregwu na Sọnde megide ndị Denver Nuggets na San Diego.
rows.reference: Onye ndu ndị Lakers Luke Walton ekwuola na James ga-eso n’egwuregwu nke nkwadobe afọ asọmpi na Sọnde n’etiti Denver Nuggets na San Diego.

rows.source: But just how many minutes he'll play has yet to be determined.
rows.output: Mana naanị nkeji ole ọ ga-atụba ya ka a ga-ekpebi.
rows.reference: Mana nkeji ole ọ ga-egwu egwuregwu ka amatabeghị.

rows.source: "It will be more than one and less than 48," said Walton on the Lakers" official website.
rows.output: "Ọ ga-adị karịa otu na-erughị 48," ka Walton kwuru na webụsaịtị gọọmentị Lakers.
rows.reference: “Ọ ga-akarị otu mana ọ gaghị eru 48,” nke Walton kwuru na weebụsaịtị ndị Lakers ziri ezi.

rows.source: Lakers reporter Mike Trudell tweeted that James will likely play limited minutes.
rows.output: Onye nta akụkọ Lakers bụ Mike Trudell tweeted na James nwere ike igwuri egwu obere nkeji.
rows.reference: Onye mkpesa akụkọ nke Lakers Mike Trudell dere na James nwere ike igwu obere egwuregwu.

rows.source: Following practice earlier this week, James was asked about his plans for the Lakers" six-game preseason schedule.
rows.output: Mgbe ọ na-eme ihe n'izuụka gara aga, a jụrụ James maka atụmatụ ya maka usoro egwuregwu asọmpi isii nke Lakers.
rows.reference: Isochi nkwadobe na mbido nke izu a, ajụrụ James maka atụmatụ ya maka usoro nke nkwadobe afọ asọmpi egwuregwu isii nke Lakers.

rows.source: "I don't need preseason games at this stage of my career to get ready," he said.
rows.output: "Anaghị m achọ egwuregwu tupu oge mmalite n'oge a nke ọrụ m iji kwadebe," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Achọghị m egwuregwu a na-eme n’oge mmalite n’ọnọdụ m ugbu a n’ọrụ m, iji dị nkwadebe,” o kwuru.

rows.source: Trump's West Virginia Rally Time, YouTube Channel
rows.output: Oge Trump na-eme njem na West Virginia, YouTube Channel
rows.reference: Oge nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ Trump nke West Virginia. Youtube Channel

rows.source: President Donald Trump begins a flurry of campaign rallies tonight in Wheeling, West Virginia.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Donald Trump malitere ọtụtụ nnọkọ mgbapụta na abalị a na Wheeling, West Virginia.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ala Donald Trump malitere ọtụtụ nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị na Wheeling, West Virginia.

rows.source: It's Trump's first of five scheduled rallies in the next week, including stops in friendly places including Tennessee and Mississippi.
rows.output: Ọ bụ nnọkọ mbụ Trump n'ime nnọkọ ise a hazigharịrị n'ime izu na-abịa, gụnyere nkwagide na ebe ndị enyi dị ka Tennessee na Mississippi.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ nke izizi n’ime nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ ise achịkọbara Trump n’izu ise na-abịa, tinyere ebe nkwụsị nke ndị enyi tinyere Tennessee na Mississippi.

rows.source: With the confirmation vote on hold for his pick to fill the Supreme Court vacancy, Trump is aiming to build support for upcoming mid-term elections since Republicans are at risk of losing control of Congress when votes are cast on Nov.
rows.output: N'oge na-adịghị anya, Trump na-achọ iwulite nkwado maka ntuli aka etiti na-abịa ebe ndị Republican nwere ike tufuo ọchịchị nke Congress mgbe a na-eme ntuli aka na Nọvemba.
rows.reference: N’ijigide ntuli aka nkwado onye nhọrọ nke ya ịbanye n’ọkwa Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị Elu ghe oghe,Trump na-atụ anya ịkwalite nkwado maka ntuli aka ọkara ọchịchị na-abịa, ebe ndị otu Repọblikan nọ n’ihe egwu nnarapụ njikwa Ụlọ Ọmebe iwu mgbe a ga-atụnye aka na Nov.

rows.source: What time is Trump's West Virginia rally tonight and how do you watch online?
rows.output: Olee oge Trump ga-eme nnọkọ ya na West Virginia n'abalị a na otu ị ga-esi lelee ya n'ịntanetị?
rows.reference: Kedu oge bụ nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ West Virginia nke Trump n’abalị a, yana kedu ka ị ga-esi lelee ya n’ịntanetị.

rows.source: Trump's Wheeling, West Virginia rally is scheduled for 7 p.m. ET tonight, Saturday, September 29, 2018.
rows.output: Mgbakọ Trump na Wheeling, West Virginia bụ nke a hazigoro maka 7 p.m. ET taa, Saturday, September 29, 2018.
rows.reference: Etinyere nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ Trump nke Wheeling West Virginia na elekere 7 nke abalị. ET, Satọde, Septemba 29, 2018.

rows.source: You can watch Trump's West Virginia rally online below via live stream on YouTube.
rows.output: Ị nwere ike ilele nnọkọ Trump na West Virginia n'ịntanetị n'okpuru site na iyi egwu na YouTube.
rows.reference: I nwere ike lelee nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ Trump nke West Virginia n’ịntanetị, n’okpuru site na ihe nkiri ozugbo na Youtube.

rows.source: Trump is likely to address this week's hearings for Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh, which became tense over sexual misconduct allegations with an anticipated Senate confirmation vote on hold for up to a week while the FBI investigates.
rows.output: Trump nwere ike ikwurịta n'oge a na-eme nyocha maka onye a họpụtara n'ụlọikpe dị elu, Brett Kavanaugh, nke ghọrọ ihe na-ewute ya n'ihi ebubo nke ihe metụtara mmekọahụ, na-atụ anya na ndị Sineti ga-eme mkpebi n'ime otu izu ka ndị FBI na-enyocha.
rows.reference: Trump nwere ike ikwu maka nnụrịta ụka nke izu a banyere onye nhọpụta Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị Elu Brett Kavanaugh, nke malitere ịdị ọgbaghara n’ihi ebubo ihe mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị yana ntuli aka nkwado Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu a na-atụ anya ya ejigidere ihe ruru otu izu mgbe ndị FBI na-eme nyocha.

rows.source: But the primary aim of this flurry of rallies is helping Republicans facing touch November elections gain some momentum.
rows.output: Mana isi ebumnuche nke ọgba aghara a bụ inyere ndị Republican aka na-echebe ntuli aka November na-abịa nweta ụfọdụ ike.
rows.reference: Mana isi atụmatụ ọtụtụ nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ a bụ inyere ndị otu Repọblikan aka na ntuli aka Nọvemba siri ike nwetakwa agbamume.

rows.source: Thus, President Trump's campaign said these five rallies in the next week are aimed at "energizing volunteers and supporters as Republicans try to protect and expand the majorities they hold in the Senate and House of Representatives," according to Reuters.
rows.output: Ya mere, ndị otu President Trump kwuru na nnọkọ ndị a ise n'ime izu na-abịa bụ iji "kpalie ndị na-arụ ọrụ na ndị nkwado ka ndị Republican na-agbalị ichebe ma gbasaa ọtụ ndị otu ha nọ na Senate na House of Representatives," dị ka Reuters si kwuo.
rows.reference: Ya mere, ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị Onye Isi Ala Trump kwuru na nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ nke izu ise a na-abịa bụ maka “ịgba ndị na-enyere aka akwụ ụgwọ na ndị nkwado ume, ka ndị otu Repọblikan na-agbalị ichekwa ma gbasaa na ịmịrịkịtị ha ji na Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Iwu nke Nnukwu na nke Obere” dabere na ndị Reuter.

rows.source: "Control of Congress is so critical for his agenda that the president will travel to as many states as possible as we head into the busy campaign season," a Trump campaign spokesman who declined to be named told Reuters.
rows.output: "Ịchịkwa ụlọ omebe iwu dị oke mkpa maka atụmatụ ya, ya mere onye isi ala ga-eme njem gaa n'ọtụtụ steeti dị ka anyị na-aga n'oge oge mgbachite na-arụ ọrụ." Onye na-ekwu okwu maka mkpọsa Trump, onye jụrụ ịkpọ aha, gwara Reuters.
rows.reference: “Njikwa Ụlọ Ọmebe Iwu dị oke mkpa maka atụmatụ ya, nke na onye isi ala ga-eje ọtụtụ obodo ka ọ nwere ike, ka anyị na-abanye n’oge ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị” onye nkwuchite okwu ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị Trump nke achọghị ka akpọ aha ya gwara Reuters.

rows.source: Scheduled for Wesbanco Arena in Wheeling, tonight's rally could bring supporters from "Ohio and Pennsylvania and draw coverage from the Pittsburgh media," according to the West Virginia Metro News.
rows.output: Edebere maka Wesbanco Arena dị na Wheeling, nnọkọ a ga-eme n'abalị a nwere ike ịkpọta ndị nkwado site na "Ohio na Pennsylvania na dọta mkpuchi site na mgbasa ozi Pittsburgh," dị ka West Virginia Metro News si kwuo.
rows.reference: Etinyere na Ama Wesbanco Wheeling, nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ abalị a nwekere ike ịkpọta ndị nkwado si “Ohio na Pennsylvania ma dọrọ mkpuchi site na mgbasa ozi Pittsburgh,”dabere na West Virginia Metro News.

rows.source: Saturday will be the second time in the past month that Trump has visited West Virginia, the state he won by more than 40 percentage points in 2016.
rows.output: Sọnde ga-abụ oge nke abụọ n'ime ọnwa gara aga ka Trump gara West Virginia, steeti nke o meriri karịa 40 pasentị na 2016.
rows.reference: Satọde ga-abụ ugboro nke abụọ n’ọnwa gara aga Trump gara West Virginia, obodo nke o meriri site na ihe karịrị akara pesentị 40 na 2016.

rows.source: Trump is trying to help West Virginia Republican Senate candidate Patrick Morrisey, who is trailing in the polls.
rows.output: Trump na-agbalị inyere onye na-azọ ọkwa sinetọ nke West Virginia Republican, Patrick Morrisey, bụ onye na-eso ụzọ na nyocha.
rows.reference: Trump na-agbali ịnyere onye ahọpụtara maka Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Repọblikan West Virginia Patrick Morrisey aka, bụ onye nke na-akpụ akpụ na nyocha.

rows.source: "It's not a good sign for Morrisey that the president has to come to try to give him a boost in the polls," said Simon Haeder, a political scientist at West Virginia University, according to Reuters.
rows.output: "Ọ bụghị akara ọma maka Morrisey na onye isi ala ga-abịa gbalịa nye ya aka n'ịtọ ndị na-atụ vootu maka ya," ka onye ọkà mmụta ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị bụ́ Simon Haeder kwuru, dị ka Reuters si kwuo.
rows.reference: “Ọ bụghị ezigbo akara dịịrị Morrisey na onye isi ala ga-abịa iji kwalite ya na nyocha,” Simon Haeder kwuru, onye nyocha sayensị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị na West Virginia University, dabere na Reuters.

rows.source: Ryder Cup 2018: Team USA show stomach for fight to keep hopes alive heading into Sunday singles
rows.output: Ryder Cup 2018: Ndị otu USA gosiri obi ike maka ọgụ iji mee ka olileanya dị ndụ na-aga n'ihu na Sọnde otu onye.
rows.reference: Ryder Cup 2018: Ndị otu USA gosiri afọ ịlụ ọgụ iji dobe olile anya were banye na asompi agba nke otu onye na Sọnde

rows.source: After three one-sided sessions, Saturday afternoon's foursomes might just have been what this Ryder Cup needed.
rows.output: Mgbe oge atọ nke otu akụkụ gasịrị, mgbede Satọde nke otu ndị na-egwu egwuregwu nwere ike ịbụ ihe a chọrọ maka asọmpi Ryder Cup a.
rows.reference: Ka akụchara agba otu akụkụ ugboro atọ, agba mmadụ anọ nke ehihe Satọde nwere ike bụrụ ihe Ryder Cup a chọrọ.

rows.source: The swinging pendulum of momentum is a completely invented sporting concept but one that players truly believe in, and never more so than at competitions like these.
rows.output: Mmetụta nke mmegharị na mmegharị bụ echiche egwuregwu nke e chepụtara n'ụzọ dị iche, ma ndị na-egwu egwuregwu kwenyere na ya, na ọ dịghị mgbe ha kwenyere karịa n'oge asọmpi dị ka nke a.
rows.reference: Ike nke nkuli ihe bụ kpamkpam atụmatụ egwuregwu achọpụtara mana ọ bụ nke ndị na-egwu egwuregwu kwenyere na ya, nke pụtakarịrị ihie na ụdị asompi dị otu a.

rows.source: So where would they say the momentum is now?
rows.output: Yabụ ebe ọ bụ na ha ga-ekwu na ike na-aga n'ihu ugbu a?
rows.reference: Yabụ kedu ebe ha ga-ekwu na ike dị ugbu a?

rows.source: "They had a six-point lead and now it's four, so we are carrying that as a little bit of momentum I guess," said Jordan Spieth as he strolled off for the day.
rows.output: "Ha nwere isi isii ma ugbu a ọ bụ anọ, ya mere anyị na-eburu nke ahụ dị ka obere ihe na-eme ka obi dị anyị mma," ka Jordan Spieth kwuru ka ọ na-aga ezumike.
rows.reference: “Ha ji akara isii aga ma ugbu a ọ bụ anọ, yabụ anyị ga-ebu nke ahụ dịka obere agbamume, a na m eche,” Jordan Spieth kwuru ka ọ na-apụ maka ụbọchị ahụ.

rows.source: Europe have the advantage, of course, four points ahead with twelve more in play.
rows.output: Europe nwere uru, n'ezie, isi anọ n'ihu na iri na abụọ ọzọ n'ọrụ.
rows.reference: Mba Europe nwere uru, n’ezie, akara anọ n’ihu yana iri na abụọ a ka na-akụ akụ.

rows.source: The Americans, as Spieth says, feel they have a little wind in their sails though and they have plenty to be encouraged by, not least the form of Spieth and Justin Thomas who played together all day and each boast three points from four.
rows.output: Ndị America, dị ka Spieth si kwuo, na-eche na ha nwere obere ikuku n'ụgbọ ha ma ha nwere ọtụtụ ihe ga-eme ka obi sie ha ike, ọ bụghị naanị ụdị Spieth na Justin Thomas bụ ndị gbara egwuregwu niile n'ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ onye ọ bụla nwere isi atọ n'ime anọ.
rows.reference: Ndị America, dịka Spieth kwuru, chere na ha nwere obere ikuku n’ubu ha ma nwee ọtụtụ ihe agbamume, na abụghị opekempe ụdịdị Spieth na Justin Thomas, bụ ndị gwukọrọ egwuregwu ọnụ ụbọchị niile, na onye ọ bụla ga-anya isi akara atọ n’ime anọ.

rows.source: Spieth has been lethal from tee to green and is leading by example.
rows.output: Spieth na-eme ihe ike site na tee ruo n'ụzọ ndụ ndụ na-edu ụzọ.
rows.reference: Spieth dị mmerụ ahụ kemgbe akụpụrụ na tee ruo na ama ndu ndu ma na-aga dịka ọmụmatụ.

rows.source: Those guttural screams of celebration got louder as his round went on, sinking a crucial putt to take match four all-square when he and Thomas had been two down after two.
rows.output: Mkpọtụ ndị ahụ dị n'olu nke mmega ahụ na-arị elu ka ọ na-aga n'ihu, na-eme egwuregwu dị mkpa iji kee egwuregwu nke anọ n'ụzọ ziri ezi mgbe ha abụọ, Thomas na ya, na-azọ 2-2 ka ha na-aga.
rows.reference: Mkpu ike nke anurị dasibere ike ka agba nke ya na-aga n’ihu, n’ịkụbanye bọọlụ dị mkpa iji mee ka egwuregwu nke anọ nọrọ n’otu akara mgbe ya na Thomas jiri ọkụkụ abụọ ‘na-akpụ akpụ ka ha kụchara ugboro abụọ.

rows.source: His putt that won them the match on 15 was met with a similar scream, the sort that tells you he believes that the American team is not out of this.
rows.output: Mgbapụta ya nke meriri ha n'egwuregwu ahụ na 15 bụ otu ihe ahụ, ụdị nke na-agwa gị na otu ndị America enweghị ihe ha ga-eme n'ụzọ a.
rows.reference: Ụdị olu mkpu ahụ zutere ya na nkụbanye nke nyere ha mmeri na 15, ụdị nke na-agwa gị na ọ kwenyere na ndị America apụbeghị na nke a.

rows.source: "You've really just got to dig deep and worry about your own match," Spieth said.
rows.output: "Ị ga-agbali nke ukwuu ma chee maka egwuregwu nke gị," Spieth kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ị ga-enyobanye anya n’ime were na-atụ uche maka egwuregwu nke gị,” Spieth kwuru.

rows.source: It is all each of these players has left now.
rows.output: Ọ bụ naanị ihe ndị egwuregwu a hapụrụ ugbu a.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ naanị ihe ndị niile na-akụ egwuregwu a nwere ugbu a.

rows.source: 18 holes to make a mark.
rows.output: Ogho iri na asatọ iji mee akara.
rows.reference: Oghere18 iji nwee akara.

rows.source: The only players with more points than Spieth and Thomas over the past two days are Francesco Molinari and Tommy Fleetwood, the indisputable story of the Ryder Cup.
rows.output: Ndị egwuregwu ole na ole nwere isi ihe karịrị nke Spieth na Thomas n'ime ụbọchị abụọ gara aga bụ Francesco Molinari na Tommy Fleetwood, akụkọ na-adịghị akọwapụta nke Ryder Cup.
rows.reference: Naanị ndị na-akụ egwuregwu a nwere akara karịa Spieth na Thomas n’ime ụbọchị abụọ gara aga bụ Francesco Molinari na Tommy Fleetwood, akụkọ nke Ryder Cup enweghị mgbagha.

rows.source: Europe's odd but adorable couple are four from four and can do no wrong.
rows.output: Di na nwunye Europe na-akpa ọchị ma na-akpa ọchị, ha nwere ụmụ anọ n'ime anọ, ha enweghị ike ime ihe ọ bụla na-ezighị ezi.
rows.reference: Njikọ mara mma ma na atụghị anya nke Europe bụ anọ n’ime anọ n’enweghị ike ime ihe ọjọọ ọ bụla.

rows.source: "Moliwood" were the only pair not to shoot a bogey on Saturday afternoon, but they also avoided bogeys on Saturday morning, Friday afternoon and the back nine on Friday morning.
rows.output: "Moliwood" bụ naanị di na nwunye na-adịghị agba ọsọ na Satọde mgbe ehihie, ma ha na-ezere ọsọ na Satọde mgbe ụtụtụ, mgbe ehihie na Fraịde, na azụ itoolu na Fraịde mgbe ụtụtụ.
rows.reference: “Moliwood” bụ naanị njikọ na-akụfeghị na ehihe Satọde, mana ha zenarịrị nkụfe n’ụtụtụ Satọde, ehihe Fraịde yana ngwucha oghere itoolu n’ụtụtụ Fraịde.

rows.source: That run, and the way their energy seems to flow both to and from this boisterous crowd cements that they are the players to beat on Sunday, and there would be no more popular player to seal a potential European victory as the sun sets over Le Golf National than Fleetwood or Molinari.
rows.output: Nke ahụ na-agba ọsọ, na otu ike ha yiri ka ọ na-agbapụta ma na-abata n'ìgwè mmadụ a na-enye ike na-eme ka ha bụrụ ndị na-eme egwuregwu na-emeri na Sọnde, na ọ dịghị onye na-eme egwuregwu ga-adịkwuo mkpa iji mechie mmeri Europe nwere ike karịa ka anyanwụ na-ada n'elu Le Golf National karịa Fleetwood ma ọ bụ Molinari.
rows.reference: Ọkụkụ ahụ, na ka ike ha si aga ma na-abịa site na ndị igwe mmadụ a na-eme mkpọtụ gosipụtara na ha bụ ndị egwuregwu a ga-achọ imeri na Sọnde, nke n’agaghị enwe onye egwuregwu ọzọ ama ama nwere ike bute mmeri nke mba Europe ka anwụ na-ada na Le Golf National karịa Fleetwood na Molinari.

rows.source: Preferably both simultaneously on different holes.
rows.output: Kachasi mma, ha abụọ n'otu oge n'ime oghere dị iche iche.
rows.reference: Ọ kacha mma ha abụọ n’otu oge n’oghere dị iche iche.

rows.source: Talk of European glory remains premature, though.
rows.output: Oku banyere ihe ịga nke ọma nke Europe ka dị n'isi, n'agbanyeghị.
rows.reference: Okwu ebube mba Europe erubeghị, agbanyeghi.

rows.source: Bubba Watson and Webb Simpson made short work of Sergio Garcia, the morning's fourballs hero, when he was paired with Alex Noren.
rows.output: Bubba Watson na Webb Simpson mere ka ọ dị mfe maka Sergio Garcia, onye dike nke ọtụtụ n'ụtụtụ, mgbe aara ya ka ọ na-egwu Alex Noren.
rows.reference: Bubba Watson na Webb Simpson jiri Sergio Garcia mere ihe egwuregwu na bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ n’ụtụtụ, mgbe etinyekọrọ yana Alex Noren.

rows.source: A bogey and two doubles on the front nine dug the Spaniard and the Swede into a hole they never got close to climbing out of.
rows.output: Otu bogey na abụọ abụọ n'ihu itoolu dugara onye Spen na onye Sweden n'ime oghere ha na-apụghị ịgbapụta.
rows.reference: Ịkụfe otu ugboro na ịkụfe ugboro abụọ n’ọkụkụ ugboro itoolu kụnyere onye mba Spain na Sweden n’olulu nke ha enweghị ike ịrịpụta.

rows.source: On Sunday, though, there is nobody to help you out of your hole.
rows.output: N'ụbọchị Sọnde, ọ nweghị onye ga-enyere gị akaịpụta n'ime oghere gị.
rows.reference: Na Sọnde, agbanyeghị n’onweghị onye ga-enyere gị aka ịpụta n’olulu gị.

rows.source: The fourballs and foursomes are so fascinating to watch up close because of the interactions between pairings, the advice they give, the advice they don't and the way that a strategy can change in an instant.
rows.output: Otu abụọ na anọ na anọ na anọ na-adọrọ mmasị ile anya n'akụkụ dị nso n'ihi mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ndị otu, ndụmọdụ ha na-enye, ndị ha anaghị enye na otu ụzọ atule nwere ike ịgbanwe n'otu ntabị.
rows.reference: Bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ na agba mmadụ anọ bụ ihe ịtụ n’anya ịnọ nso lelee n’ihi mkparịta ụka dị na etiti njikọ a, ndụmọdụ ha na-enye, ndụmọdụ ha anaghị enye na otu atụmatụ na-esi agbanwe ozugbo ozugbo.

rows.source: Europe have played better as a team thus far and take a significant lead into the final day but this foursomes session also showed that Team USA has the stomach for the fight that some, especially Stateside, had been doubting.
rows.output: Ndị Europe na-egwu egwu nke ọma dị ka otu ahụ ruo ugbu a, naewerekwa nnukwu ụzọ n'ime ụbọchị ikpeazụ. Ma oge a na-egwu egwuregwu nke abụọ na-egosi na Team USA nwere ike ịlụ ọgụ nke ụfọdụ, karịsịa ndị si n'ụsọ oké osimiri, na-enwebu obi abụọ.
rows.reference: Mba Europe akụọla nke ọma dịka otu ruo ugbu a ma werekwa isi pụtara ihie ruo n’ụbọchị ikpeazụ mana agba mmadụ anọ a gosiri na otu USA nwere afọ ilụ ọgụ nke na ụfọdụ, ọ kachasị ndị Stateside na-agbagha mgbagha.

rows.source: Europe take 10-6 lead into Ryder Cup final day
rows.output: Europe na-ebute 10-6 n'ime ụbọchị ikpeazụ nke Ryder Cup
rows.reference: Mba Europe ji 10-6 aga, were banye Ryder Cup n’ụbọchị ikpeazụ

rows.source: Europe will take a healthy advantage into the final day of the Ryder Cup after emerging from Saturday's fourballs and foursomes matches with a 10-6 lead over the United States.
rows.output: Europe ga-eji uru ahụike nke ọma n'ụbọchị ikpeazụ nke Ryder Cup mgbe ha si na egwuregwu anọ na anọ nke Saturday pụta na 10-6 na United States.
rows.reference: Mba Europe ga-eji uru mara abụba were banye ụbọchị ikpeazụ nke Ryder Cup ka ha jichara 10-6 aga United State na bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ yana agba mmadụ anọ nke Satọde.

rows.source: Inspired duo Tommy Fleetwood and Francesco Molinari led the charge with two victories over a struggling Tiger Woods to take their tally so far at Le Golf National to four points.
rows.output: N'ụzọ dị iche, duo Tommy Fleetwood na Francesco Molinari na-edu ụzọ na mmeri abụọ n'elu Tiger Woods na-alọta, na-ebuli ọnụ ọgụgụ ha ugbu a na Le Golf National ruo isi anọ.
rows.reference: Ndị abụọ a akpalitere mmụọ ha, Tommy Fleetwood na Francesco Molinari bu ụzọ site na mmeri abụọ emeriri Tiger Woods n’agbalị mgbalị, n’iji akara anọ aga na Le Golf National.

rows.source: Thomas Bjorn's European side, bidding to retain the trophy they lost at Hazeltine two years ago, dominated a misfiring American side in the morning fourballs, taking the series 3-1.
rows.output: N'ụzọ dị iche, Thomas Bjorn's European side, na-achọ ịgbachitere ihe nrite ha furu efu na Hazeltine afọ abụọ gara aga, na-achịkwa otu American side na-ata ahụhụ n'oge ụtụ anọ, naewere usoro 3-1.
rows.reference: Ndị otu mba Europe nke Thomas Bjorn, na-achụ ijigide iko mmeri anapụrụ ha na Hazeline afọ abụọ gara aga, nọgidere ndị mba America na-akụgheri akụgheri ike na bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ n’ụtụtụ, were 3-1 merie agba nke ahụ.

rows.source: The U.S. offered more resistance in the foursomes, winning two matches, but they could not eat into the deficit.
rows.output: U.S. nyerekwu nguzozi n'ime foursomes, merie egwuregwu abụọ, mana ha enweghị ike iri n'ime ụgwọ.
rows.reference: Ndị US zọgidere nke ukwuu na agba mmadụ anọ, wee merie na asompi abụọ, mana ha enweghị ike ibelata ọnụọgụ mmeri.

rows.source: Jim Furyk's side need eight points from Sunday's 12 singles matches to retain the trophy.
rows.output: N'ụzọ Jim Furyk, ha chọrọ isi asatọ site na egwuregwu 12 nke otu n'ụzọ abụọ na Sọnde iji chekwaa ihe nrite ahụ.
rows.reference: Otu Jim Furyk chọrọ akara asatọ site na asompi 12 agba nke otu onye mere na Sọnde iji jigide iko mmeri ha.

rows.source: Fleetwood is the first European rookie to win four points in a row while he and Molinari, dubbed "Molliwood" after a sensational weekend are only the second pair to win four points from their opening four matches in Ryder Cup history.
rows.output: Fleetwood bụ onye rookie Europe mbụ meriri isi anọ n'usoro mgbe ọ na-eme ya na Molinari, a na-akpọ "Molliwood" mgbe ha nwere izu na-adịghị mma, bụ naanị ndị abụọ na-eme egwuregwu anọ site na egwuregwu anọ mbụ ha na asọmpi Ryder.
rows.reference: Fleetwood bụ onye ọhụrụ mbụ mba Europe meriri akara anọ ugboro ugboro ebe ya na Molinari, agụrụ aha “Molliwood” ka izu ụka pụrụ iche gachara bụ otu abụọ jiri akara anọ merie na asompi izizi anọ ha na hịstrị Ryder Cup.

rows.source: Having crushed Woods and Patrick Reed in the fourballs they then gelled superbly to beat a deflated Woods and American rookie Bryson Dechambeau by an even more emphatic 5&4.
rows.output: Ịkụpụrụ Woods na Patrick Reed n'ime egwuregwu anọ, ha wee gbazee nke ọma iji merie Woods na onye rookie America Bryson Dechambeau site na 5&4.
rows.reference: Ebe ha merigoro Woods na Patrick Reed na bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ, ha were jikọọ nke ọma were merie Woods dagoro mba na onye ọhụrụ mba America, Bryson Dechambeau site na 5&4 dara ụda.

rows.source: Woods, who dragged himself through two matches on Saturday, showed occasional bursts of brilliance but he has now lost 19 of his 29 matches in fourballs and foursomes and seven in a row.
rows.output: Woods, onye buru onwe ya n'ime egwuregwu abụọ na Satọde, gosipụtara mgbọrọgwụ nke ọma mgbe ụfọdụ mana ọ furu efu 19 n'ime egwuregwu 29 ya na anọ na abụọ na anọ na ise na otu.
rows.reference: Woods, bụ onye dọgidere onwe ya na asompi abụọ na Satọde gosiri anya nka ya na adanye adanye mana o tufuola asompi 19 n’ime 29 na bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ yana agba mmadụ anọ na nke asaa ugboro ugboro.

rows.source: Justin Rose, rested for the morning fourballs, returned to partner Henrik Stenson in the foursomes to a 2&1 defeat of Dustin Johnson and Brooks Koepka - ranked one and three in the world.
rows.output: Justin Rose, nke ezubere maka egwuregwu ụtụtụ anọ, lọghachiri partner ya Henrik Stenson na egwuregwu abụọ na otu (2&1) meri Dustin Johnson na Brooks Koepka - ndị nke mbụ na nke atọ n'ụwa.
rows.reference: Justin Rose zuru ike bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ nke ụtụtụ, were laghachi isonyere Henrik Stenson na agba mmadụ anọ nke ejiri 2&1 were merie Dustin Johnson na Brooks Koepka-ndị nọ n’ọkwa nke mbu na nke atọ na mba ụwa.

rows.source: Europe did not have it al their own way though on a pleasant, breezy day south west of Paris.
rows.output: Ọ bụghị naanị Europe nwere ya, n'ụbọchị mara mma, na-ekpo ọkụ na ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ nke Paris.
rows.reference: Mba Europe enwetachaghị ya ka ha siri chọọ, agbanyeghị n’ụbọchị ikuku ọma mgbada ọdịda anyanwu nke Paris.

rows.source: Three-times major winner Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas set the benchmark for the Americans with two points on Saturday.
rows.output: Onye mmeri ugboro atọ Jordan Spieth na Justin Thomas debere ihe atụ maka ndị America na isi abụọ na Satọde.
rows.reference: Jordan Spieth onye mmeri ugboro atọ na Justin Thomas jiri akara abụọ were tọọ ọkọlọtọ maka mba America na Satọde.

rows.source: They earned a gritty 2&1 win over Spain's Jon Rahm and Ian Poulter in the fourballs and returned later to beat Poulter and Rory McIlroy 4&3 in the foursomes having lost the opening two holes.
rows.output: Ha nwetara mmeri 2&1 na Spain Jon Rahm na Ian Poulter na egwuregwu anọ na abụọ, ma laghachi n'oge e mesịrị merie Poulter na Rory McIlroy 4&3 na egwuregwu anọ, mgbe ha furu efu n'ụzọ abụọ mbụ.
rows.reference: Ha nwetara mmeri siri ike nke 2&1 na Jon Rahm na Ian Poulter nke mba Spain na bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ were laghachi ọzọ imeri Poulter na Rory Mcllroy 4&3 na agba mmadụ anọ, ebe emerigoro ha n’oghere mmalite abụọ.

rows.source: Only twice in Ryder Cup history has a team come back from a four-point deficit going into the singles, although as holders Furyk's side need only draw to retain the trophy.
rows.output: Naanị ugboro abụọ n'akụkọ ihe mere eme nke Ryder Cup ka otu ndị otu na-alaghachi site na ọghọm anọ na-aga n'ihu na singles, ọ bụ ezie na dị ka ndị na-ejide, Furyk's side chọrọ naanị ịdọ aka ná ntị iji chekwaa ihe nrite ahụ.
rows.reference: Naanị ugboro abụọ na hịstrị Ryder Cup ka otu laghachiri azụ site na akara anọ ejiri emeri ha na mbanye agba nke otu onye, n’agbanyeghị dịka ndị ji iko, otu Furyk chọrọ naanị ịgbata onye laba, onye laba iji jigide iko mmeri ha.

rows.source: After being second-best for two days, however, a Sunday counter-attack looks as though it will be beyond them.
rows.output: Mgbe ọ bụ nke abụọ kacha mma n'ime ụbọchị abụọ, ọ dị ka ọ gaghị ekwe omume ịkwaga n'ihu na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Mgbe ha gbachara ndị nke abụọ n’ụbọchị abụọ, kosiladị, mbuso agha nke Sọnde dị ka ihe karịrị ha.

rows.source: North Korea says 'no way' will disarm unilaterally without trust
rows.output: North Korea na-ekwu 'weghachite' na ọ gaghị emebi onwe ya n'onwe ya na-enweghị ntụkwasị obi
rows.reference: North Korea kwuru “ọ gaghị eme” ịgbarapụ ngwa ọgụ na anataghị nkwenye

rows.source: North Korea's foreign minister told the United Nations on Saturday continued sanctions were deepening its mistrust in the United States and there was no way the country would give up its nuclear weapons unilaterally under such circumstances.
rows.output: Onye minista mba ofesi North Korea gwara United Nations na Satọde na mmachi iwu ndị ọzọ na-eme ka obi ghara ikere ha n'aka United States, na enweghị ụzọ ha ga-esi nye ngwa agha nuklia ha n'otu aka ahụ n'okpuru ọnọdụ ndị a.
rows.reference: Onye Mịnịsta nke mba ofesi North Korea gwara United Nations na Satọde na ịga n’ihu amachibido ha na-ebute atụkwasịghị obi na United State nke na ọ nweghịkwa ka obodo ha ga-esi gbarapụ ngwa ọgụ nuklịa ha n’ụdị ọnọdụ ahụ.

rows.source: Ri Yong Ho told the world body's annual General Assembly that North Korea had taken "significant goodwill measures" in the past year, such as stopping nuclear and missiles tests, dismantling the nuclear test site, and pledging not to proliferate nuclear weapons and nuclear technology.
rows.output: Ri Yong Ho gwara ọgbakọ mba ụwa nke afọ niile nke General Assembly na North Korea emeela "nzọụkwụ dị mma" n'afọ gara aga, dị ka ịkwụsị nnwale nuklia na missiles, ịkwatu ebe nnwale nuklia, na ịkwe nkwa na ha agaghịasa nuklia na teknụzụ nuklia.
rows.reference: Ri Yong Ho gwara otu mba ụwa na Mgbakọ Ezumezu ha kwa afọ na North Korea esorola “ezigbo ụzọ pụtara ihie” n’afọ gara aga, dị ka nkwụsị nlele ngwa nuklịa na ogbunigwe, ntọsa ebe nlele ngwa nuklịa ma kwee nkwa na ọ gaghị arụkasị ngwa ọgụ nuklịa na teknụzụ nuklịa.

rows.source: "However, we do not see any corresponding response from the U.S.," he said.
rows.output: "Otú ọ dị, anyị anaghị ahụ nzaghachi ọ bụla si n'aka ndị America," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Kosiladị, anyị ahụghị asịsa na-esote ya sitere na U,S” o kwuru.

rows.source: "Without any trust in the U.S. there will be no confidence in our national security and under such circumstances there is no way we will unilaterally disarm ourselves first."
rows.output: "Na-enweghị ntụkwasị obi ọ bụla na U.S., enweghị ntụkwasị obi na nchekwa obodo anyị ma n'okpuru ọnọdụ dị otú ahụ, enweghị ụzọ anyị ga-eweghachi onwe anyị n'ụzọ otu."
rows.reference: “N’enweghị ntụkwasị obi na U.S, agaghị enwekwa okwukwe na nchekwa nke obodo anyị, na n’ụdị ọnọdụ a, ọ nweghị ka anyị ga-esi buru ụzọ gbarapụ ngwa ọgụ anyị.”

rows.source: While Ri reprised familiar North Korean complaints about Washington's resistance to a "phased" approach to denuclearization under which North Korea would be rewarded as it took gradual steps, his statement appeared significant in that it did not reject unilateral denuclearization out of hand as Pyongyang has done in the past.
rows.output: Ebe Ri rụrụ ọrụ ugboro ugboro maka mkpesa North Korea gbasara Washington naeguzogide usoro "nke a na-eme n'ụzọ dị iche iche" nke ịwepụ nuklia, ebe a ga-akwụrụ North Korea ụgwọ ka ọ na-aga n'ihu n'ụzọ dị nwayọọ, okwu ya dị ka ọ dị mkpa n'ihi na ọ nweghị ike ịjụ ịwepụ nuklia n'onwe ya n'ụzọ dị mfe, dị ka Pyongyang mere n'oge gara aga.
rows.reference: Ebe Ri gbanwere mkpesa ndị North Korea banyere ọjụjụ nke Washington ime usoro “agba” mgbarapụ ngwa nuklịa n’okpuru nke North Korea ga-erite elele dịka ọ na-esonye usoro obere obere, okwu ya bara uru n’ihi na ọ jụghị mgbarapụ ngwa nuklliya ozugbo dịka Pyongyang siri mee n’oge gara aga.

rows.source: Ri referred to a joint statement issued by Kim Jong Un and Donald Trump at a first ever summit between a serving U.S. president and a North Korean leader in Singapore on June 12, when Kim pledged to work toward "denuclearization of the Korean peninsula" while Trump promised guarantees of North Korea's security.
rows.output: Ri na-ezo aka n'okwu nkwonkwo nke Kim Jong Un na Donald Trump wepụtara n'oge nzukọ mbụ n'etiti onye isi ala US na-arụ ọrụ na onye isi ala North Korea na Singapore na June 12, mgbe Kim kwere nkwa ịrụ ọrụ maka "denuclearization nke Korean Peninsula" ebe Trump kwere nkwa inye North Korea nkwa nchekwa.
rows.reference: Ri rụtụrụ aka na nkwuputa Kim Jong Un na Donald Trump kwukọrịtara na ọgbakọ nke izizi n’etiti onye isi ala U.S nọ n’ọchịchị na onye ọchịchị North Korea na Singapore na Juun 12, mgbe Kim kwere nkwa ịhụ banyere “mgbarapụ ngwa nuklịa nke okirikiri Korea” ebe Trump kwere nkwa nchekwa nke North Korea.

rows.source: North Korea has been seeking a formal end to the 1950-53 Korea War, but the United States has said Pyongyang must give up its nuclear weapons first.
rows.output: North Korea na-achọ ka e kwuchie agha Korea nke afọ 1950-53, mana United States kwuru na Pyongyang ga-ebunye ngwa agha nuklia mbụ.
rows.reference: North Korea na-achọ njedebe agha 1950-53 nke Korea, mana United States ekwuola na Pyongyang ga-ebu ụzọ gbarapụ ngwa ọgụ nuklliya ya.

rows.source: Washington has also resisted calls to relax tough international sanctions on North Korea.
rows.output: Washington enweela ike iguzogide oku ka ha mee ka iwu siri ike nke mba ndị ọzọ na North Korea dị mfe.
rows.reference: Washington ajụkwala oku ibelata mmachibido mba ụwa a siri ike nke North Korea.

rows.source: "The U.S. insists on the "denuclearization-first" and increases the level of pressure by sanctions to achieve their purpose in a coercive manner, and even objecting to the "declaration of the end of war,"" Ri said.
rows.output: "U.S. na-eme ka ọ dị mkpa "denuclearization-first" ma na-abawanye nrụgide site na ntaramahụhụ iji nweta ebumnuche ha n'ụzọ mmanye, na ọbụna na-eme ihe megide "nkwupụta nke njedebe nke agha,"" Ri kwuru.
rows.reference: “U.S kwụgidere na “mgbarapụ ngwa nuklịa-izizi” ma bulikwuo nkwanye ya site na mmachibido iji mezuo ebumnuche ha n’ụzọ nkwanye, ma jụkwuo “nkwuputa nke njedebe agha” Ri kwuru.

rows.source: "The perception that sanctions can bring us on our knees is a pipe dream of the people who are ignorant about us.
rows.output: "Ọ na-adị ka ndị na-enweghị ihe ọmụma banyere anyị na-eche na ntaramahụhụ nwere ike ime anyị ka anyị daa n'ikpere.
rows.reference: “Nghọta na mmachibido ga-akputu anyị n’ikpere anyị bụ nrọ efu nke ndị na amaghị anyị.

rows.source: But the problem is that the continued sanctions are deepening our mistrust."
rows.output: Mana nsogbu ahụ bụ na ntaramahụhụ ndị a na-aga n'ihu na-eme ka anyị ghara inwe ntụkwasị obi."
rows.reference: Mana nsogbu bụ na ịganihu eme machibido na-emina enweghị ntụkwasị obi anyị.”

rows.source: Ri made no mention of plans for a second summit between Kim and Trump that the U.S. leader highlighted at the United Nations earlier in the week.
rows.output: Ri ekwughighi atụmatụ maka nzukọ nke abụọ n'etiti Kim na Trump nke onye isi ala U.S. mere ka ọ pụta ìhè na United Nations n'isi izu ahụ.
rows.reference: Ri ekwughị maka atụmatụ ọgbakọ nke abụọ n’etiti Kim na Trump nke onye ọchịchị U.S kwuturu na United Nation n’izu ahụ.

rows.source: The minister instead highlighted three meetings between Kim and South Korean leader Moon Jae-in in the past five months and added: "If the party to this issue of denuclearization were South Korea and not the U.S., the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula would not have come to such a deadlock."
rows.output: Onye ozi ahụ wee gosi na e nwere nzukọ atọ n'etiti Kim na onye isi ala South Korea Moon Jae-in n'ime ọnwa ise gara aga, ma gbakwunyere: "Ọ bụrụ na otu n'ime okwu a bụ denuclearization nke Korean Peninsula, ọ bụghị United States, denuclearization nke Korean Peninsula ga-abịaghị n'ọnọdụ a."
rows.reference: Kama mịnịsta ahụ kwuturu maka nzụkọ atọ n’etiti Kim na onye ọchịchị South Korea Moon Jae-in n’ime ọnwa ise gara aga were tinyekwa: “Ọ bụrụ na ndị ọ metutara n’okwu nke mgbarapụ ngwa nuklịa bụ South Korea na ọ bụghị U.S, mgbarapụ ngwa nuklịa nke okirikiri Korea agaghị abịa n’ụdị nkụchikọ a.”

rows.source: Even so, the tone of Ri's speech was dramatically different from last year, when he told the U.N. General Assembly that targeting the U.S. mainland with North Korea's rockets was inevitable after "Mr Evil President" Trump called Kim a "rocket man" on a suicide mission.
rows.output: Ọbụna ya, ụda okwu Ri dị nnọọ iche na nke afọ gara aga, mgbe ọ gwara ọgbakọ mba ụwa na ịtọọ ebe isi obodo US na rọketi North Korea bụ ihe a na-apụghị izere ezere mgbe "onye isi ala ajọ" Trump kpọrọ Kim "onye na-agba ọsọ rọketi" na njem igbu onwe ya.
rows.reference: Ọbụlagodi otu a, olu okwu Ri tụgharịrị nke ukwuu site na afọ gara aga, mgbe ọ gwara Mgbakọ Ezumezu U.N. kwuru na iji rọketị ndị North Korea wee nweta isi ala U.S. apụghị ime, ka “Ajọ Onye Isi Ala” Trump kpọrọ Kim “nwoke rọketị” nọ n’ọrụ igbu ọchụ.

rows.source: This year at the United Nations, Trump, who last year threatened to "totally destroy" North Korea, heaped praise on Kim for his courage in taking steps to disarm, but said much work still had to be done and sanctions must remain in place until North Korea denuclearizes.
rows.output: N'afọ a na United Nations, Trump, onye n'afọ gara aga na-eyi egwu "n'ipụta ihe niile" North Korea, toro Kim maka obi ike ya n'ịụzị na ọ ga-ebelata, mana o kwuru na ọtụtụ ọrụ ka dị na ya ma na amachibido ihe ruo mgbe North Korea denuclearizes.
rows.reference: N’afọ a na United Nations, Trump onye nke majara n’afọ gara aga “imebi kpam kpam” North Korea, kpokwasara Kim otito maka obi ọ nwere n’isoro usoro mgbarapụ ngwa agha, mana o kwuru na a ka nwere ọtụtụ ọrụ nke na mmachibido ka ga-adịgide ruo mgbe North Korea kwụsịrị ngwa nuklịa.

rows.source: On Wednesday, Trump said he did not have a time frame for this, saying "If it takes two years, three years or five months - doesn't matter."
rows.output: N'Ụbọchị Wenezde, Trump kwuru na o nweghị oge maka nke a, na-ekwu "Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-ewe afọ abụọ, afọ atọ ma ọ bụ ọnwa ise - ọ naghị eme ihe ọ bụla."
rows.reference: Na Wenesde, Trump kwuru na ọ nweghị oge ewepụtara maka nke a, na-ekwu “ọ bụrụ na ọ ga-ewe afọ abụọ, afọ atọ ma ọ bụ ọnwa ise- ọ nweghị ihe ọ pụtara.”

rows.source: China and Russia argue that the U.N. Security Council should reward Pyongyang for steps taken.
rows.output: Ndị China na ndị Russia na-arụ ụka na ndị otu nche nke U.N.
rows.reference: China na Russia na-arụrịta ụka na Ọgbakọ Nchekwa U.N. kwesịrị inye Pyongyang elele maka usoro ndị ha megoro.

rows.source: However, U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo told the U.N. Security Council on Thursday that: "Enforcement of Security Council sanctions must continue vigorously and without fail until we realize the fully, final, verified denuclearization."
rows.output: Ọbụna, Onye isi ala United States Mike Pompeo gwara ndị otu United Nations na Tọzde na: "Mmanye iwu nke United Nations ga-aga n'ihu n'ụzọ siri ike na enweghị mperi ruo mgbe anyị nwetara nkwubi okwu zuru ezu, nke ikpeazụ, nke e mere n'ụzọ ziri ezi."
rows.reference: Kosiladị, U.S Mike Pompeo gwara Ọgbakọ Nchekwa U,N Na Tọsde na “Mmanye nke mmachibido Ọgbakọ Nchekwa ga-aga n’ihu ike n’ike na-adaghị mba ruo mgbe anyị mezuru mgbarapụ ngwa nuklịa kpam kpam, na njedebe.”

rows.source: The Security Council has unanimously boosted sanctions on North Korea since 2006 in a bid to choke off funding for Pyongyang's nuclear and ballistic missile programs.
rows.output: Ụlọ Nzukọ Nche ahụ emela ka ntaramahụhụ dị n'ebe ugwu Korea dịkwuo elu n'ụzọ dị n'otu kemgbe 2006 iji gbochie ego maka mmemme nuklia na ụgbọ elu nke Pyongyang.
rows.reference: Ọgbakọ Nchekwa ahụ jikọrọ aka ọnụ kwalite mmachibido North Korea kemgbe 2006, n’ụzọ ịgbachi ego maka mmemme ngwa nuklịa na ogbunigwe Pyongyang.

rows.source: Pompeo met Ri on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly and said afterwards that he would visit Pyongyang again next month to prepare for a second summit.
rows.output: Pompeo zutere Ri n'akụkụ ọgbakọ mba ụwa na-ekwu na mgbe e mesịrị, ọ ga-eleta Pyongyang ọzọ n'ọnwa na-abịa iji kwadebe maka nzukọ nke abụọ.
rows.reference: Pompeo zutere Ri n’akụkụ nke Mgbakọ Ezumezu U.N. wee gwa ya ka emechara na ọ ga-abịa Pyongyang ọzọ n’ọnwa na-abịa iji kwado maka ọgbakọ nke abụọ.

rows.source: Pompeo has visited North Korea three times already this year, but his last trip did not go well.
rows.output: Pompeo enela North Korea ugboro atọ n'afọ a, ma njem ikpeazụ ya adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Pompeo ejeela North Korea ugboro atọ n’afọ a, mana njem ikpeazụ ya agaghị nke ọma.

rows.source: He left Pyongyang in July saying that progress had been made, only for North Korea within hours to denounce him for making "gangster-like demands."
rows.output: Ọ hapụrụ Pyongyang n'ọnwa Julaị na-ekwu na e mere ọganihu, ma n'ime awa ole na ole, North Korea katara ya maka ime "ihe ndị na-eme ihe ike."
rows.reference: Ọ hapụrụ Pyongyang na Julaị na-ekwu na enwela agamnihu, naanị ka North Korea jụ ya n’ime awa ole ma ole maka iti “iwu yiri nke ndị agboro.”

rows.source: North Korea pledged in a meeting with Moon this month to dismantle a missile site and also a nuclear complex if the United States took "corresponding measures."
rows.output: North Korea kwere nkwa n'oge nzukọ ya na Moon n'ọnwa a ka ha kwụsị ebe a na-atụ bọmbụ na ebe a na-emepụta nuklia ma ọ bụrụ na United States mere "nzọụkwụ ndị ọzọ."
rows.reference: North Korea kwere nkwa na nzụkọ yana Moon mere n’ime ọnwa a ịtọsa ebe ogbunigwe nakwa ụlọ ọrụ nuklịa ma ọ bụrụ na United States esoro “usoro dabara.”

rows.source: He said Kim had told him the "corresponding measures" he was seeking were security guarantees Trump pledged in Singapore and moves toward normalization of relations with Washington.
rows.output: O kwuru na Kim gwara ya na "ụzọ dị iche" ọ na-achọ bụ nchedo Trump kwere nkwa na Singapore na mmegharị maka ime ka mmekọrịta dị n'etiti Washington na Pyongyang dịkwuo mma.
rows.reference: O kwuru na Kim gwara ya, “usoro dabara” nke ọ na-achọ bụ nkwa nchekwa Trump kwere ya na nkwa na Singapore yana ịga n’ihu mee ka mmekọrịta dị n’etiti Washington dị mma.

rows.source: Harvard students take course in getting enough rest
rows.output: Ụmụ akwụkwọ Harvard na-amụ ihe gbasara izu ike zuru ezu
rows.reference: Ụmụ akwụkwọ Harvard na-eme mmụta ka-esi enwe ezumike zuru ezu

rows.source: A new course at Harvard University this year has got all its undergraduates getting more sleep in a bid to combat the growing macho culture of studying through caffeine-fuelled 'all-nighters.'
rows.output: N'afọ a, otu nkuzi ọhụrụ na Mahadum Harvard nwere ụmụ akwụkwọ niile na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ akwụkwọ na-amụ
rows.reference: Mmụta ọ hụrụ dị na Mahadum Harvard n’afọ a mere ụmụ akwụkwọ niile na-agụ akwụkwọ ịrahụzu ụra, ime ka echere omenala iji kafin agụ akwụkwọ ‘abalị niile’ aka mgba.’

rows.source: An academic found students at the world's number one university are often clueless when it comes to the very basics about how to look after themselves.
rows.output: Onye ọkà mmụta sayensị hụrụ na ụmụ akwụkwọ na mahadum kacha elu n'ụwa na-enwekarị ihe isi ike mgbe ọ bịara n'isi ihe ndị dị mkpa gbasara otú ha ga-esi lekọta onwe ha.
rows.reference: Onye mmụta chọpụtara na ụmụ akwụkwọ enwere na Mahadum mbu n’ụwa niile anaghị amakarị ihe kwesịrị ma abịa n’ilekọta onwe ha anya.

rows.source: Charles Czeisler, professor of sleep medicine at Harvard Medical School and a specialist at the Brigham and Women's Hospital, designed the course, which he believes is the first of its kind in the US.
rows.output: Charles Czeisler, onye ọkà mmụta ihe gbasara ihi ụra na Harvard Medical School na onye ọkachamara na Brigham and Women's Hospital, mere atụmatụ mmemme ahụ, nke o kwenyere na ọ bụ nke mbụ ya na US.
rows.reference: Charles Czeisler, ọkammụta ahụike nke ụra na Havard Medical School yana onye ọkachamara na Brigham yana Women Hospital haziri mmụta ahụ, nke ọ kwenyere na ọ bụ ụdịdị ya mbu na US.

rows.source: He was inspired to start the course after giving a talk on the impact sleep deprivation had on learning.
rows.output: Ọ bụ mkpalị malitere ịmụ ihe mgbe ọ na-ekwu okwu banyere mmetụta nke enweghị ụra na mmụta.
rows.reference: Ọ nwetara echiche ịmalite mmụta ahụ ka ọ nyechara nkuzi banyere nsonazụ arahụghị ụra na-eme mmụta.

rows.source: 'At the end of it one girl came up to me and said: 'Why am I only being told this now, in my senior year?'
rows.output: "N'ikpeazụ ya, otu nwa agbọghọ bịakwutere m ma sị: 'Gịnị mere e ji akọwahie m ihe a ugbu a, n'afọ ikpeazụ m?'
rows.reference: ‘Ka emechara nke ahụ otu nwa agbọghọ biakwutere m nwee sị: ‘Kedu ihe kpatara o jiri bụrụ ugbu a ka a na-agwa m ihe a, n’afọ senịọ m?’

rows.source: She said no one had ever told her about the importance of sleep - which surprised me,' he told The Telegraph.
rows.output: Ọ sịrị na onye ọ bụla ọ bụla gwara ya gbasara mkpa ihi ụra - nke tụkwara m n'anya,' ka o kwuru na Telegraph.
rows.reference: O kwuru na ọ nwebeghị onye gwara ya uru ụra bara- bụ ihe tụrụ m n’anya.’ ọ gwara The Telegraph.

rows.source: The course, rolled out for the first time this year, explains to students the essentials of how good sleep habits help academic and athletic performance, as well as improve their general wellbeing.
rows.output: N'ụzọ dị iche, a na-akụzi ụmụ akwụkwọ ihe ndị dị mkpa nke otu e si ehi ụra nke ọma na-enyere aka na arụmọrụ agụmakwụkwọ na egwuregwu, yana imeziwanye ahụike ha n'ozuzu.
